WITH dept_units_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS FROM `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING') SELECT icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(icte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(icte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(icte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, dept_course_counts.Total_Courses FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN (SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Total_Courses FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_course_counts ON icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_course_counts.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dept_course_counts.Total_Courses), math_course_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.SUBJECT_CODE, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS, scd.COURSE, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND NOT ccc.total_units IS NULL AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.COURSE AS course_number, i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.TOTAL_UNITS, dept_stats.avg_total_units, dept_stats.min_total_units, dept_stats.max_total_units, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - dept_stats.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_stats ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT dus.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, dus.Total_Courses, mcs.course_number, mcs.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, mcs.TOTAL_UNITS AS math_course_total_units, mcs.avg_total_units AS math_avg_total_units, mcs.min_total_units AS math_min_total_units, mcs.max_total_units AS math_max_total_units, mcs.deviation_from_avg AS math_deviation_from_avg FROM dept_units_stats AS dus LEFT JOIN math_course_stats AS mcs ON dus.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = mcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dus.total_units_variance DESC, mcs.deviation_from_avg DESC

WITH political_science_subjects AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(student_count))) AS geometric_mean_students, SUM(student_count) AS total_students FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` GROUP BY DEPARTMENT) AS m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC), department_units_stats AS (SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT <> '18' GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME), department_school_phone AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT ps.SUBJECT_CODE, ps.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ps.geometric_mean_students, ps.total_students, dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsp.SCHOOL_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, dsp.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM (SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, geometric_mean_students, total_students FROM political_science_subjects GROUP BY SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, geometric_mean_students, total_students WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(total_students) > 0) AS ps LEFT JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS ssc ON ps.SUBJECT_CODE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE LEFT JOIN department_units_stats AS dus ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN department_school_phone AS dsp ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsp.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ps.SUBJECT_CODE, ps.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, dsp.SCHOOL_NAME, dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON at.TERM_CODE = c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION), cte1 AS (SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.num_subjects, at.TERM_START_DATE, at.TERM_END_DATE FROM inner_cte1 AS i JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.TERM_DESCRIPTION = at.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY i.num_subjects DESC LIMIT 10), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR), cte2 AS (SELECT icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_variance, icte.total_units_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte2 AS icte LEFT JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cte1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cte1.num_subjects, cte1.TERM_START_DATE, cte1.TERM_END_DATE, cte2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte2.avg_total_units, cte2.total_units_variance, cte2.total_units_stddev, cte2.SCHOOL_NAME, cte2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY cte1.num_subjects DESC, cte2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH highest_avg_enrollment AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, l.TERM_CODE, AVG(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment_per_term FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s JOIN `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND NOT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, l.TERM_CODE) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(avg_enrollment_per_term) AS highest_avg_enrollment_per_term FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME), course_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.COURSE_LEVEL, icte.course_count, icte.min_total_units, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE_OPTION) AS distinct_course_options FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.COURSE_LEVEL = scd.COURSE_LEVEL GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.COURSE_LEVEL, icte.course_count, icte.min_total_units, scd.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cs.COURSE_LEVEL, cs.course_count, cs.min_total_units, cs.SCHOOL_NAME, cs.distinct_course_options, hae.highest_avg_enrollment_per_term FROM course_stats AS cs JOIN highest_avg_enrollment AS hae ON cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = hae.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cs.COURSE_LEVEL

WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS cso WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cso.IS_VARIABLE_UNITS = 'N' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%Mathematics%') SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING NOT ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NULL ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION) OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) = inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION END AS term_description, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_NUMBER, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.window_column AS subject_rank_in_dept, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, dept_stats.subject_count_in_dept, inner_cte.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE = ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_count_in_dept FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY t0.TERM_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_stats ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = dept_stats.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE) SELECT 'Department_Statistics' AS result_type, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.avg_total_units, s1.var_total_units, NULL AS term_description, NULL AS subject_code, NULL AS subject_number, NULL AS subject_title, NULL AS subject_rank_in_dept, NULL AS school_name, NULL AS subject_count_in_dept FROM Subquery1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT 'Subject_Details' AS result_type, NULL AS academic_year, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS var_total_units, s2.term_description, s2.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.subject_rank_in_dept, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.subject_count_in_dept FROM Subquery2 AS s2 ORDER BY result_type, academic_year, department_name, term_description, subject_code

WITH math_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, GREATEST(c.TOTAL_UNITS, COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0)) AS max_total_units_3rows FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.TERM_CODE) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_NUMBER, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.TERM_CODE, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.max_total_units_3rows FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON i.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ORDER BY i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_NUMBER, i.TERM_CODE), eng_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s.TERM_CODE, s.TOTAL_UNITS FROM `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS s JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON ata.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON s.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_START_DATE, at.TERM_END_DATE, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, MIN(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE) SELECT m.SUBJECT_CODE, m.SUBJECT_NUMBER, m.SUBJECT_TITLE, m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.ACADEMIC_YEAR, m.TERM_CODE, m.TERM_DESCRIPTION, m.max_total_units_3rows, e.SCHOOL_NAME, e.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, e.TERM_START_DATE, e.TERM_END_DATE, e.window_column FROM math_cte AS m JOIN eng_cte AS e ON m.TERM_CODE = e.TERM_CODE ORDER BY m.SUBJECT_CODE, m.SUBJECT_NUMBER, m.TERM_CODE, e.SCHOOL_NAME, e.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC

WITH SchoolCIP AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_code, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_CODE FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS c JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_CODE HAVING MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) > 120000) SELECT i.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK, MAX(i.max_cip_code) AS school_max_cip_code, CASE WHEN MAX(i.max_cip_code) > 150000 THEN 'HIGH_CIP' WHEN MAX(i.max_cip_code) < 130000 THEN 'LOW_CIP' ELSE 'MEDIUM_CIP' END AS cip_category, i.SCHOOL_CODE FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS s ON i.SCHOOL_CODE = s.SCHOOL_CODE GROUP BY i.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK, i.SCHOOL_CODE), MathDeptTopSubject AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS subject_course_count FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SCHOOL_NAME = scd.SCHOOL_NAME AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS ssc ON scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND scd.SCHOOL_NAME = ssc.SCHOOL_NAME GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY subject_course_count DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT sc.SCHOOL_NAME, sc.SCHOOL_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK, sc.school_max_cip_code, sc.cip_category, mdts.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mdts.SCHOOL_NAME AS MATH_SCHOOL_NAME, mdts.SUBJECT_CODE, mdts.subject_course_count FROM SchoolCIP AS sc LEFT JOIN MathDeptTopSubject AS mdts ON sc.SCHOOL_NAME = mdts.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY sc.SCHOOL_NAME

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y'), cte_subject_units AS (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 9999 ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance, MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS academic_year_desc FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP), SubjectUnitsStats AS (SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(academic_year) OVER (ORDER BY year_sort, academic_year, dept_sort) = academic_year THEN NULL ELSE academic_year END AS academic_year, academic_year_desc, dept, units_range, units_variance FROM cte_subject_units AS tbl ORDER BY year_sort, dept_sort), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10), BuildingRoomStats AS (SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.area_range, ic.area_variance, ic.area_stddev, b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, b.DATE_BUILT FROM inner_cte2 AS ic JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b ON ic.BUILDING_NAME = b.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY ic.area_range DESC) SELECT s.academic_year, s.academic_year_desc, s.dept, s.units_range, s.units_variance, b.BUILDING_NAME, b.area_range, b.area_variance, b.area_stddev, b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, b.DATE_BUILT FROM SubjectUnitsStats AS s CROSS JOIN BuildingRoomStats AS b ORDER BY s.academic_year, s.dept, b.area_range DESC

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR), dept_avg AS (SELECT department, AVG(subject_count) AS avg_subject_count FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY department), subq1 AS (SELECT i.department, i.academic_year, i.subject_count, i.min_term_start_date, d.avg_subject_count, CASE WHEN i.subject_count > d.avg_subject_count * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.subject_count < d.avg_subject_count * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'WITHIN_10_PERCENT' END AS subject_count_category FROM inner_cte1 AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.department = d.department), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), subq2 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte2 WHERE avg_total_units > (SELECT AVG(ccso2.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata2 JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso2 ON ata2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.TERM_CODE WHERE ata2.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ata2.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%')) SELECT s1.department, s1.academic_year, s1.subject_count, s1.min_term_start_date, s1.avg_subject_count, s1.subject_count_category, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.avg_total_units, s2.stddev_total_units FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.academic_year = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.department, s1.academic_year

WITH school_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, EXP(AVG(LN(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE))) AS geometric_mean_dept_budget_code FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND NOT DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT i.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(i.geometric_mean_dept_budget_code) AS school_geometric_mean_dept_budget_code, AVG(dept_subject_counts.subject_count) AS avg_subject_codes_per_department FROM inner_cte AS i LEFT JOIN (SELECT d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_count FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d LEFT JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS dept_subject_counts ON i.SCHOOL_NAME = dept_subject_counts.SCHOOL_NAME AND i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dept_subject_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY i.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY i.SCHOOL_NAME), math_course_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.COURSE_LEVEL, icte.course_count, icte.min_total_units, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE_OPTION) AS distinct_course_options FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.COURSE_LEVEL = scd.COURSE_LEVEL GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.COURSE_LEVEL, icte.course_count, icte.min_total_units, scd.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.school_geometric_mean_dept_budget_code, ss.avg_subject_codes_per_department, mcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mcs.COURSE_LEVEL, mcs.course_count, mcs.min_total_units, mcs.SCHOOL_NAME AS math_school_name, mcs.distinct_course_options FROM school_stats AS ss CROSS JOIN math_course_stats AS mcs

WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.subject_code_count, ic.min_dept_budget_code, COUNT(DISTINCT s.COURSE_NUMBER) AS unique_course_count FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SUBJECT_CODE = s.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.subject_code_count, ic.min_dept_budget_code), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS t1 JOIN `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t2 ON t1.COURSE_NUMBER = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT * FROM inner_cte) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.subject_code_count, s1.min_dept_budget_code, s1.unique_course_count, s2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.window_column, s2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s1.SUBJECT_CODE = s2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE, COUNT(c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE), cte1 AS (SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(dept) OVER (ORDER BY dept_sort, grade_type) = dept THEN NULL ELSE dept END AS department, grade_type, subject_count, min_total_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone, sd.DLC_KEY AS dlc_key FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept, GRADE_TYPE AS grade_type, COUNT(SUBJECT_COUNT) AS subject_count, MIN(min_total_units) AS min_total_units FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, GRADE_TYPE WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp LEFT JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, o.DLC_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT d.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND NOT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('ADMISSIONS') AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_KEY HAVING COUNT(*) > 5), cte2 AS (SELECT inner_cte2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte2.area_stddev, o2.DLC_NAME, inner_cte2.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte2 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o2 ON inner_cte2.DLC_KEY = o2.DLC_KEY) SELECT cte1.department, cte1.grade_type, cte1.subject_count, cte1.min_total_units, cte1.school_name, cte1.department_phone, cte2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, cte2.area_stddev, cte2.DLC_NAME FROM cte1 LEFT JOIN cte2 ON cte1.dlc_key = cte2.DLC_KEY ORDER BY cte1.department, cte1.grade_type, cte2.area_stddev DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.DLC_NAME, t0.DLC_CODE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.ORGANIZATION_ID, AVG(t1.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DLC_CODE ORDER BY t1.ORGANIZATION_SORT) AS avg_org_number FROM `MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME = 'School of Science' AND LOWER(t0.DLC_NAME) <> LOWER('Biology') AND NOT t1.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250')) SELECT DLC_NAME, DLC_CODE, ORGANIZATION_NAME, ORGANIZATION_ID, MAX(avg_org_number) AS max_avg_org_number FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DLC_NAME, DLC_CODE, ORGANIZATION_NAME, ORGANIZATION_ID

WITH BuildingRoomArea AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, SUM(fr.AREA) AS total_room_area, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` AS fr JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC IN ('RESIDENT', 'LABS') AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING SUM(fr.AREA) > 1000), BuildingPeriods AS (SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD, ic.total_room_area, ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_HIST` AS fbh ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) SELECT bp.BUILDING_NAME, bp.FISCAL_PERIOD, SUM(bp.total_room_area) AS total_room_area, bp.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM BuildingPeriods AS bp GROUP BY bp.FISCAL_PERIOD, bp.BUILDING_NAME, bp.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(bp.total_room_area) > 0), AcademicBuildingArea AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD, SUM(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY fb.CAMPUS_SECTOR ORDER BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_assignable_area FROM `FCLT_BUILDING` AS fb JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_HIST` AS fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> '32') SELECT icte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, icte.BUILDING_NAME, icte.FISCAL_PERIOD, icte.running_assignable_area, fb.EXT_GROSS_AREA FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS fb ON icte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) SELECT bra.BUILDING_NAME, bra.FISCAL_PERIOD, bra.total_room_area, aba.running_assignable_area, aba.EXT_GROSS_AREA FROM BuildingRoomArea AS bra JOIN AcademicBuildingArea AS aba ON bra.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = aba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND bra.FISCAL_PERIOD = aba.FISCAL_PERIOD WHERE NOT bra.BUILDING_NAME IS NULL ORDER BY bra.FISCAL_PERIOD, bra.BUILDING_NAME

WITH org_space_units AS (SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, DESCRIPTION, SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(SPACE_UNIT) OVER (PARTITION BY ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS total_space_units, DLC_KEY FROM (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.DLC_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' AND NOT t0.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250')) AS inner_cte), org_hr_dept AS (SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION, ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.organization_count, ic.min_organization_number, f.DLC_KEY FROM (SELECT f.ORGANIZATION, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS f JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' AND NOT f.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST') AND NOT f.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY f.ORGANIZATION, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS ic JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h2 ON ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = h2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS f ON ic.ORGANIZATION = f.ORGANIZATION WHERE h2.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = 'Provost Area') SELECT osu.ORGANIZATION_NAME, osu.DESCRIPTION, osu.SPACE_UNIT, osu.total_space_units, ohd.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ohd.organization_count, ohd.min_organization_number FROM org_space_units AS osu JOIN org_hr_dept AS ohd ON osu.DLC_KEY = ohd.DLC_KEY

WITH highest_avg_enrollment_per_term_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, l.TERM_CODE, AVG(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment_per_term FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s JOIN `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND NOT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, l.TERM_CODE) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(avg_enrollment_per_term) AS highest_avg_enrollment_per_term FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME), course_stats_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.COURSE_LEVEL, icte.course_count, icte.min_total_units, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE_OPTION) AS distinct_course_options FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.COURSE_LEVEL = scd.COURSE_LEVEL GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.COURSE_LEVEL, icte.course_count, icte.min_total_units, scd.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT csc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, csc.COURSE_LEVEL, csc.course_count, csc.min_total_units, csc.SCHOOL_NAME, csc.distinct_course_options, hap.highest_avg_enrollment_per_term FROM course_stats_cte AS csc JOIN highest_avg_enrollment_per_term_cte AS hap ON csc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = hap.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY csc.COURSE_LEVEL

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME), cte1 AS (SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte1 WHERE coefficient_of_variation > 0.2), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, o.DLC_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT d.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND NOT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('ADMISSIONS') AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_KEY HAVING COUNT(*) > 5), cte2 AS (SELECT inner_cte2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte2.area_stddev, o2.DLC_NAME, inner_cte2.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte2 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o2 ON inner_cte2.DLC_KEY = o2.DLC_KEY) SELECT cte1.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.coefficient_of_variation, cte2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, cte2.area_stddev, cte2.DLC_NAME FROM cte1 JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON cte1.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS fo ON sd.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN cte2 ON fo.DLC_KEY = cte2.DLC_KEY ORDER BY cte1.coefficient_of_variation DESC, cte2.area_stddev DESC

WITH cv_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0), avg_cv AS (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_cv FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_cv AS a ON 1 = 1 WHERE i.coefficient_of_variation > a.avg_cv), materials_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status_description, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS td JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS` AS tms ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON td.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND td.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE (NOT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY IS NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY NOT LIKE 'N/ACourse has no materials%') GROUP BY tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(material_count) AS highest_material_count_for_status FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT cv_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cv_cte.coefficient_of_variation, materials_cte.highest_material_count_for_status FROM cv_cte JOIN materials_cte ON cv_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = materials_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cv_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC

WITH enrolled_variance_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, enrolled_students_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE enrolled_students_variance > (SELECT AVG(enrolled_students_variance) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC), material_count_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status_description, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS td JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS` AS tms ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON td.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND td.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE (NOT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY IS NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY NOT LIKE 'N/ACourse has no materials%') GROUP BY tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(material_count) AS highest_material_count_for_status FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT evc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, evc.enrolled_students_variance, mcc.highest_material_count_for_status FROM enrolled_variance_cte AS evc LEFT JOIN material_count_cte AS mcc ON evc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mcc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY evc.enrolled_students_variance DESC

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_NAME, b.BUILDING_TYPE, COUNT(h.FCLT_BUILDING_HIST_KEY) AS hist_record_count, SUM(h.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_assignable_area FROM `FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS` AS a JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b ON a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_HIST` AS h ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = h.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE a.CITY = 'CAMBRIDGE' AND a.STATE = 'MA' AND b.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 1 AND NOT b.BUILDING_NAME IS NULL AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> 32 GROUP BY b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_NAME, b.BUILDING_TYPE) SELECT ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.BUILDING_TYPE, ic.hist_record_count, ic.total_assignable_area, AVG(h.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS avg_hist_num_of_rooms FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_HIST` AS h ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = h.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.BUILDING_TYPE, ic.hist_record_count, ic.total_assignable_area), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10) SELECT inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME, inner_cte.area_range, inner_cte.area_variance, inner_cte.area_stddev, b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM inner_cte JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b ON inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME = b.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.area_range DESC) SELECT s1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, s1.BUILDING_NAME, s1.BUILDING_TYPE, s1.hist_record_count, s1.total_assignable_area, s1.avg_hist_num_of_rooms, s2.area_range, s2.area_variance, s2.area_stddev, s2.ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS mit_assignable_area FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.BUILDING_NAME = s2.BUILDING_NAME

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE, COUNT(c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE), cte1 AS (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept, GRADE_TYPE AS grade_type, COUNT(SUBJECT_COUNT) AS subject_count, MIN(min_total_units) AS min_total_units FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, GRADE_TYPE WITH ROLLUP), DepartmentSubjects AS (SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(dept) OVER (ORDER BY dept_sort, grade_type) = dept THEN NULL ELSE dept END AS department, grade_type, subject_count, min_total_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone, sd.DLC_KEY FROM cte1 AS tbltmp LEFT JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dept_sort, grade_type), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, o.DLC_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT d.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND NOT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('ADMISSIONS') AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_KEY HAVING COUNT(*) > 5), DepartmentRoomStats AS (SELECT inner_cte2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte2.area_stddev, o2.DLC_NAME, o2.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte2 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o2 ON inner_cte2.DLC_KEY = o2.DLC_KEY ORDER BY inner_cte2.area_stddev DESC) SELECT ds.department, ds.grade_type, ds.subject_count, ds.min_total_units, ds.school_name, ds.department_phone, drs.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name, drs.area_stddev, drs.DLC_NAME AS dlc_name FROM DepartmentSubjects AS ds JOIN DepartmentRoomStats AS drs ON ds.DLC_KEY = drs.DLC_KEY ORDER BY ds.department, ds.grade_type, drs.area_stddev DESC

WITH area_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, o.DLC_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT d.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND NOT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('ADMISSIONS') AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_KEY HAVING COUNT(*) > 5) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.area_stddev, o2.DLC_NAME, inner_cte.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o2 ON inner_cte.DLC_KEY = o2.DLC_KEY ORDER BY inner_cte.area_stddev DESC), hr_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hou.DLC_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS num_hr_org_units FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS fo JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT fo.ORGANIZATION_ID IN (138, 250) AND LOWER(hou.DLC_NAME) = 'biology' GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hou.DLC_NAME ORDER BY num_hr_org_units DESC, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME LIMIT 3) SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.num_hr_org_units, COUNT(DISTINCT hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS num_hr_departments, fo.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS fo ON icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME AND icte.DLC_NAME = fo.DLC_NAME JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE LOWER(hou.DLC_NAME) = 'biology' GROUP BY icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.num_hr_org_units, fo.DLC_KEY ORDER BY icte.num_hr_org_units DESC, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT a.ORGANIZATION_NAME, a.area_stddev, a.DLC_NAME, h.num_hr_org_units, h.num_hr_departments FROM area_stats AS a JOIN hr_stats AS h ON a.ORGANIZATION_NAME = h.ORGANIZATION_NAME AND a.DLC_NAME = h.DLC_NAME AND a.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY ORDER BY h.num_hr_org_units DESC, a.area_stddev DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.coefficient_of_variation, c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ed.FULL_NAME AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_FULL_NAME, mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER, AVG(ed.OFFICE_PHONE) OVER (PARTITION BY ed.LAST_NAME ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS AVG_OFFICE_PHONE_WINDOW, ed.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_EMAIL FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY` AS ed ON c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = ed.MIT_ID LEFT JOIN `MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL` AS mld ON ed.MIT_ID = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = 18 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.SUBJECT_CODE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sp.MIT_ID, sp.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, SUM(sp.MIT_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR ORDER BY sp.MIT_ID) AS running_sum_mit_id FROM `SE_PERSON` AS sp JOIN `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` AS msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Student' AND msd.DEPARTMENT = 6 AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR, sp.MIT_ID), DepartmentUnitVariation AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0), DepartmentCourseCount AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS total_courses FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT icte.MIT_ID, icte.FULL_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.STUDENT_YEAR, icte.running_sum_mit_id, duv.coefficient_of_variation, dcc.total_courses FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN DepartmentUnitVariation AS duv ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN DepartmentCourseCount AS dcc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.STUDENT_YEAR, icte.MIT_ID

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'), course_counts AS (SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER) AS total_courses FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE), subject_code_stats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM (SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS cd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT) AS course_subjects JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON course_subjects.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.window_column, scs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scs.avg_subject_codes, scs.stddev_subject_codes, cc.total_courses FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN subject_code_stats AS scs ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scs.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN course_counts AS cc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, scs.avg_subject_codes DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, l.TERM_CODE FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS l JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'), math_units_variation AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation_total_units FROM `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR), chem_tip_materials AS (SELECT t.TERM_CODE, t.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS num_tip_materials FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t LEFT JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS td ON t.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY AND t.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' GROUP BY t.TERM_CODE, t.SUBJECT_ID), chem_subjects_with_materials AS (SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.window_column, i.TERM_CODE, t.SUBJECT_ID, COALESCE(m.num_tip_materials, 0) AS num_tip_materials FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t ON i.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND i.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME = t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' LEFT JOIN chem_tip_materials AS m ON t.TERM_CODE = m.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = m.SUBJECT_ID), avg_materials_per_year AS (SELECT mv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(csm.num_tip_materials) AS avg_tip_materials_per_chem_subject FROM math_units_variation AS mv CROSS JOIN chem_subjects_with_materials AS csm GROUP BY mv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT csm.SUBJECT_TITLE, csm.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, csm.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, csm.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, csm.window_column, mv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, mv.coefficient_of_variation_total_units, csm.num_tip_materials, avgm.avg_tip_materials_per_chem_subject FROM chem_subjects_with_materials AS csm CROSS JOIN math_units_variation AS mv LEFT JOIN avg_materials_per_year AS avgm ON mv.ACADEMIC_YEAR = avgm.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND mv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = avgm.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.ORGANIZATION_ID, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, MAX(t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ORGANIZATION_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT t1.ORGANIZATION_ID IS NULL AND NOT t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID IS NULL AND t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND NOT t1.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250')), DepartmentRoomAreaStddev AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT d.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND NOT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('ADMISSIONS') AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5), DepartmentRoomCount AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS total_room_count FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT o1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o1.ORGANIZATION_ID, o1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, o1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, o1.MAX_HR_ORG_UNIT_ID, d2.area_stddev, d3.total_room_count FROM inner_cte AS o1 LEFT JOIN DepartmentRoomAreaStddev AS d2 ON o1.ORGANIZATION_NAME = d2.ORGANIZATION_NAME LEFT JOIN DepartmentRoomCount AS d3 ON o1.ORGANIZATION_NAME = d3.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY o1.ORGANIZATION_ID

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.TERM_CODE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_chemistry_courses, AVG(reserved_count) AS avg_reserved_materials FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso LEFT JOIN (SELECT td.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_count FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS td JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrm ON td.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY td.SUBJECT_ID) AS reserves ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = reserves.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') AND NOT tso.TERM_CODE IS NULL GROUP BY tso.TERM_CODE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, term, dept_sort) = term THEN NULL ELSE term END AS term, dept, num_chemistry_courses, avg_reserved_materials, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(department_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(department_name) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(department_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(department_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE department_name END AS dept_sort, department_name AS dept, SUM(num_chemistry_courses) AS num_chemistry_courses, AVG(avg_reserved_materials) AS avg_reserved_materials, MAX(OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS offer_dept_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TERM_CODE, department_name, OFFER_DEPT_CODE WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp LEFT JOIN `STUDENT_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON tbltmp.offer_dept_code = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date, s.DEPARTMENT FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS s JOIN `CIP` AS c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'), DeptCostStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, VARIANCE(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, STDDEV(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT LIKE '%Mathematics%' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT ic.COURSE, ic.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.PROGRAM_CODE, ic.PROGRAM_TITLE, ic.CATEGORY_CODE, ic.CATEGORY_TITLE, ic.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, ic.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, ic.min_warehouse_load_date, dcs.avg_clearing_cost_collector, dcs.clearing_cost_collector_variance, dcs.clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN DeptCostStats AS dcs ON ic.DEPARTMENT = dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ic.CATEGORY_CODE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_NAME, STDDEV(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS assignable_area_stddev FROM `FCLT_BUILDING` JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_HIST` ON FCLT_BUILDING.COST_CENTER_CODE = FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.COST_CENTER_CODE WHERE FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_NAME <> 'BROWN BUILDING' GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ORDER BY assignable_area_stddev DESC) SELECT icte.BUILDING_NAME, icte.assignable_area_stddev, brs.avg_area, brs.var_area, brs.total_rooms FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN (SELECT fbh.BUILDING_NAME, AVG(fr.AREA) AS avg_area, VARIANCE(fr.AREA) AS var_area, COUNT(fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS total_rooms FROM `FCLT_BUILDING_HIST` AS fbh JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS fr ON fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fbh.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' OR fbh.BUILDING_NUMBER = '32' GROUP BY fbh.BUILDING_NAME) AS brs ON icte.BUILDING_NAME = brs.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY icte.assignable_area_stddev DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS cso JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.num_unique_subjects, icte.min_total_units, mfall.avg_total_units, mfall.var_total_units, mspring.max_spring_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN (SELECT cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS cso WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cso.IS_VARIABLE_UNITS = 'N' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS mfall ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mfall.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN (SELECT cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_spring_enrollment FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS cso JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND cso.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND cso.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS mspring ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mspring.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_NAME, b.BUILDING_TYPE, COUNT(h.FCLT_BUILDING_HIST_KEY) AS hist_record_count, SUM(h.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_assignable_area FROM `FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS` AS a JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b ON a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_HIST` AS h ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = h.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE a.CITY = 'CAMBRIDGE' AND a.STATE = 'MA' AND b.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 1 AND NOT b.BUILDING_NAME IS NULL AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> 32 GROUP BY b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_NAME, b.BUILDING_TYPE) SELECT ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.BUILDING_TYPE, ic.hist_record_count, ic.total_assignable_area, AVG(h.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS avg_hist_num_of_rooms FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_HIST` AS h ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = h.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.BUILDING_TYPE, ic.hist_record_count, ic.total_assignable_area

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sp.MIT_ID, sp.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, SUM(sp.MIT_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR ORDER BY sp.MIT_ID) AS running_sum_mit_id FROM `SE_PERSON` AS sp JOIN `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` AS msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Student' AND msd.DEPARTMENT = 6 AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR, sp.MIT_ID), DepartmentUnitVariation AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0), DepartmentMaxUnits AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT icte.MIT_ID, icte.FULL_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.STUDENT_YEAR, icte.running_sum_mit_id, duv.coefficient_of_variation, dmu.max_total_units FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN DepartmentUnitVariation AS duv ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN DepartmentMaxUnits AS dmu ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.STUDENT_YEAR, icte.MIT_ID

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_CODE AS join_subject_code FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), math_dept_course_count AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses, 'Mathematics' AS join_department_name FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY num_courses DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.window_column, mdc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mdc.SCHOOL_NAME, mdc.num_courses, cso.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, cso.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN math_dept_course_count AS mdc JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS cso ON ic.SUBJECT_CODE = cso.SUBJECT_CODE AND ic.SUBJECT_NUMBER = cso.SUBJECT_NUMBER AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH LargestRoomPerFloor AS (SELECT sf.FLOOR_NAME, sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sd.FLOOR_KEY FROM `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd JOIN `SPACE_FLOOR` AS sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 100 AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE = (SELECT MAX(sd2.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) FROM `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd2 WHERE sd2.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd2.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY AND sd2.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24') ORDER BY sf.FLOOR_NAME), RoomAveragesPerFloor AS (SELECT sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sf.FLOOR_NAME, AVG(sd2.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS AVG_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE_PER_FLOOR, sd.FLOOR_KEY, sd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE FROM `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd JOIN `SPACE_FLOOR` AS sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY JOIN `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd2 ON sd2.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 10 AND sd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' GROUP BY sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sf.FLOOR_NAME, sd.FLOOR_KEY, sd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE ORDER BY sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) SELECT lrf.FLOOR_NAME, lrf.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME AS LARGEST_ROOM_NAME, lrf.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS LARGEST_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, raf.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, raf.ROOM_NUMBER, raf.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, raf.AVG_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE_PER_FLOOR, raf.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE FROM LargestRoomPerFloor AS lrf JOIN RoomAveragesPerFloor AS raf ON lrf.FLOOR_NAME = raf.FLOOR_NAME ORDER BY lrf.FLOOR_NAME, raf.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) SELECT * FROM inner_cte

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.avg_cip_program_code, dcs.range_cip_program_code, dcs.var_cip_program_code, ph.HGN_CODE, ph.max_lecture_units, ph.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS range_cip_program_code, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS var_cip_program_code FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME IS NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dcs JOIN (SELECT c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.SUBJECT_ID FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS s ON c.HGN_CODE = s.HGN_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND c.LECTURE_UNITS > 2 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.SUBJECT_ID HAVING MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) > 2) AS ph ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ph.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_cip_program_code, inner_cte.range_cip_program_code, inner_cte.var_cip_program_code, inner_cte.HGN_CODE, inner_cte.max_lecture_units, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS so ON so.SUBJECT_TITLE = inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.HGN_CODE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ccso.LECTURE_UNITS, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics'), MathDeptUnitStats AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` WHERE IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND NOT TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic.LECTURE_UNITS, CASE WHEN NOT ccs.JOINT_SUBJECTS IS NULL AND TRIM(ccs.JOINT_SUBJECTS) <> '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS IS_JOINT_SUBJECT, mds.total_units_range, mds.total_units_variance FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccs ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MathDeptUnitStats AS mds ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mds.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mds.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ic.SUBJECT_ID

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MathTermStats AS (SELECT s.TERM_CODE, MIN(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS s JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS a ON s.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND (a.ACADEMIC_YEAR BETWEEN 2000 AND 2020 OR s.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6) GROUP BY s.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s.TERM_CODE), ChemistrySubjectStats AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_num_enrolled_students FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `STUDENT_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND NOT t0.TERM_CODE IS NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N') SELECT css.SUBJECT_TITLE, css.TERM_CODE, css.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, css.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, css.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, css.SCHOOL_NAME, css.max_num_enrolled_students, mts.min_academic_year, mts.avg_total_units FROM ChemistrySubjectStats AS css JOIN MathTermStats AS mts ON css.TERM_CODE = mts.TERM_CODE) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.TERM_CODE, ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.max_num_enrolled_students, ic.min_academic_year, ic.avg_total_units, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.FIRST_DAY_OF_CLASSES FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON ic.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE ORDER BY ic.TERM_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS s JOIN `CIP` AS c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = 6 AND s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y') SELECT ic.COURSE, ic.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.PROGRAM_CODE, ic.PROGRAM_TITLE, ic.CATEGORY_CODE, ic.CATEGORY_TITLE, ic.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, ic.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, ic.min_warehouse_load_date FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY min_warehouse_load_date DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte) AS ic WHERE ic.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.CATEGORY_CODE LIMIT 10

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH LargestRoomPerFloor AS (SELECT sf.FLOOR_NAME, sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sd.FLOOR_KEY FROM `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd JOIN `SPACE_FLOOR` AS sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 100 AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE = (SELECT MAX(sd2.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) FROM `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd2 WHERE sd2.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd2.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY AND sd2.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24') ORDER BY sf.FLOOR_NAME), RoomAveragesPerFloor AS (SELECT sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sf.FLOOR_NAME, AVG(sd2.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS AVG_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE_PER_FLOOR, COUNT(sd2.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME) AS TOTAL_ROOMS_ON_FLOOR, sd.FLOOR_KEY FROM `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd JOIN `SPACE_FLOOR` AS sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY JOIN `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd2 ON sd2.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 10 GROUP BY sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sf.FLOOR_NAME, sd.FLOOR_KEY ORDER BY sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) SELECT lrf.FLOOR_NAME, lrf.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME AS LARGEST_ROOM_NAME, lrf.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS LARGEST_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, raf.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, raf.ROOM_NUMBER, raf.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, raf.AVG_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE_PER_FLOOR, raf.TOTAL_ROOMS_ON_FLOOR FROM LargestRoomPerFloor AS lrf JOIN RoomAveragesPerFloor AS raf ON lrf.FLOOR_NAME = raf.FLOOR_NAME ORDER BY lrf.FLOOR_NAME, raf.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) SELECT * FROM inner_cte

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scm.SUBJECT_CODE, scm.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scm.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS mathematics_department_name, scm.SCHOOL_NAME, scm.avg_dept_budget_code, ads.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS admin_department_name, ads.avg_clearing_cost_collector, ads.clearing_cost_collector_variance, ads.clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t0 JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS scm CROSS JOIN (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, VARIANCE(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, STDDEV(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev, MAX(a.LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE) AS most_recent_activity_date FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY clearing_cost_collector_variance DESC) AS ads) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.mathematics_department_name, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.avg_dept_budget_code, inner_cte.admin_department_name, inner_cte.avg_clearing_cost_collector, inner_cte.clearing_cost_collector_variance, inner_cte.clearing_cost_collector_stddev, ads2.most_recent_activity_date FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(a.LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE) AS most_recent_activity_date FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS ads2 ON inner_cte.admin_department_name = ads2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE AS LIBRARY_TERM_CODE, tso.TERM_CODE AS TIP_TERM_CODE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) AS MIN_TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS lso JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso ON lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE (lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = 928034000 OR tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5) AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')), dept_stats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_grad_subjects, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.LIBRARY_TERM_CODE, icte.TIP_TERM_CODE, icte.LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED, icte.TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, icte.MIN_TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.enrolled_range, ds.enrolled_variance, ds.num_grad_subjects FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN dept_stats AS ds ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date, s.DEPARTMENT FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS s JOIN `CIP` AS c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = 6 AND s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'), student_counts AS (SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` AS msd GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR), dept_stats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sc.num_students) AS avg_students_per_year, MAX(sc.num_students) - MIN(sc.num_students) AS range_students_per_year, VARIANCE(sc.num_students) AS var_students_per_year FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd JOIN student_counts AS sc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.COURSE, ic.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.PROGRAM_CODE, ic.PROGRAM_TITLE, ic.CATEGORY_CODE, ic.CATEGORY_TITLE, ic.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, ic.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, ic.min_warehouse_load_date, ds.avg_students_per_year, ds.range_students_per_year, ds.var_students_per_year, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_CODE FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN dept_stats AS ds ON ic.DEPARTMENT = ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ic.CATEGORY_CODE, ic.COURSE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS c JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL) SELECT tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS OFFERING_DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, icte.course_count, icte.min_total_units FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = ccc.SUBJECT_ID JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS c ON c.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND c.COURSE = tso.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN inner_cte AS icte ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.COURSE_LEVEL = c.COURSE_LEVEL WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ORDER BY tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC LIMIT 10

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH department_units_stats AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC), department_student_cip_stats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` AS msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, dscs.COURSE_LEVEL, dscs.student_count, dscs.min_cip_code FROM department_units_stats AS dus JOIN department_student_cip_stats AS dscs ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dscs.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_range, inner_cte.total_units_variance, inner_cte.COURSE_LEVEL, inner_cte.student_count, inner_cte.min_cip_code, stats.avg_lecture_units, stats.max_lab_units FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT scd.COURSE_LEVEL, AVG(ccc.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units, MAX(ccc.LAB_UNITS) AS max_lab_units FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON scd.DEPARTMENT = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.COURSE_LEVEL) AS stats ON inner_cte.COURSE_LEVEL = stats.COURSE_LEVEL
