WITH inner_cte AS (WITH OrgAreaStats AS (SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(fr.AREA) AS area_stddev, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` AS fr JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS fo ON fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING COUNT(fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 5), BuildingFloorStats AS (SELECT fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME, AVG(ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS avg_assignable_area, STDDEV(ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS stddev_assignable_area FROM `FCLT_BUILDING` AS fb JOIN `FCLT_FLOOR` AS ff ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> '39' GROUP BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(ff.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY) > 1) SELECT oas.ORGANIZATION_NAME, oas.area_stddev, bfs.BUILDING_NAME, bfs.avg_assignable_area, bfs.stddev_assignable_area, bfs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM OrgAreaStats AS oas JOIN BuildingFloorStats AS bfs ON oas.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bfs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.area_stddev, icte.BUILDING_NAME, icte.avg_assignable_area, icte.stddev_assignable_area, fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS most_recent_assignable_area FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN (SELECT fbh1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fbh1.ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM `FCLT_BUILDING_HIST` AS fbh1 WHERE (fbh1.FISCAL_PERIOD, fbh1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) IN (SELECT MAX(fbh2.FISCAL_PERIOD) AS max_period, fbh2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM `FCLT_BUILDING_HIST` AS fbh2 GROUP BY fbh2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY)) AS fbh ON icte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.BUILDING_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t0 JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME), Subquery2 AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS s JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT sq1.SUBJECT_CODE, sq1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, sq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sq1.SCHOOL_NAME, sq1.avg_dept_budget_code, sq2.SUBJECT_TITLE, sq2.TOTAL_UNITS, sq2.window_column FROM Subquery1 AS sq1 JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS sc ON sq1.SUBJECT_CODE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE AND sq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN Subquery2 AS sq2 ON sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sq2.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND sq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND sq1.SCHOOL_NAME = sq2.SCHOOL_NAME), school_avg_units AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.avg_dept_budget_code, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS, CASE WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS > s.avg_total_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_LOAD' WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS < s.avg_total_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_LOAD' ELSE 'AVERAGE_LOAD' END AS unit_load_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN school_avg_units AS s ON i.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS total_reserved_materials FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrm ON td.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') AND tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) > 20) SELECT ic.department_name, ic.total_reserved_materials, cs.SUBJECT_TITLE, cs.TERM_CODE, cs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cs.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, cs.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, cs.SCHOOL_NAME, cs.max_enrolled_students, ROUND(ic.total_reserved_materials / NULLIF(cs.max_enrolled_students, 0), 2) AS reserved_materials_per_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `STUDENT_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND NOT t0.TERM_CODE IS NULL AND t0.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N') AS cs ON ic.department_name = cs.join_dept_name ORDER BY reserved_materials_per_max_enrollment DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH Sub1 AS (SELECT t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DLC_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.FCLT_MAJOR_ORG_KEY = 230 AND t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'), Sub2 AS (SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number, MAX(o.ORGANIZATION_SORT) AS max_organization_sort FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND NOT d.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' AND NOT o.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.DLC_KEY, s1.window_column, s2.organization_count, s2.min_organization_number, ROUND(s2.organization_count / NULLIF(s2.min_organization_number, 0), 2) AS normalized_org_count, s2.max_organization_sort FROM Sub1 AS s1 JOIN Sub2 AS s2 ON s1.DLC_KEY = s2.DLC_KEY AND s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME = s2.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DLC_KEY, window_column, SUM(organization_count) AS total_organization_count, MIN(min_organization_number) AS min_organization_number, ROUND(SUM(organization_count) / NULLIF(MIN(min_organization_number), 0), 2) AS normalized_org_count, MAX(max_organization_sort) AS max_organization_sort FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DLC_KEY, window_column WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(organization_count) > 0 ORDER BY normalized_org_count DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptTotalEnrolled AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students, MAX(scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING) AS IS_DEGREE_GRANTING FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND (scd.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') OR scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING total_enrolled_students > 20), DeptMaxEnrolled2019 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE AS MAX_ENROLLED_COURSE_TITLE, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd JOIN `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS lso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND ((sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') OR (lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry')) AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = (SELECT MAX(lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS lso2 WHERE lso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND lso2.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5) ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT dte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dte.total_enrolled_students, dte.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, dme.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, dme.MAX_ENROLLED_COURSE_TITLE, dme.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM DeptTotalEnrolled AS dte JOIN DeptMaxEnrolled2019 AS dme ON dte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_enrolled_students, inner_cte.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, inner_cte.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLED_COURSE_TITLE, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.total_enrolled_students DESC, inner_cte.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC LIMIT 10

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH course_desc_stats AS (SELECT scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION) AS course_description_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_program_code FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), top_math_courses AS (SELECT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS offer_count FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY offer_count DESC LIMIT 3) SELECT tmc.COURSE_NUMBER, tmc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, tmc.SUBJECT_TITLE, tmc.offer_count, cds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cds.course_description_count, cds.min_cip_program_code, scd.FROM_TERM, scd.FROM_TERM_DESCRIPTION, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM top_math_courses AS tmc JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd ON tmc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION = scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION JOIN course_desc_stats AS cds ON scd.COURSE = cds.COURSE AND cds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY tmc.COURSE_NUMBER, tmc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, tmc.SUBJECT_TITLE, tmc.offer_count, cds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cds.course_description_count, cds.min_cip_program_code, scd.FROM_TERM, scd.FROM_TERM_DESCRIPTION, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER ORDER BY tmc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.FROM_TERM) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(COURSE_NUMBER) OVER (ORDER BY COURSE_NUMBER, FROM_TERM) = COURSE_NUMBER THEN NULL ELSE COURSE_NUMBER END AS COURSE_NUMBER, COURSE_DESCRIPTION, SUBJECT_TITLE, offer_count, DEPARTMENT_NAME, course_description_count, min_cip_program_code, FROM_TERM, FROM_TERM_DESCRIPTION, SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte ORDER BY COURSE_NUMBER, FROM_TERM

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.coefficient_of_variation, c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS SUBJECT_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ed.FULL_NAME AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_FULL_NAME, mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER, AVG(ed.OFFICE_PHONE) OVER (PARTITION BY ed.LAST_NAME ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS AVG_OFFICE_PHONE_WINDOW, ed.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_EMAIL FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY` AS ed ON c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = ed.MIT_ID LEFT JOIN `MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL` AS mld ON ed.MIT_ID = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = 18 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.SUBJECT_CODE

WITH DeptUnitsStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_variance DESC), PoliSciHGNStats AS (SELECT c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, s.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS s ON c.HGN_CODE = s.HGN_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND c.LECTURE_UNITS > 2 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE HAVING MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) > 2), DeptSubjectTotals AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME), CombinedStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_units, d.units_variance, NULL AS HGN_CODE, NULL AS max_lecture_units, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS total_subjects, 'DeptUnitsStats' AS Source FROM DeptUnitsStats AS d UNION ALL SELECT p.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_units, NULL AS units_variance, p.HGN_CODE, p.max_lecture_units, p.SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS total_subjects, 'PoliSciHGNStats' AS Source FROM PoliSciHGNStats AS p UNION ALL SELECT t.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_units, NULL AS units_variance, NULL AS HGN_CODE, NULL AS max_lecture_units, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, t.total_subjects, 'DeptSubjectTotals' AS Source FROM DeptSubjectTotals AS t) SELECT * FROM CombinedStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Source

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.units_range, inner_cte.units_variance, c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS SUBJECT_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ed.FULL_NAME AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_FULL_NAME, mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER, AVG(ed.OFFICE_PHONE) OVER (PARTITION BY ed.LAST_NAME ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS AVG_OFFICE_PHONE_WINDOW, ed.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_EMAIL FROM inner_cte JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN `EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY` AS ed ON c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = ed.MIT_ID LEFT JOIN `MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL` AS mld ON ed.MIT_ID = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = 18 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, t2.BUILDING_NUMBER, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ASSIGNABLE_AREA ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM `FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_FLOOR` AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS t2 ON t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t2.BUILDING_NUMBER = 'W85' AND t2.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT'), FloorCounts AS (SELECT BUILDING_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT FCLT_FLOOR_KEY) AS total_floors FROM inner_cte GROUP BY BUILDING_NUMBER) SELECT i.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, i.BUILDING_NUMBER, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, f.BUILDING_NUMBER, f.total_floors AS window_column FROM FloorCounts AS f ORDER BY BUILDING_NUMBER, FCLT_FLOOR_KEY

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2008 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.total_units_range, icte.total_units_variance, mso.SUBJECT_TITLE, mso.max_total_units, co.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN (SELECT cso.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, cso.SUBJECT_ID FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS cso JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON cso.SUBJECT_ID = ccc.SUBJECT_ID WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, cso.SUBJECT_ID HAVING MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6) AS mso ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mso.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS co ON mso.SUBJECT_ID = co.SUBJECT_ID AND co.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND co.SUBJECT_TITLE = mso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mso.SUBJECT_TITLE, co.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH OrgStats AS (SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND NOT d.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' AND NOT o.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME), BuildingRoomStats AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10 ORDER BY area_range DESC) SELECT os.DLC_KEY, os.ORGANIZATION_NAME, os.organization_count, os.min_organization_number, brs.BUILDING_NAME, brs.area_range, brs.area_variance, brs.area_stddev, b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM OrgStats AS os JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON os.ORGANIZATION_NAME = o.ORGANIZATION_NAME JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN BuildingRoomStats AS brs ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = brs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b ON brs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) SELECT * FROM inner_cte

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH org_area_stddev AS (SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(fr.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` AS fr JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS fo ON fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 5), building_floor_stats AS (SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, AVG(ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS avg_assignable_area, STDDEV(ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS stddev_assignable_area, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM `FCLT_BUILDING` AS fb JOIN `FCLT_FLOOR` AS ff ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> '39' GROUP BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(ff.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY) > 1) SELECT bfs.BUILDING_NAME, bfs.avg_assignable_area, bfs.stddev_assignable_area, oas.ORGANIZATION_NAME, oas.area_stddev, bfs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM building_floor_stats AS bfs LEFT JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS fr ON bfs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY LEFT JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS fo ON fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY LEFT JOIN org_area_stddev AS oas ON fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME = oas.ORGANIZATION_NAME WHERE NOT oas.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY bfs.BUILDING_NAME, bfs.avg_assignable_area, bfs.stddev_assignable_area, oas.ORGANIZATION_NAME, oas.area_stddev, bfs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.avg_assignable_area, ic.stddev_assignable_area, ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.area_stddev, (fb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA - COALESCE(hb.avg_hist_assignable_area, 0)) AS deviation_from_hist_avg FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS fb ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY LEFT JOIN (SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS avg_hist_assignable_area FROM `FCLT_BUILDING_HIST` GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) AS hb ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = hb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.LECTURE_UNITS, t0.LAB_UNITS, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.GRADE_TYPE, t0.GRADE_RULE, MIN(t0.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_by_dept FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE), geom_mean_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC), desc_rank_cte AS (SELECT ic.SUBJECT_CODE, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS desc_count, @rank := CASE WHEN @current_code = ic.SUBJECT_CODE THEN @rank + 1 ELSE 1 END AS `Rank`, @current_code := ic.SUBJECT_CODE FROM (SELECT @rank := 0, @current_code := '') AS vars, inner_cte AS ic JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd ON ic.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE GROUP BY ic.SUBJECT_CODE, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY ic.SUBJECT_CODE, desc_count DESC) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ic.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, ic.TOTAL_UNITS, ic.min_total_units_by_dept, gmc.geometric_mean_total_units, drc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS Most_Common_Description, drc.desc_count AS Description_Count FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN geom_mean_cte AS gmc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = gmc.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN desc_rank_cte AS drc ON ic.SUBJECT_CODE = drc.SUBJECT_CODE AND drc.`Rank` = 1 ORDER BY ic.TOTAL_UNITS DESC LIMIT 10

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.units_range, icte.units_variance, c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ed.FULL_NAME AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_FULL_NAME, mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER, AVG(ed.OFFICE_PHONE) OVER (PARTITION BY ed.LAST_NAME ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS AVG_OFFICE_PHONE_WINDOW, ed.EMAIL_ADDRESS FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN `EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY` AS ed ON c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = ed.MIT_ID LEFT JOIN `MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL` AS mld ON ed.MIT_ID = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = 18 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ccso.LECTURE_UNITS, ccso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics'), subq2 AS (SELECT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` INNER JOIN `EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY` ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY.MIT_ID INNER JOIN `MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL` ON EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY.MIT_ID = MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, icte.LECTURE_UNITS, icte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s2.avg_total_units, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH largest_room_per_floor AS (SELECT sf.FLOOR_NAME, sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sd.FLOOR_KEY FROM `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd JOIN `SPACE_FLOOR` AS sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 100 AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE = (SELECT MAX(sd2.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) FROM `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd2 WHERE sd2.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd2.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY AND sd2.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24') ORDER BY sf.FLOOR_NAME), room_and_avg_per_floor AS (SELECT sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sf.FLOOR_NAME, AVG(sd2.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS AVG_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE_PER_FLOOR, sd.FLOOR_KEY FROM `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd JOIN `SPACE_FLOOR` AS sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY JOIN `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd2 ON sd2.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 10 GROUP BY sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sf.FLOOR_NAME, sd.FLOOR_KEY ORDER BY sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) SELECT lrf.FLOOR_NAME, lrf.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME AS LARGEST_ROOM_NAME, lrf.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS LARGEST_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, raf.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, raf.ROOM_NUMBER, raf.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, raf.AVG_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE_PER_FLOOR, sf.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE AS FLOOR_WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE FROM largest_room_per_floor AS lrf JOIN room_and_avg_per_floor AS raf ON lrf.FLOOR_NAME = raf.FLOOR_NAME JOIN `SPACE_FLOOR` AS sf ON lrf.FLOOR_NAME = sf.FLOOR_NAME ORDER BY lrf.FLOOR_NAME, raf.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) SELECT * FROM inner_cte

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.DLC_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS assignable_organization_count FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND o.DLC_NAME LIKE '%Office%' AND LOWER(o.DLC_NAME) <> LOWER('Biology') GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.DLC_NAME), Dept_Max_Org_Space AS (SELECT mdh.DLC_KEY, mdh.DLC_NAME AS department, MAX(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS max_organization_number, su.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name FROM `MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY` AS mdh JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS fo ON mdh.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY LEFT JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY WHERE mdh.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER > 50000 AND mdh.DLC_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY mdh.DLC_KEY, mdh.DLC_NAME, su.SPACE_UNIT), Org_Earliest_Load AS (SELECT o.DLC_KEY, MIN(o.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS earliest_warehouse_load_date FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o GROUP BY o.DLC_KEY) SELECT ic.DLC_KEY, ic.DLC_NAME, ic.organization_count, ic.assignable_organization_count, dmos.department, dmos.max_organization_number, dmos.space_unit_name, oel.earliest_warehouse_load_date FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN Dept_Max_Org_Space AS dmos ON ic.DLC_KEY = dmos.DLC_KEY LEFT JOIN Org_Earliest_Load AS oel ON ic.DLC_KEY = oel.DLC_KEY

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH OrgStats AS (SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND NOT d.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' AND NOT o.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME), BuildingRoomStats AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10) SELECT os.DLC_KEY, os.ORGANIZATION_NAME, os.organization_count, os.min_organization_number, brs.BUILDING_NAME, brs.area_range, brs.area_variance, brs.area_stddev, b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM OrgStats AS os JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON os.ORGANIZATION_NAME = o.ORGANIZATION_NAME JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN BuildingRoomStats AS brs ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = brs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b ON brs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) SELECT inner_cte.DLC_KEY, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.organization_count, inner_cte.min_organization_number, inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME, inner_cte.area_range, inner_cte.area_variance, inner_cte.area_stddev, inner_cte.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, CASE WHEN inner_cte.ASSIGNABLE_AREA >= 100000 THEN 'LARGE' WHEN inner_cte.ASSIGNABLE_AREA >= 50000 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS building_size_category FROM inner_cte

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS activity_count, MIN(t.START_DATE) AS earliest_start_date FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `TIME_DAY` AS t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE) SELECT c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, c.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, c.activity_count, c.earliest_start_date, MAX(t.END_DATE) AS latest_end_date FROM inner_cte AS c JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY AND c.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE JOIN `TIME_DAY` AS t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE GROUP BY c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, c.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, c.activity_count, c.earliest_start_date

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS min_org_unit_id FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS f JOIN `MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY` AS m ON f.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' GROUP BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(dept_long) OVER (ORDER BY dept_long_sort, hier3_sort) = dept_long THEN NULL ELSE dept_long END AS department_long_name, hier3_name, org_count, min_org_unit_id, max_load_date FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) = 1 AND GROUPING(MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG END AS dept_long_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) = 0 AND GROUPING(MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) = 1 AND GROUPING(MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG END AS dept_long, CASE WHEN GROUPING(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) = 0 AND GROUPING(MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME END AS hier3_sort, MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME AS hier3_name, COUNT(DISTINCT FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS min_org_unit_id, MAX(h.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS max_load_date FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS f JOIN `MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY` AS m ON f.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY dept_long_sort, hier3_sort

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.MIT_ID, t0.COURSE_NAME FROM `LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR` AS t0 JOIN `SE_PERSON` AS t1 ON t0.INSTRUCTOR_NAME = t1.FULL_NAME WHERE t0.DEPARTMENT = '18 - Mathematics' AND t0.UNIT = 'Hayden') SELECT icte.MIT_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT icte.COURSE_NAME) AS Num_Courses_Taught, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT icte.COURSE_NAME) DESC) AS Instructor_Rank FROM inner_cte AS icte GROUP BY icte.MIT_ID ORDER BY Num_Courses_Taught DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, sos.SUBJECT_ID FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS lso JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.window_column, sos.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC, sos.HGN_CODE_DESC FROM inner_cte JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2014FA'

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.BUILDING_ROOM, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, su.SPACE_UNIT, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY sd.BUILDING_ROOM) AS window_column FROM `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY WHERE sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE = 150) SELECT ic.BUILDING_ROOM, ic.ROOM_NUMBER, ic.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ic.SPACE_UNIT, cnt.ROOM_COUNT FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT SPACE_UNIT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS ROOM_COUNT FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2) AS cnt ON ic.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = cnt.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY ic.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ic.BUILDING_ROOM

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.CALENDAR_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS t0 JOIN `TIME_DAY` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N') SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.CALENDAR_DATE, t1.FISCAL_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN `TIME_DAY` AS t1 ON inner_cte.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.CALENDAR_DATE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.FISCAL_YEAR, t0.FY_QUARTER_CODE, t0.QUARTER_START_DATE, t0.CALENDAR_YEAR, t1.CALENDAR_PERIOD_DESCRIPTION, t1.CALENDAR_MONTH_NAME, t1.CALENDAR_MONTH, AVG(t1.CALENDAR_MONTH) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FISCAL_PERIOD ORDER BY t0.FISCAL_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_avg FROM `TIME_QUARTER` AS t0 JOIN `TIME_MONTH` AS t1 ON t0.FISCAL_YEAR = t1.FISCAL_YEAR WHERE t0.FISCAL_YEAR = 2026) SELECT inner_cte.FISCAL_YEAR, inner_cte.FY_QUARTER_CODE, inner_cte.QUARTER_START_DATE, inner_cte.CALENDAR_YEAR, inner_cte.CALENDAR_PERIOD_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.CALENDAR_MONTH_NAME, inner_cte.window_avg, CASE WHEN inner_cte.CALENDAR_MONTH > inner_cte.window_avg THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN inner_cte.CALENDAR_MONTH < inner_cte.window_avg THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AT_AVERAGE' END AS month_vs_window FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.FISCAL_YEAR

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.BUILDING_ROOM, sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, su.SPACE_USAGE, COUNT(DISTINCT sd.FLOOR_KEY) AS floor_count, SUM(sd.ROOM_COUNTER) AS total_room_counter FROM `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd JOIN `SPACE_USAGE` AS su ON sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = su.SPACE_USAGE_KEY WHERE sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 100 GROUP BY sd.BUILDING_ROOM, sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, su.SPACE_USAGE) SELECT BUILDING_ROOM, BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, SPACE_USAGE, floor_count, total_room_counter FROM inner_cte WHERE total_room_counter > (SELECT AVG(total_room_counter) FROM (SELECT SUM(sd.ROOM_COUNTER) AS total_room_counter FROM `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd WHERE sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 100 GROUP BY sd.BUILDING_ROOM, sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY) AS sub)

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5) SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS highest_hr_org_unit_id FROM inner_cte GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(ccc.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2007' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' GROUP BY scd.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, inner_cte.COURSE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.total_units, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL FROM inner_cte JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd ON inner_cte.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY = scd.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT, inner_cte.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, inner_cte.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, inner_cte.window_column, ActivityCounts.Total_Activities FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS Total_Activities FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE) AS ActivityCounts ON inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = ActivityCounts.ENROLLMENT_TYPE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, t2.LECTURE_UNITS FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS t0 JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.SCHOOL_CODE = 'E') SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_DESCRIPTION, (TOTAL_UNITS - LECTURE_UNITS) AS units_minus_lecture FROM inner_cte

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SPONSOR_TYPE, s.SPONSOR_NAME, VARIANCE(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR` AS s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND NOT d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL GROUP BY s.SPONSOR_TYPE, s.SPONSOR_NAME) SELECT SPONSOR_TYPE, SPONSOR_NAME, max_enrollment_variance FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT SPONSOR_TYPE, NULL AS SPONSOR_NAME, VARIANCE(max_enrollment_variance) AS max_enrollment_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SPONSOR_TYPE ORDER BY SPONSOR_TYPE, SPONSOR_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.FLOOR, t0.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.OFFICE_LOCATION, t1.FULL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t0.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER ORDER BY t0.FLOOR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` AS t0 JOIN `EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY` AS t1 ON t0.BUILDING_ROOM = t1.OFFICE_LOCATION WHERE t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = 'E38') SELECT BUILDING_ROOM, FLOOR, MAJOR_USE_DESC, ORGANIZATION_NAME, OFFICE_LOCATION, FULL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > 100

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.DLC_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DLC_KEY ORDER BY t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 402100) SELECT inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.DLC_NAME, inner_cte.DLC_KEY, inner_cte.window_column, DLC_Count.Total_Space_Units FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT t0.DLC_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS Total_Space_Units FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 402100 GROUP BY t0.DLC_KEY) AS DLC_Count ON inner_cte.DLC_KEY = DLC_Count.DLC_KEY

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_NAME, t1.BUILDING_NUMBER, t0.CITY, t0.STATE, t1.BUILDING_USE, t1.NUM_OF_ROOMS FROM `FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t0.CITY = 'CAMBRIDGE') SELECT BUILDING_USE, BUILDING_NAME, BUILDING_NUMBER, CITY, STATE, AVG(NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS avg_num_of_rooms FROM inner_cte GROUP BY BUILDING_USE, BUILDING_NAME, BUILDING_NUMBER, CITY, STATE WITH ROLLUP HAVING NOT BUILDING_USE IS NULL ORDER BY BUILDING_USE, BUILDING_NAME, BUILDING_NUMBER

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.subject_count, icte.total_enrollment, s.COURSE_NUMBER AS SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS s ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s.COURSE_NUMBER

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, COUNT(*) AS total_active_grad_students FROM `SE_PERSON` AS s JOIN `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` AS m ON s.FULL_NAME = m.FULL_NAME WHERE s.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND m.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND NOT m.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NULL GROUP BY m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE HAVING COUNT(*) > 0) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(total_active_grad_students) AS highest_active_grad_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT AS department_name, AVG(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS avg_supervisees, MAX(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) - MIN(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS supervisee_range, VARIANCE(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS supervisee_variance FROM `SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE` JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` ON SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.DEPT_NAMES = SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT) SELECT inner_cte.department_name, inner_cte.avg_supervisees, inner_cte.supervisee_range, inner_cte.supervisee_variance, SUM(SSU.SQFT) AS total_sqft, SUM(SSU.RESEARCH_VOLUME) AS total_research_volume FROM inner_cte JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS SU ON inner_cte.department_name = SU.SPACE_UNIT JOIN `SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE` AS SSU ON SU.DLC_KEY = SSU.DEPT_NAMES GROUP BY inner_cte.department_name, inner_cte.avg_supervisees, inner_cte.supervisee_range, inner_cte.supervisee_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.supervisee_range DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SPONSOR_NAME, s.SPONSOR_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR` AS s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY WHERE NOT d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL) SELECT SPONSOR_NAME, SPONSOR_TYPE, AVG(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, VARIANCE(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS var_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SPONSOR_NAME, SPONSOR_TYPE ORDER BY var_max_enrollment DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE) AS min_level3_code FROM `MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY` AS m JOIN `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT ic.DLC_NAME, ic.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, ic.org_count, ic.min_level3_code, MAX(m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) AS max_level3_name FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY` AS m ON ic.DLC_NAME = m.DLC_NAME GROUP BY ic.DLC_NAME, ic.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, ic.org_count, ic.min_level3_code

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.BUILDING_NAME, t1.BUILDING_NAME AS HIST_BUILDING_NAME, t0.BUILDING_TYPE, t1.BUILDING_TYPE AS HIST_BUILDING_TYPE, t0.BUILDING_HEIGHT FROM `FCLT_BUILDING` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_HIST` AS t1 ON t0.COST_CENTER_CODE = t1.COST_CENTER_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 50) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(BUILDING_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY BUILDING_HEIGHT) = BUILDING_NAME THEN NULL ELSE BUILDING_NAME END AS BUILDING_NAME, HIST_BUILDING_NAME, BUILDING_TYPE, HIST_BUILDING_TYPE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY BUILDING_HEIGHT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY BUILDING_HEIGHT

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE` AS t1 ON t0.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = t1.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = 'HE'), DepartmentTotals AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS total_subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM, NULL AS total_subjects FROM inner_cte AS ic UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, dt.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM, dt.total_subjects FROM DepartmentTotals AS dt ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS s JOIN `CIP` AS c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = 6) SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE min_warehouse_load_date > '01-JAN-20' ORDER BY CATEGORY_CODE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserve_count FROM `LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS` AS lms JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY WHERE lrmd.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS) SELECT inner_cte.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, inner_cte.reserve_count, avg_stats.avg_count, CASE WHEN inner_cte.reserve_count > avg_stats.avg_count * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN inner_cte.reserve_count < avg_stats.avg_count * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS status_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(reserve_count) AS avg_count FROM inner_cte) AS avg_stats ORDER BY inner_cte.reserve_count DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.DEPT_COUNT, t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, t2.RESEARCH_VOLUME FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN `SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE` AS t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DEPT_NAMES WHERE t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500) SELECT space_unit_name, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ORGANIZATION_NAME, DEPT_COUNT, NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, MAX(RESEARCH_VOLUME) AS highest_research_volume FROM inner_cte GROUP BY space_unit_name, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ORGANIZATION_NAME, DEPT_COUNT, NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE NOT d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL) SELECT ic.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, AVG(ic.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, VARIANCE(ic.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS var_max_enrollment, COUNT(*) AS activity_count FROM inner_cte AS ic GROUP BY ic.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY var_max_enrollment DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, d.TERM_CODE, COUNT(d.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserve_material_count, MIN(c.RECORD_COUNTER) AS min_record_counter FROM `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG` AS c ON d.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = c.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY WHERE c.CATALOG_YEAR > 2000 GROUP BY d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, d.TERM_CODE) SELECT LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TERM_CODE, reserve_material_count, min_record_counter FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, NULL AS TERM_CODE, SUM(reserve_material_count) AS reserve_material_count, MIN(min_record_counter) AS min_record_counter FROM inner_cte GROUP BY LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TERM_CODE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT l.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, l.TERM_CODE, l.SUBJECT_ID, t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t.ISBN, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MIN(t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) OVER (ORDER BY s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS l JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') SELECT inner_cte.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, inner_cte.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, inner_cte.ISBN, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.window_column, ReserveCounts.Total_Reserve_Materials FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(*) AS Total_Reserve_Materials FROM `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` WHERE LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY SUBJECT_ID) AS ReserveCounts ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = ReserveCounts.SUBJECT_ID

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT l.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, l.TERM_CODE, l.SUBJECT_ID, t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t.ISBN, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, MIN(t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) OVER (ORDER BY s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS l JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') SELECT LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, TERM_CODE, SUBJECT_ID, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ISBN, SUBJECT_TITLE, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > (SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED`)

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(tm.CALENDAR_MONTH) AS min_calendar_month, SUM(tm.CALENDAR_YEAR) AS total_calendar_years, tm.FISCAL_YEAR FROM `TIME_MONTH` AS tm JOIN `TIME_DAY` AS td ON tm.FISCAL_PERIOD = td.FISCAL_PERIOD WHERE td.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE = '2020FA' GROUP BY tm.FISCAL_YEAR) SELECT inner_cte.FISCAL_YEAR, inner_cte.min_calendar_month, inner_cte.total_calendar_years FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.FISCAL_YEAR

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.PERSON_ROLE, AVG(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, MAX(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) - MIN(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_range, VARIANCE(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON` AS p JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d ON p.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND NOT d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL GROUP BY p.PERSON_ROLE) SELECT cte.PERSON_ROLE, cte.avg_max_enrollment, cte.max_enrollment_range, cte.max_enrollment_variance, CASE WHEN cte.avg_max_enrollment > overall.avg_enrollment * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_CAPACITY' WHEN cte.avg_max_enrollment < overall.avg_enrollment * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_CAPACITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS capacity_category FROM inner_cte AS cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_enrollment FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND NOT d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL) AS overall ORDER BY cte.max_enrollment_range DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SPONSOR_NAME, AVG(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, VARIANCE(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS var_max_enrollment FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR` AS s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY WHERE NOT d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL GROUP BY s.SPONSOR_NAME) SELECT SPONSOR_NAME, avg_max_enrollment, var_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_max_enrollment > (SELECT AVG(MAX_ENROLLMENT) FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` WHERE NOT MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL) ORDER BY var_max_enrollment DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.BUILDING_COMPONENT, t1.FLOOR, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD` AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1) SELECT SPACE_USAGE, MAX(FLOOR) AS highest_floor FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SPACE_USAGE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.PERSON_ROLE, d.TERM_CODE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON` AS p JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d ON p.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND NOT d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(PERSON_ROLE) OVER (ORDER BY person_role_sort, term_sort) = PERSON_ROLE THEN NULL ELSE PERSON_ROLE END AS person_role, term, avg_max_enrollment, max_enrollment_range, max_enrollment_variance FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(PERSON_ROLE) = 1 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE PERSON_ROLE END AS person_role_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(PERSON_ROLE) = 0 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(PERSON_ROLE) = 1 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(PERSON_ROLE) = 0 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, PERSON_ROLE, TERM_CODE, AVG(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, MAX(MAX_ENROLLMENT) - MIN(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_range, VARIANCE(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY PERSON_ROLE, TERM_CODE WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY person_role_sort, term_sort

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, lrmd.TERM_CODE, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserve_count FROM `LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS` AS lms JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY GROUP BY lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, lrmd.TERM_CODE) SELECT LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, TERM_CODE, SUM(reserve_count) AS reserve_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, TERM_CODE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(reserve_count) > 0 ORDER BY LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, TERM_CODE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(sp.MIT_ID) AS person_count, MIN(sp.MIT_ID) AS min_mit_id FROM `SE_PERSON` AS sp JOIN `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` AS msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.person_count, inner_cte.min_mit_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT sp.OFFICE_LOCATION SEPARATOR ',') AS unique_office_locations FROM inner_cte JOIN `SE_PERSON` AS sp ON sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = inner_cte.EMPLOYEE_TYPE JOIN `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` AS msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY inner_cte.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.person_count, inner_cte.min_mit_id

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, AVG(c.RECORD_COUNTER) AS avg_record_counter, VARIANCE(c.RECORD_COUNTER) AS record_counter_variance FROM `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG` AS c ON d.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = c.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY WHERE c.CATALOG_YEAR > 2000 GROUP BY d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY), avg_var AS (SELECT AVG(record_counter_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, i.avg_record_counter, i.record_counter_variance, CASE WHEN i.record_counter_variance > a.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN i.record_counter_variance < a.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_var AS a ORDER BY i.record_counter_variance DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, AVG(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, VARIANCE(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS var_max_enrollment FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE NOT d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) SELECT i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, i.avg_max_enrollment, i.var_max_enrollment, (i.avg_max_enrollment - i.var_max_enrollment) AS avg_minus_var FROM inner_cte AS i ORDER BY avg_minus_var DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, t0.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, t0.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS t0 JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND t0.TERM_CODE = '2009SP') SELECT inner_cte.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, inner_cte.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, inner_cte.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM inner_cte

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_subjects FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS so JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso ON so.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = tso.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2011FA' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5) SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_subjects_with_more_than_10_enrolled FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS so JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso ON so.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = tso.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2011FA' AND so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT, t1.SPACE_USAGE, MIN(t0.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) OVER (ORDER BY t0.BUILDING_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE AS space_detail_load_date, t1.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE AS space_usage_load_date FROM `SPACE_DETAIL` AS t0 JOIN `SPACE_USAGE` AS t1 ON t0.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = t1.SPACE_USAGE_KEY WHERE t0.ROOM_NUMBER = '21E') SELECT * FROM inner_cte

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_ID, t0.CREATE_DATE FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12) SELECT ACTIVITY_TITLE, ENROLLMENT_TYPE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUBJECT_ID, MIN(CREATE_DATE) AS earliest_create_date FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACTIVITY_TITLE, ENROLLMENT_TYPE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUBJECT_ID

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.PERSON_ROLE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON` AS p JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d ON p.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND NOT d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL) SELECT i.PERSON_ROLE, AVG(i.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, MAX(i.MAX_ENROLLMENT) - MIN(i.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_range, VARIANCE(i.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance, COUNT(*) AS total_activities FROM inner_cte AS i GROUP BY i.PERSON_ROLE ORDER BY max_enrollment_range DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name, t1.DLC_NAME AS dlc_name, t1.DLC_KEY AS org_dlc_key, MIN(t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_min_space_unit_code FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500) SELECT inner_cte.space_unit_name, inner_cte.organization_name, inner_cte.dlc_name, inner_cte.org_dlc_key, inner_cte.window_min_space_unit_code, org_unit_counts.total_space_units FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS total_space_units FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY GROUP BY t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS org_unit_counts ON inner_cte.organization_name = org_unit_counts.ORGANIZATION_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SPONSOR_TYPE, s.SPONSOR_NAME, s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, VARIANCE(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR` AS s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND NOT d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL GROUP BY s.SPONSOR_TYPE, s.SPONSOR_NAME, s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY) SELECT i.SPONSOR_TYPE, i.SPONSOR_NAME, i.max_enrollment_variance FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT SPONSOR_TYPE FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR` GROUP BY SPONSOR_TYPE) AS t ON i.SPONSOR_TYPE = t.SPONSOR_TYPE ORDER BY i.max_enrollment_variance DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.PERSON_ROLE, VARIANCE(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance, STDDEV(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_stddev FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON` AS p JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d ON p.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY WHERE NOT d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL GROUP BY p.PERSON_ROLE), avg_var AS (SELECT AVG(max_enrollment_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.PERSON_ROLE, i.max_enrollment_variance, i.max_enrollment_stddev, CASE WHEN i.max_enrollment_variance > a.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN i.max_enrollment_variance < a.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_var AS a ORDER BY i.max_enrollment_variance DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) AS window_column FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY) SELECT IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, MAX(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS highest_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY IAP_CATEGORY_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TERM_START_DATE, t2.CALENDAR_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY t1.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `TIME_DAY` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE t1.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.CALENDAR_DATE, t2.DAY_OF_WEEK, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN `TIME_DAY` AS t2 ON inner_cte.CALENDAR_DATE = t2.CALENDAR_DATE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS activity_count, SUM(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS total_max_enrollment FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' GROUP BY c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME HAVING COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) >= 5) SELECT inner_cte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, inner_cte.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, inner_cte.activity_count, inner_cte.total_max_enrollment, c.IAP_CATEGORY_DESC FROM inner_cte JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c ON inner_cte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, lrmd.TERM_CODE, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM `LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR` AS lci JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT, lrmd.TERM_CODE) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, term, dept_sort) = term THEN NULL ELSE term END AS term, dept, catalog_key_variance FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT AS dept, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM (SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, lrmd.TERM_CODE, lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY FROM `LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR` AS lci JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') AS base GROUP BY TERM_CODE, DEPARTMENT WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS min_square_footage, SUM(sd.ROOM_COUNTER) AS total_rooms, sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT FROM `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd JOIN `SPACE_USAGE` AS su ON sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = su.SPACE_USAGE_KEY WHERE su.SPACE_USAGE = 'RESEARCH CENTER' GROUP BY sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT) SELECT ic.BUILDING_COMPONENT, ic.min_square_footage, ic.total_rooms FROM inner_cte AS ic

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t0.PREREQUISITES, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, MIN(t1.TERM_START_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.TERM_CODE ORDER BY t0.TERM_CODE) AS window_column FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.PREREQUISITES, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.TERM_END_DATE, inner_cte.window_column, term_counts.total_activities FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, COUNT(*) AS total_activities FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS t0 WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30 GROUP BY t0.TERM_CODE) AS term_counts ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = term_counts.TERM_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.TERM_CODE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS activity_count, SUM(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS total_max_enrollment FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' GROUP BY c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME HAVING COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) >= 5), avg_enrollment AS (SELECT AVG(total_max_enrollment) AS avg_total_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, i.activity_count, i.total_max_enrollment, CASE WHEN i.total_max_enrollment > a.avg_total_max_enrollment * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_CAPACITY' WHEN i.total_max_enrollment < a.avg_total_max_enrollment * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_CAPACITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS capacity_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_enrollment AS a

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1) SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.window_column, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t2 ON icte.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ORDER BY icte.window_column DESC LIMIT 10

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lrmd.SUBJECT_ID, MIN(lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS min_material_status, SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_records FROM `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS td ON lrmd.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY lrmd.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.min_material_status, inner_cte.total_records, MAX(lrmd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS latest_library_warehouse_date, MAX(td.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS latest_tip_warehouse_date FROM inner_cte JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS td ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.min_material_status, inner_cte.total_records ORDER BY inner_cte.total_records DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.RESEARCH_VOLUME, t0.DEPT_NAMES, t0.SQFT, t0.MIT_ID, AVG(t0.SQFT) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t0.RESEARCH_VOLUME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE` AS t0 JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.DEPT_NAMES = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES = 2) SELECT RESEARCH_VOLUME, DEPT_NAMES, SQFT, MIT_ID, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > 200

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY, d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME, o.OWNER_TYPE, d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, o.OWNER, d.LAST_UPDATE_DATE FROM `MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `MOIRA_LIST_OWNER` AS o ON d.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = o.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY WHERE d.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = '18-DEC-24'), avg_mit_id AS (SELECT OWNER_TYPE, AVG(MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID) AS avg_mit_id FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OWNER_TYPE) SELECT i.MOIRA_LIST_KEY, i.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME, i.OWNER_TYPE, i.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, i.OWNER, i.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, CASE WHEN i.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID > a.avg_mit_id THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID < a.avg_mit_id THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS mit_id_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_mit_id AS a ON i.OWNER_TYPE = a.OWNER_TYPE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT td.TERM_CODE, td.SUBJECT_ID, MIN(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS min_record_count, SUM(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS total_new_shelf_price FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS td JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL` AS tm ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE NOT tm.AUTHOR IS NULL AND tm.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE = 'ISBN' GROUP BY td.TERM_CODE, td.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.min_record_count, inner_cte.total_new_shelf_price FROM inner_cte

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY) SELECT i.ACTIVITY_TITLE, i.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, i.MAX_ENROLLMENT, i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, c.IAP_CATEGORY_DESC, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) AS window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c ON i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE, SUM(d.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_records FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL` AS m ON d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE m.YEAR > 2010 AND m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE > 10 GROUP BY m.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE HAVING SUM(d.RECORD_COUNT) > 0), benchmark_cte AS (SELECT m.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE, AVG(m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS avg_new_shelf_price FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL` AS m ON d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE m.YEAR > 2010 AND m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE > 10 GROUP BY m.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE), overall_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(total_records) AS avg_total_records FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE, i.total_records, b.avg_new_shelf_price, CASE WHEN i.total_records > ob.avg_total_records * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_RECORDS' WHEN i.total_records < ob.avg_total_records * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_RECORDS' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS records_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN benchmark_cte AS b ON i.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE = b.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE CROSS JOIN overall_benchmark AS ob

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT, inner_cte.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ACTIVITY_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d ON inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE = d.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.BUILDING_NAME, t2.BUILDING_NUMBER, t1.FLOOR, t1.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, t0.POSTAL_CODE, t2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM `FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_FLOOR` AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS t2 ON t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t0.CITY = 'CAMBRIDGE' AND t1.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 0 AND t2.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND t2.BUILDING_NAME = 'MACLAURIN BUILDINGS (3)') SELECT inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME, inner_cte.BUILDING_NUMBER, inner_cte.FLOOR, inner_cte.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, inner_cte.POSTAL_CODE, FloorCounts.Total_Floors, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.POSTAL_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.BUILDING_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT t2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.FLOOR) AS Total_Floors FROM `FCLT_BUILDING` AS t2 JOIN `FCLT_FLOOR` AS t1 ON t2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY t2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) AS FloorCounts ON inner_cte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = FloorCounts.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE NOT d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL) SELECT IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, AVG(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, VARIANCE(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS var_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY IAP_CATEGORY_NAME WITH ROLLUP ORDER BY CASE WHEN IAP_CATEGORY_NAME IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, var_max_enrollment DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT f.BUILDING_TYPE, f.BUILDING_NAME, f.NUM_OF_ROOMS AS current_num_rooms, VARIANCE(h.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_rooms_variance, STDDEV(h.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_rooms_stddev, AVG(h.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS avg_hist_num_rooms FROM `FCLT_BUILDING` AS f JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_HIST` AS h ON f.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY = h.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY WHERE f.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY f.BUILDING_TYPE, f.BUILDING_NAME, f.NUM_OF_ROOMS) SELECT i.BUILDING_TYPE, i.BUILDING_NAME, i.current_num_rooms, i.num_rooms_variance, i.num_rooms_stddev, i.avg_hist_num_rooms, CASE WHEN i.current_num_rooms > i.avg_hist_num_rooms * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_CAPACITY' WHEN i.current_num_rooms < i.avg_hist_num_rooms * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_CAPACITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_CAPACITY' END AS capacity_category FROM inner_cte AS i ORDER BY i.BUILDING_TYPE, i.BUILDING_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sf.FLOOR_NAME, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE FROM `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd JOIN `SPACE_FLOOR` AS sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY), avg_sqft AS (SELECT FLOOR_NAME, AVG(ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS avg_sqft FROM inner_cte GROUP BY FLOOR_NAME) SELECT i.FLOOR_NAME, i.ROOM_NUMBER, i.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_sqft AS a ON i.FLOOR_NAME = a.FLOOR_NAME WHERE i.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > a.avg_sqft ORDER BY i.FLOOR_NAME, i.ROOM_NUMBER

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fba.BUILDING_NUMBER, fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE, fba.CITY, fba.STATE, fba.POSTAL_CODE, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.BUILDING_TYPE, fb.BUILDING_USE, fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD, GREATEST(fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS, COALESCE(LEAD(fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD), 0)) AS max_num_of_rooms_3rows FROM `FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS` AS fba JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS fb ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_HIST` AS fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fba.CITY = 'Cambridge' AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC'), RollupResults AS (SELECT BUILDING_NAME, BUILDING_TYPE, ADDRESS_PURPOSE, SUM(max_num_of_rooms_3rows) AS total_max_num_of_rooms FROM inner_cte GROUP BY BUILDING_NAME, BUILDING_TYPE, ADDRESS_PURPOSE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(max_num_of_rooms_3rows) > 0) SELECT rr.BUILDING_NAME, rr.BUILDING_TYPE, rr.ADDRESS_PURPOSE, rr.total_max_num_of_rooms FROM RollupResults AS rr ORDER BY rr.BUILDING_NAME, rr.BUILDING_TYPE, rr.ADDRESS_PURPOSE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS hr_org_unit_count, SUM(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS total_department_id FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS f JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID > 100000 GROUP BY f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.hr_org_unit_count, i.total_department_id, MAX(h.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS latest_hr_org_unit_load_date FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.hr_org_unit_count, i.total_department_id
