WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC), Subquery2 AS (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_PARAMETER, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, AVG(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TERM_INDICATOR ORDER BY t0.TERM_START_DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_INDICATOR = 'P') SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.avg_total_units, s1.stddev_total_units, s2.TERM_CODE, s2.TERM_PARAMETER, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.TERM_START_DATE, s2.window_column FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR

WITH Subq1 AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS summary_subject_title, t1.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE AS offered_summary_subject_title, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS window_column, t1.SUBJECT_ID FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS t0 JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS = 1), Subq2 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t1.CLUSTER_TYPE = 'S') SELECT s1.summary_subject_title, s1.COURSE_NUMBER, s1.offered_summary_subject_title, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.window_column AS summary_window_column, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS offered_subject_title, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS offered_offer_dept_name, s2.TOTAL_UNITS AS offered_total_units, s2.window_column AS offered_window_column FROM Subq1 AS s1 JOIN Subq2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID

WITH IAP_Activities_Sessions AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, s.SESSION_TITLE, s.SESSION_LOCATION, s.SESSION_DATE, s.SESSION_START_TIME, s.SESSION_END_TIME, MIN(s.SESSION_START_TIME) OVER (PARTITION BY s.SESSION_LOCATION ORDER BY s.SESSION_LOCATION) AS min_start_time_per_location FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION` AS s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY WHERE d.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N'), IAP_Activities_Rank AS (SELECT t1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM `TIME_DAY` AS t0 JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20) SELECT a.ACTIVITY_TITLE, a.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, a.MAX_ENROLLMENT, a.SESSION_TITLE, a.SESSION_LOCATION, a.SESSION_DATE, a.SESSION_START_TIME, a.SESSION_END_TIME, a.min_start_time_per_location, r.window_column FROM IAP_Activities_Sessions AS a JOIN IAP_Activities_Rank AS r ON a.ACTIVITY_TITLE = r.ACTIVITY_TITLE ORDER BY a.SESSION_LOCATION

WITH TopMaterialStatuses AS (SELECT tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS td JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS` AS tms ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY GROUP BY tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY material_count DESC LIMIT 10), LibraryReserveCounts AS (SELECT lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserve_count, lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY FROM `LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS` AS lms JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY WHERE lrmd.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY reserve_count DESC) SELECT tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, tms.material_count, lrc.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, lrc.reserve_count FROM TopMaterialStatuses AS tms JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS` AS tms2 ON tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY JOIN `LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS` AS lms ON tms2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS = lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS JOIN LibraryReserveCounts AS lrc ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY tms.material_count DESC, lrc.reserve_count DESC

WITH DepartmentSubjectStats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR), ActivitySponsorStats AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s.SPONSOR_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS activity_count, MIN(d.FEE) AS min_fee FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR` AS s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s.SPONSOR_NAME) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units, ass.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ass.SPONSOR_NAME, ass.activity_count, ass.min_fee FROM DepartmentSubjectStats AS dss JOIN ActivitySponsorStats AS ass ON dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT t.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d ON t.TERM_CODE = d.TERM_CODE WHERE d.ACTIVITY_TITLE = ass.ACTIVITY_TITLE LIMIT 1) ORDER BY dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ass.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ass.SPONSOR_NAME

WITH RoomsOnFloor2Access1 AS (SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT, t0.FLOOR, t0.SPACE_USAGE, t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ACCESS_LEVEL, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.ORGANIZATION, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(t0.ACCESS_LEVEL) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_access_level, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM `ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2 AND t0.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1), DeptHierarchyAgg AS (SELECT h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS min_org_unit_id FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS f JOIN `MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY` AS m ON f.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' GROUP BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) SELECT r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.BUILDING_COMPONENT, r.FLOOR, r.SPACE_USAGE, r.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, r.ACCESS_LEVEL, r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.ORGANIZATION, r.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, r.min_access_level, d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, d.org_count, d.min_org_unit_id FROM RoomsOnFloor2Access1 AS r LEFT JOIN DeptHierarchyAgg AS d ON r.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = d.min_org_unit_id ORDER BY r.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE

WITH SubjectUnitsStddev AS (SELECT sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS so JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON so.COMPOSITE_SUBJECT_KEY = sos.COMPOSITE_SUBJECT_KEY WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' GROUP BY sos.SUBJECT_TITLE HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY total_units_stddev DESC), Subjects2012SU AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, MIN(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t0 JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU') SELECT s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.window_column, s1.total_units_stddev FROM Subjects2012SU AS s2 JOIN SubjectUnitsStddev AS s1 ON s2.SUBJECT_TITLE = s1.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.SUBJECT_ID

WITH OrgWindowed AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORG_PARENT = 'S H&SS' AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1), OrgKeyStats AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1) SELECT ow.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ow.DESCRIPTION, ow.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, ow.window_column AS org_window_row_number, oks.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, oks.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, oks.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE AS oks_HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, oks.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, oks.window_column AS avg_org_key_window FROM OrgWindowed AS ow JOIN OrgKeyStats AS oks ON ow.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = oks.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY ow.ORGANIZATION_NAME, oks.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY

WITH dept_variance AS (SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM `LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR` AS lci JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY catalog_key_variance DESC), subject_window AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12) SELECT sw.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dv.catalog_key_variance, sw.SUBJECT_CODE, sw.SUBJECT_NUMBER, sw.SUBJECT_TITLE, sw.TERM_DESCRIPTION, sw.TOTAL_UNITS, sw.window_column FROM subject_window AS sw LEFT JOIN dept_variance AS dv ON sw.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dv.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY dv.catalog_key_variance DESC, sw.TOTAL_UNITS DESC

WITH SubjectOfferings2017FA AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.TERM_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS s JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS a ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA'), CourseMaterialDetail AS (SELECT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.ISBN, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS t0 JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t1 ON t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE NOT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NULL AND t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0) SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.window_column, c.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, c.TERM_CODE, c.SUBJECT_ID, c.ISBN, c.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, c.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, c.max_enrolled_students FROM SubjectOfferings2017FA AS s JOIN CourseMaterialDetail AS c ON s.SUBJECT_ID = c.SUBJECT_ID AND s.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY

WITH OrgLevel5 AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS window_column, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5), LargeAssignableRooms AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.ROOM, t1.SPACE_ID, t1.AREA, t0.MAJOR_USE, t0.DESCRIPTION, MIN(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY) AS min_area_per_major_use, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM `FCLT_MAJOR_USE` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 200 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.ORGANIZATION_ID, o.DLC_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, o.window_column, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.FLOOR, r.ROOM, r.SPACE_ID, r.AREA, r.MAJOR_USE, r.DESCRIPTION, r.min_area_per_major_use FROM OrgLevel5 AS o JOIN LargeAssignableRooms AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.MAJOR_USE

WITH TopMaterialStatuses AS (SELECT tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS td JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS` AS tms ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY GROUP BY tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY material_count DESC LIMIT 10), ReserveCountsByLibraryStatus AS (SELECT lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserve_count, lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY FROM `LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS` AS lms JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY WHERE lrmd.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY reserve_count DESC) SELECT tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, tms.material_count, lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, lms.reserve_count FROM TopMaterialStatuses AS tms JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS td ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lrmd.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID AND lrmd.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE JOIN ReserveCountsByLibraryStatus AS lms ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY GROUP BY tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, tms.material_count, lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, lms.reserve_count ORDER BY tms.material_count DESC, lms.reserve_count DESC

WITH DeptSchoolRQStats AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME), LibrarySubjects2014FA AS (SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS l JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA') SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, l.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.window_column, d.subject_count, d.min_total_units FROM LibrarySubjects2014FA AS l JOIN DeptSchoolRQStats AS d ON l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = d.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH IAPActivities AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t0.PREREQUISITES, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, MIN(t1.TERM_START_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.TERM_CODE ORDER BY t0.TERM_CODE) AS window_column FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30), TipMaterialStats AS (SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(t0.RECORD_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ') SELECT ia.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ia.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, ia.PREREQUISITES, ia.TERM_CODE, ia.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS IAP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, ia.TERM_START_DATE, ia.TERM_END_DATE, ia.window_column AS IAP_MIN_TERM_START_DATE, tms.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, tms.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, tms.SUBJECT_ID, tms.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TIP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tms.window_column AS TIP_AVG_RECORD_COUNT FROM IAPActivities AS ia JOIN TipMaterialStats AS tms ON ia.TERM_CODE = tms.TERM_CODE ORDER BY ia.TERM_CODE, tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR

WITH IAPActivities AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t0.PREREQUISITES, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, MIN(t1.TERM_START_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.TERM_CODE ORDER BY t0.TERM_CODE) AS window_column FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30), TipRQDetails AS (SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(t0.RECORD_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ') SELECT ia.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ia.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, ia.PREREQUISITES, ia.TERM_CODE, ia.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS IAP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, ia.TERM_START_DATE, ia.TERM_END_DATE, ia.window_column AS IAP_MIN_TERM_START_DATE, trd.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, trd.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, trd.SUBJECT_ID, trd.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TIP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, trd.ACADEMIC_YEAR, trd.window_column AS TIP_AVG_RECORD_COUNT FROM IAPActivities AS ia JOIN TipRQDetails AS trd ON ia.TERM_CODE = trd.TERM_CODE ORDER BY ia.TERM_CODE, trd.ACADEMIC_YEAR

WITH OrgLevel5 AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5), RoomsFloor2 AS (SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.SPACE_USAGE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(t0.ACCESS_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM `ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2), CombinedResults AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.DESCRIPTION, o.SPACE_UNIT, o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, o.window_column AS org_window_column, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.SPACE_USAGE, r.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, r.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.window_column AS room_window_column FROM OrgLevel5 AS o JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS su ON o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY JOIN RoomsFloor2 AS r ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = r.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, BUILDING_ROOM

WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.TERM_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS s JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS a ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.ISBN, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS t0 JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t1 ON t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE NOT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NULL AND t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.ISBN, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s2.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, s2.max_enrolled_students FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.TERM_CODE = s2.TERM_CODE

WITH AcademicTermDetails AS (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_PARAMETER, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, AVG(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TERM_INDICATOR ORDER BY t0.TERM_START_DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_INDICATOR = 'P'), AcademicYearVariation AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT atd.TERM_CODE, atd.TERM_PARAMETER, atd.TERM_DESCRIPTION, atd.ACADEMIC_YEAR, atd.TERM_START_DATE, atd.window_column, ayv.coefficient_of_variation FROM AcademicTermDetails AS atd JOIN AcademicYearVariation AS ayv ON atd.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY atd.ACADEMIC_YEAR, atd.TERM_CODE

WITH MaterialStatusCounts AS (SELECT tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS td JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS` AS tms ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY GROUP BY tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY material_count DESC LIMIT 10), LibraryReserveCounts AS (SELECT lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserve_count, lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY FROM `LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS` AS lms JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY WHERE lrmd.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY reserve_count DESC) SELECT msc.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, msc.material_count, lrc.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, lrc.reserve_count FROM MaterialStatusCounts AS msc JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS td ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = msc.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lrmd.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID AND lrmd.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE JOIN LibraryReserveCounts AS lrc ON lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY GROUP BY msc.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, msc.material_count, lrc.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, lrc.reserve_count ORDER BY msc.material_count DESC, lrc.reserve_count DESC

WITH subq1 AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS summary_subject_title, t1.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE AS offered_summary_subject_title, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS window_column FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS t0 JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS = 1), subq2 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC) SELECT subq1.summary_subject_title, subq1.COURSE_NUMBER, subq1.offered_summary_subject_title, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, subq1.window_column, subq2.avg_total_units, subq2.stddev_total_units FROM subq1 LEFT JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.window_column

WITH provost_area_dept_orgs AS (SELECT m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE) AS min_level3_code FROM `MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY` AS m JOIN `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY), facility_org_hr_stats AS (SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, MAX(hr_unit_count) - MIN(hr_unit_count) AS org_unit_count_range, VARIANCE(hr_unit_count) AS org_unit_count_variance, STDDEV(hr_unit_count) AS org_unit_count_stddev FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS f JOIN `MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY` AS m ON f.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY JOIN (SELECT h.DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS hr_unit_count FROM `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h WHERE NOT h.DLC_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY h.DLC_KEY) AS hr_stats ON m.DLC_KEY = hr_stats.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT f.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' GROUP BY f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY org_unit_count_range DESC) SELECT p.DLC_NAME, p.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, p.org_count, p.min_level3_code, f.org_unit_count_range, f.org_unit_count_variance, f.org_unit_count_stddev FROM provost_area_dept_orgs AS p JOIN facility_org_hr_stats AS f ON p.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY

WITH BuildingRoomStats AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_room_area, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS room_area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS room_area_variance FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY room_area_range DESC), RoomAccessStats AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.BUILDING_COMPONENT, t1.FLOOR, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(t1.FLOOR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SPACE_USAGE ORDER BY t1.FLOOR) AS window_column FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD` AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1) SELECT ras.BUILDING_ROOM, ras.BUILDING_COMPONENT, ras.FLOOR, ras.SPACE_USAGE, ras.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ras.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ras.window_column, brs.BUILDING_NAME, brs.avg_room_area, brs.room_area_range, brs.room_area_variance, ROUND(ras.window_column / NULLIF(brs.avg_room_area, 0), 2) AS normalized_floor_to_area FROM RoomAccessStats AS ras JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS fr ON ras.BUILDING_ROOM = fr.BUILDING_ROOM JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN BuildingRoomStats AS brs ON fb.BUILDING_NAME = brs.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY normalized_floor_to_area DESC

WITH Subq1 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t0 JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering'), Subq2 AS (SELECT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.ISBN, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS t0 JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t1 ON t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE NOT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NULL AND t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.TERM_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.ISBN, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s2.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.max_enrolled_students FROM Subq1 AS s1 JOIN Subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND s1.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT CIP.PROGRAM_TITLE, CIP.CATEGORY_TITLE, SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.SCHOOL_NAME, CIP.VERSION FROM `CIP` JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` ON CIP.PROGRAM_CODE = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT = '17'), school_avg AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(VERSION) AS avg_version FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT i.PROGRAM_TITLE, i.CATEGORY_TITLE, i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.avg_version AS school_avg_version, CASE WHEN i.VERSION > s.avg_version * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_VERSION' WHEN i.VERSION < s.avg_version * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_VERSION' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS version_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN school_avg AS s ON i.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME

WITH DeptTotalUnits AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrm JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC), DeptCatalogKeyStats AS (SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, MAX(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) - MIN(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_range, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM `LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR` AS lci JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY catalog_key_range DESC) SELECT dtu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dtu.avg_total_units, dtu.total_units_variance, dtu.total_units_stddev, dcks.catalog_key_range, dcks.catalog_key_variance, ROUND(dtu.avg_total_units / NULLIF(dcks.catalog_key_range, 0), 2) AS avg_units_per_catalog_key_range FROM DeptTotalUnits AS dtu JOIN DeptCatalogKeyStats AS dcks ON dtu.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcks.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY avg_units_per_catalog_key_range DESC

WITH TermInfo AS (SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t0.CALENDAR_DATE, t0.DAY_OF_WEEK, AVG(t0.CALENDAR_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.CALENDAR_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE) AS window_column FROM `TIME_DAY` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.TERM_START_DATE WHERE t1.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous'), SubjectCategoryStats AS (SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT i.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS i JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT ti.TERM_CODE, ti.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ti.TERM_START_DATE, ti.CALENDAR_DATE, ti.DAY_OF_WEEK, ti.window_column, scs.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, scs.ACADEMIC_YEAR, scs.subject_count, scs.min_term_start_date, ROUND(scs.subject_count / NULLIF(ti.window_column, 0), 2) AS Normalized_Subjects_Per_Year FROM TermInfo AS ti JOIN SubjectCategoryStats AS scs ON ti.TERM_START_DATE = scs.min_term_start_date ORDER BY Normalized_Subjects_Per_Year DESC

WITH MathCourses AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5), Subjects2014FA AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, lso.SUBJECT_ID FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS lso JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0) SELECT mc.COURSE_NUMBER, mc.SUBJECT_TITLE, mc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, mc.TERM_DESCRIPTION, mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mc.window_column AS math_row_number, s14.SUBJECT_TITLE AS s14_SUBJECT_TITLE, s14.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s14.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s14.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s14.TOTAL_UNITS, s14.window_column AS s14_min_total_units_window, ROUND(mc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS / NULLIF(s14.TOTAL_UNITS, 0), 2) AS Enrolled_Per_Unit FROM MathCourses AS mc JOIN Subjects2014FA AS s14 ON mc.SUBJECT_ID = s14.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY Enrolled_Per_Unit DESC

WITH SpaceUnitStats AS (SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, VARIANCE(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_variance, STDDEV(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_stddev FROM `SPACE_UNIT` AS su JOIN `ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD` AS zr ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE zr.FLOOR = 2 GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY access_level_variance DESC), SpaceUnitOrg AS (SELECT t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE ORDER BY t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM `SPACE_UNIT` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000) SELECT sus.SPACE_UNIT, sus.access_level_variance, sus.access_level_stddev, suo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, suo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, suo.window_column FROM SpaceUnitStats AS sus JOIN SpaceUnitOrg AS suo ON sus.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = suo.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY sus.access_level_variance DESC, suo.window_column DESC

WITH subq1 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC), subq2 AS (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_PARAMETER, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, AVG(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TERM_INDICATOR ORDER BY t0.TERM_START_DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_INDICATOR = 'P') SELECT subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, subq1.avg_total_units, subq1.stddev_total_units, subq2.TERM_CODE, subq2.TERM_PARAMETER, subq2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, subq2.TERM_START_DATE, subq2.window_column FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = subq2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subq1.stddev_total_units DESC, subq2.TERM_START_DATE

WITH DeptCatalogVariance AS (SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM `LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR` AS lci JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY catalog_key_variance DESC), DeptEnrolledStddev AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2013FA' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) >= 5 ORDER BY enrolled_stddev DESC), CombinedDepts AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT AS DEPT_NAME, catalog_key_variance, NULL AS enrolled_stddev, 'CatalogVariance' AS Reason FROM DeptCatalogVariance UNION ALL SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT_NAME, NULL AS catalog_key_variance, enrolled_stddev, 'EnrolledStddev' AS Reason FROM DeptEnrolledStddev) SELECT * FROM CombinedDepts ORDER BY DEPT_NAME

WITH SpaceUnitDetails AS (SELECT t2.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name, t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME AS dept_hier_level_3_name, t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME AS dept_hier_level_2_name, t1.DLC_KEY AS department_code, MIN(t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) OVER (ORDER BY t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM `MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = 402410), ProvostDepartments AS (SELECT m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE) AS min_level3_code FROM `MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY` AS m JOIN `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT s.space_unit_name, s.organization_name, s.dept_hier_level_3_name, s.dept_hier_level_2_name, s.department_code, s.window_column, p.DLC_NAME, p.org_count, p.min_level3_code FROM SpaceUnitDetails AS s JOIN ProvostDepartments AS p ON s.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = p.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY s.organization_name, p.org_count DESC

WITH BuildingRoomAreaStats AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_room_area, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS room_area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS room_area_variance FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY room_area_range DESC), RoomAccessStats AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.BUILDING_COMPONENT, t1.FLOOR, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(t1.FLOOR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SPACE_USAGE ORDER BY t1.FLOOR) AS window_column FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD` AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1) SELECT bras.BUILDING_NAME, bras.avg_room_area, bras.room_area_range, bras.room_area_variance, ras.BUILDING_ROOM, ras.BUILDING_COMPONENT, ras.FLOOR, ras.SPACE_USAGE, ras.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ras.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ras.window_column FROM BuildingRoomAreaStats AS bras JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b ON bras.BUILDING_NAME = b.BUILDING_NAME JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN RoomAccessStats AS ras ON ras.BUILDING_ROOM = r.BUILDING_ROOM ORDER BY bras.room_area_range DESC, ras.FLOOR

WITH HassElectives2022 AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TOTAL_UNITS, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS num_hass_electives_in_department FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE` AS h ON c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = h.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND h.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM = 'HASS Elective'), TwelveUnitSubjects2024 AS (SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t0 JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12) SELECT t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE AS subject_code_2024, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER AS subject_number_2024, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title_2024, t2.TOTAL_UNITS AS total_units_2024, t2.window_column, h1.SUBJECT_CODE AS subject_code_2022, h1.SUBJECT_NUMBER AS subject_number_2022, h1.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title_2022, h1.TOTAL_UNITS AS total_units_2022, h1.num_hass_electives_in_department, ROUND(t2.window_column / NULLIF(h1.num_hass_electives_in_department, 0), 2) AS window_to_hass_electives_ratio FROM TwelveUnitSubjects2024 AS t2 LEFT JOIN HassElectives2022 AS h1 ON t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = h1.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.window_column, h1.SUBJECT_CODE

WITH CurrentTermSummary AS (SELECT atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollment FROM `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS atp JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR), SubjectsInCurrentParamTerm AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t1.TERM_CODE, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM') SELECT cts.TERM_CODE, cts.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cts.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cts.subject_count, cts.total_enrollment, sicpt.SUBJECT_TITLE, sicpt.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sicpt.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, sicpt.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS SUBJECT_TERM_DESCRIPTION, sicpt.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, sicpt.window_column FROM CurrentTermSummary AS cts JOIN SubjectsInCurrentParamTerm AS sicpt ON cts.TERM_CODE = sicpt.TERM_CODE ORDER BY cts.TERM_CODE, sicpt.SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH SpaceUnitAccessStats AS (SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, VARIANCE(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_variance, STDDEV(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_stddev FROM `SPACE_UNIT` AS su JOIN `ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD` AS zr ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE zr.FLOOR = 2 GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY access_level_variance DESC), SpaceUnitOrgWindow AS (SELECT t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE ORDER BY t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM `SPACE_UNIT` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000) SELECT s.SPACE_UNIT, s.access_level_variance, s.access_level_stddev, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.window_column FROM SpaceUnitAccessStats AS s JOIN SpaceUnitOrgWindow AS o ON s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = o.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY s.access_level_variance DESC, o.window_column DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fba.BUILDING_NUMBER, fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE, fba.CITY, fba.POSTAL_CODE, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.BUILDING_TYPE, fb.BUILDING_USE, fb.EXT_GROSS_AREA, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD, fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS, MIN(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) AS MIN_ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM `FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS` AS fba JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS fb ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_HIST` AS fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fba.CITY = 'CAMBRIDGE' AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' AND fb.BUILDING_NAME <> 'ASHDOWN HOUSE') SELECT BUILDING_NUMBER, ADDRESS_PURPOSE, CITY, POSTAL_CODE, BUILDING_NAME, BUILDING_TYPE, BUILDING_USE, EXT_GROSS_AREA, MAX(NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS MAX_NUM_OF_ROOMS FROM inner_cte GROUP BY BUILDING_NUMBER, ADDRESS_PURPOSE, CITY, POSTAL_CODE, BUILDING_NAME, BUILDING_TYPE, BUILDING_USE, EXT_GROSS_AREA ORDER BY BUILDING_NAME

WITH MathCourses AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5), Subjects2014FA AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, lso.SUBJECT_ID FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS lso JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0), CombinedSubjects AS (SELECT mc.COURSE_NUMBER, mc.SUBJECT_TITLE, mc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, mc.TERM_DESCRIPTION, mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mc.window_column AS math_window_column, NULL AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NULL AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, NULL AS TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, NULL AS TOTAL_UNITS, NULL AS subj_window_column FROM MathCourses AS mc UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS COURSE_NUMBER, s2014.SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS math_window_column, s2014.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2014.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s2014.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2014.TOTAL_UNITS, s2014.window_column AS subj_window_column FROM Subjects2014FA AS s2014) SELECT * FROM CombinedSubjects ORDER BY SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH course_info AS (SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS s JOIN `CIP` AS c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = 6), building_stats AS (SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC) SELECT ci.COURSE, ci.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ci.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ci.SCHOOL_NAME, ci.PROGRAM_CODE, ci.PROGRAM_TITLE, ci.CATEGORY_CODE, ci.CATEGORY_TITLE, ci.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, ci.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, ci.min_warehouse_load_date, bs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, bs.avg_total_units, bs.stddev_total_units FROM course_info AS ci JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS cso ON cso.SUBJECT_CODE = ci.COURSE JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS fr ON fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = cso.MEET_PLACE JOIN building_stats AS bs ON bs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY ci.CATEGORY_CODE, bs.stddev_total_units DESC

WITH department_catalog_key_variance AS (SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM `LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR` AS lci JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY catalog_key_variance DESC), department_enrolled_stddev AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2013FA' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) >= 5 ORDER BY enrolled_stddev DESC) SELECT dckv.DEPARTMENT, dckv.catalog_key_variance, desd.enrolled_stddev FROM department_catalog_key_variance AS dckv JOIN department_enrolled_stddev AS desd ON dckv.DEPARTMENT = desd.OFFER_DEPT_NAME

WITH BuildingAreaStddev AS (SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.BUILDING_NUMBER, STDDEV(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS` ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.BUILDING_NUMBER HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY area_stddev DESC), RoomAccessLevel1 AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.BUILDING_COMPONENT, t1.FLOOR, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(t1.FLOOR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SPACE_USAGE ORDER BY t1.FLOOR) AS window_column FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD` AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1) SELECT bal.BUILDING_NUMBER, bal.area_stddev, ral1.BUILDING_ROOM, ral1.BUILDING_COMPONENT, ral1.FLOOR, ral1.SPACE_USAGE, ral1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ral1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ral1.window_column FROM BuildingAreaStddev AS bal JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS fr ON bal.BUILDING_NUMBER = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN RoomAccessLevel1 AS ral1 ON fr.BUILDING_ROOM = ral1.BUILDING_ROOM ORDER BY bal.area_stddev DESC, ral1.FLOOR

WITH avg_stats AS (SELECT atp.TERM_PARAMETER, AVG(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_materials_per_subject, VARIANCE(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS variance_materials_per_subject, STDDEV(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS stddev_materials_per_subject FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS td JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON td.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS atp ON ata.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.TERM_PARAMETER <> 'SIS_UPCOMING_TERM' AND NOT ata.TERM_START_DATE IS NULL GROUP BY atp.TERM_PARAMETER ORDER BY variance_materials_per_subject DESC), eo_materials AS (SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'EO') SELECT eo_materials.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, eo_materials.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, eo_materials.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, eo_materials.TERM_CODE, eo_materials.SUBJECT_ID, eo_materials.TERM_DESCRIPTION, eo_materials.ACADEMIC_YEAR, eo_materials.TERM_PARAMETER, eo_materials.window_column, avg_stats.avg_materials_per_subject, avg_stats.variance_materials_per_subject, avg_stats.stddev_materials_per_subject FROM eo_materials LEFT JOIN avg_stats ON eo_materials.TERM_PARAMETER = avg_stats.TERM_PARAMETER ORDER BY eo_materials.ACADEMIC_YEAR, eo_materials.window_column

WITH DeptUnitsStats AS (SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS ssc JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC), Dept6CourseCIP AS (SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS s JOIN `CIP` AS c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = 6) SELECT d6c.COURSE, d6c.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, d6c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d6c.SCHOOL_NAME, d6c.PROGRAM_CODE, d6c.PROGRAM_TITLE, d6c.CATEGORY_CODE, d6c.CATEGORY_TITLE, d6c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, d6c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, d6c.min_warehouse_load_date, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance FROM Dept6CourseCIP AS d6c LEFT JOIN DeptUnitsStats AS dus ON d6c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d6c.CATEGORY_CODE, d6c.COURSE

WITH subject_window_enrollment AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM'), person_role_enrollment_stats AS (SELECT p.PERSON_ROLE, AVG(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, MAX(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) - MIN(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_range, VARIANCE(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON` AS p JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d ON p.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND NOT d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL GROUP BY p.PERSON_ROLE ORDER BY max_enrollment_range DESC) SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s.window_column, p.PERSON_ROLE, p.avg_max_enrollment, p.max_enrollment_range, p.max_enrollment_variance FROM subject_window_enrollment AS s CROSS JOIN person_role_enrollment_stats AS p

WITH Sub1 AS (SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS s JOIN `CIP` AS c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = 6), Sub2 AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT s1.COURSE, s1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.PROGRAM_CODE, s1.PROGRAM_TITLE, s1.CATEGORY_CODE, s1.CATEGORY_TITLE, s1.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, s1.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, s1.min_warehouse_load_date, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.subject_count, s2.min_total_units FROM Sub1 AS s1 JOIN Sub2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.CATEGORY_CODE, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR

WITH DepartmentVariation AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `STUDENT_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), Subjects2017JA AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `STUDENT_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA') SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.window_column, dv.coefficient_of_variation FROM Subjects2017JA AS s JOIN DepartmentVariation AS dv ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fr.FLOOR, fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC, fr.AREA, ff.FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` AS fr JOIN `FCLT_FLOOR` AS ff ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND fr.FLOOR = ff.FLOOR WHERE fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '32' AND ff.ACCESS_LEVEL = 2 AND fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC NOT LIKE '%STORAGE%') SELECT i.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, i.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, i.FLOOR, i.MAJOR_USE_DESC, i.AREA, AVG(i.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY i.FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE ORDER BY i.AREA ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS avg_area_window FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE, AVG(AREA) AS avg_floor_area FROM inner_cte GROUP BY FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE) AS favg ON i.FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE = favg.FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE WHERE i.AREA > favg.avg_floor_area ORDER BY i.FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE, i.AREA

WITH building_area_stddev AS (SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.BUILDING_NUMBER, STDDEV(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS` ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.BUILDING_NUMBER HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY area_stddev DESC), rooms_access_level_1 AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.BUILDING_COMPONENT, t1.FLOOR, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(t1.FLOOR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SPACE_USAGE ORDER BY t1.FLOOR) AS window_column FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD` AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1) SELECT bas.BUILDING_NUMBER, bas.area_stddev, ral1.BUILDING_ROOM, ral1.BUILDING_COMPONENT, ral1.FLOOR, ral1.SPACE_USAGE, ral1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ral1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ral1.window_column FROM building_area_stddev AS bas JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS` AS fba ON bas.BUILDING_NUMBER = fba.BUILDING_NUMBER JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS fr ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN rooms_access_level_1 AS ral1 ON fr.BUILDING_ROOM = ral1.BUILDING_ROOM

WITH material_status_stats AS (SELECT d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, AVG(c.RECORD_COUNTER) AS avg_record_counter, VARIANCE(c.RECORD_COUNTER) AS record_counter_variance FROM `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG` AS c ON d.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = c.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY WHERE c.CATALOG_YEAR > 2000 GROUP BY d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY record_counter_variance DESC), subject_enrollment_stats AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_enrolled_students, lso.SUBJECT_ID FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS lso INNER JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0) SELECT ms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ms.avg_record_counter, ms.record_counter_variance, ses.SUBJECT_TITLE, ses.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ses.TERM_CODE, ses.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ses.TOTAL_UNITS, ses.avg_enrolled_students FROM material_status_stats AS ms JOIN subject_enrollment_stats AS ses ON ms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = ses.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_budget_code, SUM(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_sum, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%Engineering%' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.min_budget_code, inner_cte.total_units_sum, COUNT(DISTINCT ccc.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS unique_courses, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.min_budget_code, inner_cte.total_units_sum, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS s JOIN `CIP` AS c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = 6) SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.COURSE) AS total_courses, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.CATEGORY_CODE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS min_warehouse_load_date, s.DEPARTMENT FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS s JOIN `CIP` AS c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.CATEGORY_CODE, s.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.CATEGORY_CODE) SELECT subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.min_budget_code, subq1.total_units_sum, subq1.unique_courses, subq2.total_courses, subq2.SCHOOL_NAME, subq2.CATEGORY_CODE, subq2.min_warehouse_load_date FROM subq1 JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN subq2 ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = subq2.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.CATEGORY_CODE

WITH RollupResults AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous'), YearTermCounts AS (SELECT t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.TERM_CODE) AS num_terms FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR) SELECT FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(num_terms) AS total_terms FROM YearTermCounts GROUP BY FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(num_terms) > 0), DeptVariation AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE AND LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) > 0) SELECT rr.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.total_terms, dv.coefficient_of_variation FROM RollupResults AS rr LEFT JOIN DeptVariation AS dv ON rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dv.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY rr.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS offering_count, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS so ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' GROUP BY so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.offering_count, inner_cte.total_units, SUM(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS so ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_KEY = so.SUBJECT_KEY GROUP BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.offering_count, inner_cte.total_units), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.SUBJECT_KEY, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY, AVG(t0.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SUBJECT_KEY ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS window_column FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2012SU') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_KEY, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, inner_cte.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY, inner_cte.window_column AS avg_enrollment_number, (inner_cte.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER - inner_cte.window_column) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_KEY, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.offering_count, s1.total_units, s1.total_enrolled_students, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, s2.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY, s2.avg_enrollment_number, s2.deviation_from_avg FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_KEY = s2.SUBJECT_KEY AND s1.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_KEY, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, lso.COURSE_NUMBER FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS lso JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.COURSE_NUMBER FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t0 JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'), SubjectCodeVisibility AS (SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, CASE WHEN NOT SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL AND SUBJECT_CODE_DESC <> 'nan' THEN 'Has Description' ELSE 'No Description' END AS description_status, COURSE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte2), RollupResults AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, description_status, COUNT(*) AS total_subject_codes FROM SubjectCodeVisibility GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, description_status WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0) SELECT ic1.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ic1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ic1.TOTAL_UNITS, ic1.window_column, ic1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, scv.SUBJECT_CODE, scv.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.description_status, rr.total_subject_codes FROM inner_cte1 AS ic1 JOIN SubjectCodeVisibility AS scv ON ic1.COURSE_NUMBER = scv.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN RollupResults AS rr ON scv.SCHOOL_NAME = rr.SCHOOL_NAME AND scv.description_status = rr.description_status ORDER BY ic1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.description_status

WITH CourseCIPInfo AS (SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS s JOIN `CIP` AS c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = 6), DeptSubjectStats AS (SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, at2.TERM_START_DATE FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS td JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at2 ON td.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccs ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at2.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) > 3), DeptSubjectCount AS (SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_lecture_units, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, COUNT(ccs2.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_offered FROM DeptSubjectStats AS inner_cte JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccs2 ON ccs2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ccs2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_lecture_units, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE) SELECT cci.COURSE, cci.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, cci.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cci.SCHOOL_NAME, cci.PROGRAM_CODE, cci.PROGRAM_TITLE, cci.CATEGORY_CODE, cci.CATEGORY_TITLE, cci.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, cci.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, cci.min_warehouse_load_date, dsc.max_lecture_units, dsc.TERM_START_DATE, dsc.num_subjects_offered FROM CourseCIPInfo AS cci JOIN DeptSubjectCount AS dsc ON cci.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cci.min_warehouse_load_date > '01-JAN-20' ORDER BY cci.CATEGORY_CODE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT su.SPACE_USAGE, sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE FROM `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd JOIN `SPACE_USAGE` AS su ON sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = su.SPACE_USAGE_KEY WHERE sd.ROOM_COUNTER = 1 AND sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32) SELECT SPACE_USAGE, BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, AVG(ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS avg_square_footage, MAX(ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) - MIN(ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS square_footage_range, VARIANCE(ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS square_footage_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SPACE_USAGE, BUILDING_ROOM_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY SPACE_USAGE, BUILDING_ROOM_NAME

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS hr_org_unit_count, SUM(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS total_department_id FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS f JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID > 100000 GROUP BY f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME), OrgUnitDetails AS (SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS f JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID > 100000), RollupResults AS (SELECT i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, SUM(i.hr_org_unit_count) AS hr_org_unit_count, SUM(i.total_department_id) AS total_department_id FROM inner_cte1 AS i LEFT JOIN OrgUnitDetails AS o ON i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY AND i.ORGANIZATION_NAME = o.ORGANIZATION_NAME AND i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(i.hr_org_unit_count) > 0), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT t1.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.DEPT_COUNT, t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, t2.RESEARCH_VOLUME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN `SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE` AS t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DEPT_NAMES WHERE t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500), SpaceUnitAgg AS (SELECT space_unit_name, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ORGANIZATION_NAME, DEPT_COUNT, NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, MAX(RESEARCH_VOLUME) AS highest_research_volume, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY space_unit_name, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ORGANIZATION_NAME, DEPT_COUNT, NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT rr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, rr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, rr.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, rr.hr_org_unit_count, rr.total_department_id, sua.space_unit_name, sua.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, sua.DEPT_COUNT, sua.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, sua.highest_research_volume FROM RollupResults AS rr LEFT JOIN SpaceUnitAgg AS sua ON rr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = sua.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY rr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, rr.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION, s.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_org_number FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS s ON o.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 50000 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION, s.SPACE_UNIT) SELECT i.ORGANIZATION, i.SPACE_UNIT, i.space_unit_count, i.min_org_number, o.DLC_NAME, o.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON i.ORGANIZATION = o.ORGANIZATION), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5) SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS') SELECT subq1.ORGANIZATION, subq1.SPACE_UNIT, subq1.space_unit_count, subq1.min_org_number, subq1.DLC_NAME, subq2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, subq2.ORGANIZATION_ID, subq2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, subq2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, subq2.window_column FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DLC_KEY = subq2.DLC_KEY

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS window_column FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS t0 JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS > 0), dept_counts1 AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS total_subjects FROM `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` WHERE TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS s JOIN `CIP` AS c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = 6), SchoolTotals2 AS (SELECT NULL AS COURSE, NULL AS COURSE_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS PROGRAM_CODE, NULL AS PROGRAM_TITLE, NULL AS CATEGORY_CODE, NULL AS CATEGORY_TITLE, NULL AS FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, NULL AS FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, NULL AS min_warehouse_load_date, COUNT(*) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT ic1.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic1.COURSE_NUMBER, ic1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic1.window_column, NULL AS total_subjects, ic2.COURSE, ic2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ic2.SCHOOL_NAME, ic2.PROGRAM_CODE, ic2.PROGRAM_TITLE, ic2.CATEGORY_CODE, ic2.CATEGORY_TITLE, ic2.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, ic2.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, ic2.min_warehouse_load_date, NULL AS total_courses FROM inner_cte1 AS ic1 LEFT JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd ON ic1.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE LEFT JOIN inner_cte2 AS ic2 ON scd.COURSE = ic2.COURSE UNION ALL SELECT NULL, NULL, dc1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL, dc1.total_subjects, s2.COURSE, s2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.PROGRAM_CODE, s2.PROGRAM_TITLE, s2.CATEGORY_CODE, s2.CATEGORY_TITLE, s2.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, s2.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, s2.min_warehouse_load_date, s2.total_courses FROM dept_counts1 AS dc1 LEFT JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd2 ON dc1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd2.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SchoolTotals2 AS s2 ON scd2.SCHOOL_NAME = s2.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, CATEGORY_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, COURSE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS min_square_footage, SUM(sd.ROOM_COUNTER) AS total_rooms, sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT FROM `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd JOIN `SPACE_USAGE` AS su ON sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = su.SPACE_USAGE_KEY WHERE su.SPACE_USAGE = 'RESEARCH CENTER' AND sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 GROUP BY sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT) SELECT min_square_footage, total_rooms, BUILDING_COMPONENT FROM inner_cte WHERE total_rooms = (SELECT MAX(total_rooms) FROM inner_cte)

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY FROM `SPACE_UNIT` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000) SELECT inner_cte.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, SUM(inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS total_space_unit_keys FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) > 0 ORDER BY inner_cte.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT_CODE), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t0.SPACE_UNIT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.BUILDING_ROOM ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `SPACE_UNIT` AS t0 JOIN `ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD` AS t1 ON t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE t1.FLOOR = 2 AND t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1) SELECT ic.BUILDING_ROOM, ic.SPACE_USAGE, ic.SPACE_UNIT, su_counts.ROOM_COUNT FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT t0.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(*) AS ROOM_COUNT FROM `SPACE_UNIT` AS t0 JOIN `ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD` AS t1 ON t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE t1.FLOOR = 2 AND t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY t0.SPACE_UNIT HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS su_counts ON ic.SPACE_UNIT = su_counts.SPACE_UNIT) SELECT s1.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, s1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, s1.total_space_unit_keys, s2.BUILDING_ROOM, s2.SPACE_USAGE, s2.SPACE_UNIT, s2.ROOM_COUNT FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS su ON s1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON su.SPACE_UNIT = s2.SPACE_UNIT ORDER BY s1.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, s1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, s2.BUILDING_ROOM

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, AVG(hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS avg_org_unit_id, VARIANCE(hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS org_unit_id_variance FROM `SPACE_UNIT` AS su JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID IS NULL GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT) SELECT icte.SPACE_UNIT, icte.avg_org_unit_id, icte.org_unit_id_variance, dept_stats.Most_Common_HR_Department, dept_stats.Department_Unit_Count FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN (SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Common_HR_Department, COUNT(*) AS Department_Unit_Count FROM `SPACE_UNIT` AS su JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID IS NULL AND NOT hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_stats ON icte.SPACE_UNIT = dept_stats.SPACE_UNIT AND dept_stats.Department_Unit_Count = (SELECT MAX(sub_dept_stats.Department_Unit_Count) FROM (SELECT su2.SPACE_UNIT, hou2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Department_Unit_Count FROM `SPACE_UNIT` AS su2 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS fo2 ON su2.DLC_KEY = fo2.DLC_KEY JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS hou2 ON fo2.DLC_KEY = hou2.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT hou2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID IS NULL AND NOT hou2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY su2.SPACE_UNIT, hou2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS sub_dept_stats WHERE sub_dept_stats.SPACE_UNIT = dept_stats.SPACE_UNIT) ORDER BY icte.org_unit_id_variance DESC), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS
