inner_cte.MAX_TERM_END_DATE, t1.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR FROM inner_cte JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t1 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = c.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND t.ACADEMIC_YEAR = i.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units) SELECT s1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.TERM_START_DATE, s1.MAX_TERM_END_DATE, s1.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.subject_count, s2.min_total_units, s2.avg_enrolled_students FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR

WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 300 AND t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1) SELECT inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, org_counts.Total_Rooms, inner_cte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT BUILDING_ROOM) AS Total_Rooms FROM (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 300 AND t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1) AS sub GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS org_counts ON inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = org_counts.ORGANIZATION_NAME), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.area_range, ic.area_variance, ic.area_stddev, muc.MAJOR_USE_DESC AS Most_Common_Major_Use, muc.Room_Count FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS Room_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) DESC) AS rn FROM `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, r.MAJOR_USE_DESC) AS muc ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = muc.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND muc.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.area_range DESC LIMIT 10), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s1.BUILDING_ROOM, s1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s1.Total_Rooms, b.BUILDING_NAME, s1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, 'Large_Accessible_Room' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b ON s1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS BUILDING_ROOM, NULL AS MAJOR_USE_DESC, NULL AS ORGANIZATION_NAME, NULL AS Total_Rooms, s2.BUILDING_NAME, s2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, 'Top_Building_Area_Range' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 AS s2) SELECT BUILDING_ROOM, MAJOR_USE_DESC, ORGANIZATION_NAME, Total_Rooms, BUILDING_NAME, FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, Reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY BUILDING_NAME, Reason

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.SCHOOL_CODE, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA'), cte1 AS (SELECT inner_cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte1.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte1.window_column, inner_cte1.SCHOOL_CODE, inner_cte1.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS SCHOOL_NAME_DEPT, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte1 LEFT JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON inner_cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_CODE, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS > 1), cte2 AS (SELECT SCHOOL_CODE, SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(window_column) AS highest_running_sum_total_units FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY SCHOOL_CODE, SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cte1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, cte1.SUBJECT_CODE, cte1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, cte1.window_column, cte1.SCHOOL_CODE, cte1.SCHOOL_NAME, cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, cte1.SCHOOL_NAME_DEPT, cte1.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, cte2.highest_running_sum_total_units FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.SCHOOL_CODE = cte2.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY cte1.SUBJECT_CODE

WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t2.TERM_START_DATE FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N') SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, Activity_Counts.Total_Activities FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS Total_Activities FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS Activity_Counts ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = Activity_Counts.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS activity_count, MIN(d.FEE) AS min_fee FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE) SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, AVG(d.FEE) AS avg_fee, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS total_activities FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, NULL AS IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, NULL AS IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, NULL AS avg_fee, NULL AS total_activities_sponsor, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.TERM_START_DATE, s1.Total_Activities, 'IAP Activity' AS Source FROM Subquery1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS ACTIVITY_TITLE, s2.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s2.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, s2.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, s2.avg_fee, s2.total_activities AS total_activities_sponsor, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS TERM_START_DATE, NULL AS Total_Activities, 'Category Sponsor' AS Source FROM Subquery2 AS s2) SELECT ACTIVITY_TITLE, ENROLLMENT_TYPE, IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, avg_fee, total_activities_sponsor, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TERM_START_DATE, Total_Activities, Source FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY ENROLLMENT_TYPE, Source, ACTIVITY_TITLE, IAP_CATEGORY_NAME

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS hr_org_unit_count, SUM(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS total_department_id FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS f JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID > 100000 GROUP BY f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME), OrgUnitDetails AS (SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS f JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID > 100000), RollupResults AS (SELECT i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, SUM(i.hr_org_unit_count) AS hr_org_unit_count, SUM(i.total_department_id) AS total_department_id FROM inner_cte1 AS i LEFT JOIN OrgUnitDetails AS o ON i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY AND i.ORGANIZATION_NAME = o.ORGANIZATION_NAME AND i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(i.hr_org_unit_count) > 0), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT t1.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.DEPT_COUNT, t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, t2.RESEARCH_VOLUME FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN `SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE` AS t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DEPT_NAMES WHERE t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500), SpaceUnitStats AS (SELECT space_unit_name, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ORGANIZATION_NAME, DEPT_COUNT, NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, MAX(RESEARCH_VOLUME) AS highest_research_volume FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY space_unit_name, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ORGANIZATION_NAME, DEPT_COUNT, NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) SELECT rr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, rr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, rr.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, rr.hr_org_unit_count, rr.total_department_id, sus.space_unit_name, sus.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, sus.DEPT_COUNT, sus.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, sus.highest_research_volume FROM RollupResults AS rr LEFT JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS fo ON rr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY LEFT JOIN SpaceUnitStats AS sus ON fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME = sus.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY rr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, rr.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, sus.space_unit_name

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) - MIN(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_range, VARIANCE(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_stddev FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS isd JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE NOT isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION), Subquery1 AS (SELECT inner_cte1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte1.max_enrollment_range, inner_cte1.max_enrollment_variance, inner_cte1.max_enrollment_stddev, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ata.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte1 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON inner_cte1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t0.CALENDAR_DATE, t0.DAY_OF_WEEK, AVG(t0.CALENDAR_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.CALENDAR_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE) AS window_column FROM `TIME_DAY` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.TERM_START_DATE WHERE t1.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT icte.TERM_CODE, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.TERM_START_DATE, icte.CALENDAR_DATE, icte.DAY_OF_WEEK, icte.window_column, at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at2.LAST_DAY_OF_FINAL_EXAM FROM inner_cte2 AS icte JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at2 ON icte.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE) SELECT s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.max_enrollment_range, s1.max_enrollment_variance, s1.max_enrollment_stddev, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.TERM_CODE, s2.TERM_START_DATE, s2.CALENDAR_DATE, s2.DAY_OF_WEEK, s2.window_column, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.LAST_DAY_OF_FINAL_EXAM FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.TERM_CODE = s2.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s1.max_enrollment_range DESC

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE) AS min_level3_code FROM `MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY` AS m JOIN `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT ic.DLC_NAME, ic.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, ic.org_count, ic.min_level3_code, MAX(m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) AS max_level3_name FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY` AS m ON ic.DLC_NAME = m.DLC_NAME GROUP BY ic.DLC_NAME, ic.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, ic.org_count, ic.min_level3_code), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.ORG_PARENT = 'S H&SS') SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM inner_cte JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t2 ON inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE) SELECT s1.DLC_NAME, s1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, s1.org_count, s1.min_level3_code, s1.max_level3_name, s2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s2.DESCRIPTION, s2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.window_column FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY

WITH iap_activities AS (SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.window_column, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.TERM_CODE FROM (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20) AS inner_cte JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t2 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE), previous_terms AS (SELECT inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous') AS inner_cte) SELECT ia.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ia.window_column AS activity_dense_rank, ia.TERM_DESCRIPTION, pt.TERM_CODE, pt.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS prev_term_description, pt.ACADEMIC_YEAR, pt.window_column AS running_sum_academic_year, pt.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM iap_activities AS ia JOIN previous_terms AS pt ON ia.TERM_CODE = pt.TERM_CODE ORDER BY ia.ACTIVITY_TITLE, pt.ACADEMIC_YEAR

WITH academic_year_variance AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, COUNT(DISTINCT LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS total_library_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME), sponsor_type_variance AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SPONSOR_TYPE, s.SPONSOR_NAME, s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, VARIANCE(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR` AS s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND NOT d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL GROUP BY s.SPONSOR_TYPE, s.SPONSOR_NAME, s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY) SELECT i.SPONSOR_TYPE, i.SPONSOR_NAME, i.max_enrollment_variance FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT SPONSOR_TYPE FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR` GROUP BY SPONSOR_TYPE) AS t ON i.SPONSOR_TYPE = t.SPONSOR_TYPE) SELECT ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ayv.enrolled_students_variance, ayv.department_name, ayv.total_library_subjects_offered, stv.SPONSOR_TYPE, stv.SPONSOR_NAME, stv.max_enrollment_variance FROM academic_year_variance AS ayv CROSS JOIN sponsor_type_variance AS stv ORDER BY ayv.enrolled_students_variance DESC, ayv.total_library_subjects_offered DESC, stv.max_enrollment_variance DESC

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, t0.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, t0.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS t0 JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND t0.TERM_CODE = '2009SP') SELECT inner_cte.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, inner_cte.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, inner_cte.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM inner_cte), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, sos.COURSE_NUMBER, lso.SUBJECT_ID, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS lso JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0), dept_avg AS (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` WHERE TERM_CODE = '2014FA' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, icte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, icte.TOTAL_UNITS, icte.window_column, CASE WHEN icte.TOTAL_UNITS > da.avg_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_LOAD' WHEN icte.TOTAL_UNITS < da.avg_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_LOAD' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_load_category, icte.SUBJECT_ID FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN dept_avg AS da ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = da.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) SELECT s1.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, s1.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, s1.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s1.window_column AS reserve_window_column, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.window_column AS units_window_column, s2.unit_load_category FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s1.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.SCHOOL_CODE FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.window_column, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, inner_cte.SCHOOL_CODE FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_CODE, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS > 1) SELECT SCHOOL_CODE, SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(window_column) AS highest_running_sum_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_CODE, SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s1.window_column AS min_num_enrolled_students_per_subject_code, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, s2.highest_running_sum_total_units FROM subq1 AS s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.SCHOOL_CODE = s2.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_CODE

WITH orgs_with_parent AS (SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS Org_Name, inner_cte.DESCRIPTION AS Org_Description, parent_org.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS Parent_Org_Name, parent_org.DESCRIPTION AS Parent_Org_Description, inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DESCRIPTION, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORG_PARENT_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` ON FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.DLC_KEY = 'D_MECHE' AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5) AS inner_cte LEFT JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS parent_org ON inner_cte.FCLT_ORG_PARENT_KEY = parent_org.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY), orgs_with_rank AS (SELECT inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.DLC_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, fo.DESCRIPTION, CASE WHEN fo.ASSIGNABLE = 1 THEN 'ASSIGNABLE' ELSE 'NOT_ASSIGNABLE' END AS assignable_status FROM (SELECT t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.DLC_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DLC_NAME ORDER BY t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS window_column FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.DLC_KEY = 'D_MECHE') AS inner_cte JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS fo ON inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT owp.Org_Name, owp.Org_Description, owp.Parent_Org_Name, owp.Parent_Org_Description, owr.DLC_NAME, owr.window_column, owr.DESCRIPTION AS Org_Description_Rank, owr.assignable_status FROM orgs_with_parent AS owp JOIN orgs_with_rank AS owr ON owp.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = owr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY

WITH dept_ranks AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM `MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY` AS t0 INNER JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area') SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME LIKE '%Science%'), org_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, inner_cte.window_column, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t1 ON inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) SELECT org_stats.ORGANIZATION_NAME, org_stats.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, org_stats.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, org_stats.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, org_stats.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, org_stats.window_column AS ORG_KEY_AVG, org_stats.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, org_stats.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, dept_ranks.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, dept_ranks.window_column AS DEPT_RANK FROM org_stats JOIN dept_ranks ON org_stats.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE = dept_ranks.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE

WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT l.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, l.TERM_CODE, l.SUBJECT_ID, t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t.ISBN, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MIN(t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) OVER (ORDER BY s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS l JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') SELECT inner_cte.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, inner_cte.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, inner_cte.ISBN, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.window_column, ReserveCounts.Total_Reserve_Materials FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(*) AS Total_Reserve_Materials FROM `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` WHERE LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY SUBJECT_ID) AS ReserveCounts ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = ReserveCounts.SUBJECT_ID), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_DESCRIPTION) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY academic_year_sort, term_code_sort) = ACADEMIC_YEAR THEN NULL ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year, academic_year_desc, term_code, term_description, record_count_variance, record_count_stddev FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 9999 ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_code_sort, ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, VARIANCE(record_count_variance) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(record_count_stddev) AS record_count_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY academic_year_sort, term_code_sort) SELECT s1.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, s1.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s1.ISBN, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.window_column, s1.Total_Reserve_Materials, s2.academic_year, s2.academic_year_desc, s2.term_code, s2.term_description, s2.record_count_variance, s2.record_count_stddev FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.TERM_CODE = s2.term_code

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME), subquery1 AS (SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t1.record_count_variance, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Represented_Department, t2.Subject_Count FROM (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(record_count_variance) AS record_count_variance FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC LIMIT 1) AS t1 JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS t2 ON t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND t2.rn = 1 ORDER BY t1.record_count_variance DESC), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_CODE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ'), subquery2 AS (SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(academic_year) OVER (ORDER BY academic_year_sort, min_term_code) = academic_year THEN NULL ELSE academic_year END AS academic_year, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, material_count, min_term_code FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS material_count, MIN(TERM_CODE) AS min_term_code FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY academic_year_sort, min_term_code), CombinedResults AS (SELECT 'Highest Variance Year' AS Result_Type, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.record_count_variance, s1.Most_Represented_Department, s1.Subject_Count, NULL AS TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, NULL AS TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS TERM_CODE, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS material_count, NULL AS min_term_code FROM subquery1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT 'Textbook Materials' AS Result_Type, s2.academic_year, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS record_count_variance, NULL AS Most_Represented_Department, NULL AS Subject_Count, s2.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.TERM_CODE, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.material_count, s2.min_term_code FROM subquery2 AS s2) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY Result_Type, academic_year, min_term_code

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE) AS min_level3_code FROM `MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY` AS m JOIN `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY), provost_dept_stats AS (SELECT inner_cte1.DLC_NAME, inner_cte1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, inner_cte1.org_count, inner_cte1.min_level3_code, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, m.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte1 JOIN `MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY` AS m ON inner_cte1.DLC_NAME = m.DLC_NAME), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DLC_KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM `MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY` AS t0 JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME = 'Sloan School of Management Area'), sloan_dept_stats AS (SELECT inner_cte2.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.window_column, t0.DLC_NAME, inner_cte2.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte2 JOIN `MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY` AS t0 ON inner_cte2.DLC_KEY = t0.DLC_KEY) SELECT pds.DLC_NAME, pds.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, pds.org_count, pds.min_level3_code, pds.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, sds.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, sds.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sds.window_column, sds.DLC_NAME AS SLOAN_DLC_NAME FROM provost_dept_stats AS pds JOIN sloan_dept_stats AS sds ON pds.DLC_KEY = sds.DLC_KEY ORDER BY pds.DLC_NAME, sds.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2022FA') SELECT icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.window_column, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t2 ON icte.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID AND t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA'), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT td.TERM_CODE, td.SUBJECT_ID, MIN(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS min_record_count, SUM(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS total_new_shelf_price FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS td JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL` AS tm ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE NOT tm.AUTHOR IS NULL AND tm.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE = 'ISBN' GROUP BY td.TERM_CODE, td.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.min_record_count, inner_cte.total_new_shelf_price FROM inner_cte) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM, s2.min_record_count, s2.total_new_shelf_price FROM subq1 AS s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_ID

WITH DepartmentSuperviseeStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT AS department_name, AVG(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS avg_supervisees, MAX(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) - MIN(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS supervisee_range, VARIANCE(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS supervisee_variance FROM `SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE` JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` ON SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.DEPT_NAMES = SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT) SELECT inner_cte.department_name, inner_cte.avg_supervisees, inner_cte.supervisee_range, inner_cte.supervisee_variance, SUM(SSU.SQFT) AS total_sqft, SUM(SSU.RESEARCH_VOLUME) AS total_research_volume, MAX(SU.DLC_KEY) AS department_dlc_key FROM inner_cte JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS SU ON inner_cte.department_name = SU.SPACE_UNIT JOIN `SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE` AS SSU ON SU.DLC_KEY = SSU.DEPT_NAMES GROUP BY inner_cte.department_name, inner_cte.avg_supervisees, inner_cte.supervisee_range, inner_cte.supervisee_variance), SpaceUnitOrgStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name, t1.DLC_NAME AS dlc_name, t1.DLC_KEY AS org_dlc_key, MIN(t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_min_space_unit_code, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500) SELECT inner_cte.space_unit_name, inner_cte.organization_name, inner_cte.dlc_name, inner_cte.org_dlc_key, inner_cte.window_min_space_unit_code, COUNT(su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS total_space_units_for_org, inner_cte.org_dlc_key AS join_dlc_key FROM inner_cte JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS su ON inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY GROUP BY inner_cte.space_unit_name, inner_cte.organization_name, inner_cte.dlc_name, inner_cte.org_dlc_key, inner_cte.window_min_space_unit_code) SELECT dss.department_name, dss.avg_supervisees, dss.supervisee_range, dss.supervisee_variance, dss.total_sqft, dss.total_research_volume, sus.space_unit_name, sus.organization_name, sus.dlc_name, sus.org_dlc_key, sus.window_min_space_unit_code, sus.total_space_units_for_org FROM DepartmentSuperviseeStats AS dss JOIN SpaceUnitOrgStats AS sus ON dss.department_dlc_key = sus.join_dlc_key ORDER BY dss.supervisee_range DESC, sus.total_space_units_for_org DESC

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous') SELECT TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, window_column, FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` WHERE TERM_STATUS = 'Previous') ORDER BY FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA') SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.window_column FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at2 ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND at2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA' WHERE at2.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y') SELECT s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS PREV_TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS PREV_ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.window_column AS PREV_RUNNING_SUM, s1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS SUBJECT_TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS SUBJECT_ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.window_column AS SUBJECT_RANK FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.SUBJECT_ID

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous') SELECT TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, window_column, FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` WHERE TERM_STATUS = 'Previous')), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA') SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.window_column FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at2 ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND at2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA' WHERE at2.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y') SELECT s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS PREV_TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS PREV_ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.window_column AS PREV_RUNNING_SUM, s1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS SUBJECT_TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS SUBJECT_ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.window_column AS SUBJECT_RANK, ROUND(s1.window_column / NULLIF(s2.window_column, 0), 2) AS Normalized_RunningSum_to_SubjectRank FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.SUBJECT_ID

WITH org_stats_by_dlc_orgname AS (SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL > 4 GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME), prominent_major_org AS (SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.MAJOR_ORG, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS Major_Org_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) DESC) AS rn FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL > 4 GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.MAJOR_ORG), dlc_org_stats AS (SELECT ic.DLC_KEY, fo.DLC_NAME, ic.org_count_range, ic.org_count_variance, ic.org_count_stddev, org_totals.total_organizations FROM (SELECT fdlk.DLC_KEY, MAX(org_count) - MIN(org_count) AS org_count_range, VARIANCE(org_count) AS org_count_variance, STDDEV(org_count) AS org_count_stddev FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS fdlk JOIN (SELECT fo.DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS org_count FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS fo WHERE NOT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY fo.DLC_KEY) AS org_stats ON fdlk.DLC_KEY = org_stats.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT fdlk.DLC_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY fdlk.DLC_KEY) AS ic JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS fo ON ic.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN (SELECT DLC_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_organizations FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` WHERE NOT ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NULL AND NOT DLC_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY DLC_KEY) AS org_totals ON ic.DLC_KEY = org_totals.DLC_KEY GROUP BY ic.DLC_KEY, fo.DLC_NAME, ic.org_count_range, ic.org_count_variance, ic.org_count_stddev, org_totals.total_organizations) SELECT o.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.organization_count, o.min_organization_number, pmo.MAJOR_ORG AS Most_Prominent_Major_Org, pmo.Major_Org_Count, d.DLC_NAME, d.org_count_range, d.org_count_variance, d.org_count_stddev, d.total_organizations FROM org_stats_by_dlc_orgname AS o LEFT JOIN prominent_major_org AS pmo ON o.DLC_KEY = pmo.DLC_KEY AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME = pmo.ORGANIZATION_NAME AND pmo.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN dlc_org_stats AS d ON o.DLC_KEY = d.DLC_KEY ORDER BY o.organization_count DESC

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_avg_total_units FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME), cte1 AS (SELECT inner_cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.dept_avg_total_units, (inner_cte1.dept_avg_total_units - overall.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM inner_cte1 JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(dept_avg_total_units) AS avg_total_units FROM (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_avg_total_units FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_avgs GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS overall ON inner_cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = overall.ACADEMIC_YEAR), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, MAX(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_CODE FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y'), cte2 AS (SELECT inner_cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, inner_cte2.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, t2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte2.TERM_CODE, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_ID FROM inner_cte2 JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t2 ON inner_cte2.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte2.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.dept_avg_total_units, cte1.deviation_from_overall_avg, cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cte2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS SUBJECT_ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, cte2.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, cte2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t0.TERM_START_DATE, t0.TERM_END_DATE, MIN(t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TERM_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND t1.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.TERM_END_DATE, inner_cte.window_column, t1.IS_CURRENT_TERM, t2.IS_REGULAR_TERM FROM inner_cte JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS t1 ON inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION = t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units, s.benchmark_enrollment, CASE WHEN i.min_total_units > s.benchmark_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.min_total_units < s.benchmark_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS benchmark_enrollment FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS s ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.TERM_START_DATE, s1.TERM_END_DATE, s1.window_column, s1.IS_CURRENT_TERM, s1.IS_REGULAR_TERM, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.subject_count, s2.min_total_units, s2.benchmark_enrollment, s2.enrollment_category FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON t.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept, sos.COURSE_NUMBER AS join_course FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS lso JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0), cte1 AS (SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TOTAL_UNITS, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_units_window, join_dept, join_course FROM inner_cte1), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS l JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME), cte2 AS (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(subject_count) AS total_subjects, MIN(min_total_units) AS min_total_units FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(subject_count) > 0 ORDER BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cte1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, cte1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, cte1.TOTAL_UNITS, cte1.max_units_window, cte2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, cte2.total_subjects, cte2.min_total_units FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.join_dept = cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND cte1.join_course = cte2.COURSE_NUMBER ORDER BY cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME

WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, inner_cte.window_column, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t1 ON inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1) SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(LENGTH(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME)) AS longest_department_name_length FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, s1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, s1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, s1.window_column, s1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, s1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, NULL AS longest_department_name_length, 'Windowed' AS Source FROM Subquery1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, NULL AS HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, NULL AS window_column, NULL AS HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, s2.longest_department_name_length, 'LongestDeptName' AS Source FROM Subquery2 AS s2) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, Source

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM `MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY` AS t0 INNER JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area'), DeptRanked AS (SELECT inner_cte1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, inner_cte1.window_column, t2.DLC_NAME, inner_cte1.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte1 INNER JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t2 ON inner_cte1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT t1.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.DEPT_COUNT, t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, t2.RESEARCH_VOLUME, t1.DLC_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN `SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE` AS t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DEPT_NAMES WHERE t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500), SpaceStats AS (SELECT space_unit_name, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ORGANIZATION_NAME, DEPT_COUNT, NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, MAX(RESEARCH_VOLUME) AS highest_research_volume, DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY space_unit_name, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ORGANIZATION_NAME, DEPT_COUNT, NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, DLC_KEY) SELECT d.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, d.window_column, d.DLC_NAME, s.space_unit_name, s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, s.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s.DEPT_COUNT, s.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, s.highest_research_volume FROM DeptRanked AS d JOIN SpaceStats AS s ON d.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY ORDER BY d.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, s.space_unit_name

WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS so JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' ORDER BY icte.subject_count DESC, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ISBN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.TERM_CODE, i.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, i.ISBN, l.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS l ON i.SUBJECT_ID = l.SUBJECT_ID AND i.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.subject_count, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.ISBN, s2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s2.window_column FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.TERM_CODE = s2.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s1.subject_count DESC, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.window_column

WITH max_avg_enrollment AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS atp JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON atp.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(avg_enrollment) AS max_avg_subject_enrollment FROM (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS subq GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY max_avg_subject_enrollment DESC), term_window_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t0.TERM_START_DATE, t0.TERM_END_DATE, MIN(t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TERM_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND t1.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.TERM_END_DATE, inner_cte.window_column, Total_Terms.Total_Terms_Per_Year, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.TERM_CODE) AS Total_Terms_Per_Year FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 GROUP BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS Total_Terms ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = Total_Terms.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT tws.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, tws.TERM_DESCRIPTION, tws.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, tws.TERM_START_DATE, tws.TERM_END_DATE, tws.window_column, tws.Total_Terms_Per_Year, mae.max_avg_subject_enrollment FROM term_window_stats AS tws JOIN max_avg_enrollment AS mae ON tws.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mae.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY tws.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, tws.TERM_START_DATE

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t0 JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > 12 ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(sp.MIT_ID) AS person_count, MIN(sp.MIT_ID) AS min_mit_id FROM `SE_PERSON` AS sp JOIN `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` AS msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.person_count, inner_cte.min_mit_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT sp.OFFICE_LOCATION SEPARATOR ',') AS unique_office_locations FROM inner_cte JOIN `SE_PERSON` AS sp ON sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = inner_cte.EMPLOYEE_TYPE JOIN `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` AS msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY inner_cte.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.person_count, inner_cte.min_mit_id) SELECT subq1.SUBJECT_CODE, subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.window_column, subq2.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, subq2.person_count, subq2.min_mit_id, subq2.unique_office_locations FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.SUBJECT_CODE, subq2.EMPLOYEE_TYPE

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS min_org_unit_id FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS f JOIN `MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY` AS m ON f.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' GROUP BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(dept_long) OVER (ORDER BY dept_long_sort, hier3_sort) = dept_long THEN NULL ELSE dept_long END AS department_long_name, hier3_name, org_count, min_org_unit_id, max_load_date FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) = 1 AND GROUPING(MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG END AS dept_long_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) = 0 AND GROUPING(MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) = 1 AND GROUPING(MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG END AS dept_long, CASE WHEN GROUPING(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) = 0 AND GROUPING(MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME END AS hier3_sort, MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME AS hier3_name, COUNT(DISTINCT FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS min_org_unit_id, MAX(h.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS max_load_date FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS f JOIN `MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY` AS m ON f.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY dept_long_sort, hier3_sort), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS min_org_unit_id FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS f JOIN `MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY` AS m ON f.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' GROUP BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, inner_cte.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, inner_cte.org_count, inner_cte.min_org_unit_id, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS') SELECT s1.department_long_name, s1.hier3_name, s1.org_count, s1.min_org_unit_id, s1.max_load_date, s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM subq1 AS s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.department_long_name = s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG AND s1.hier3_name = s2.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME AND s1.min_org_unit_id = s2.min_org_unit_id ORDER BY s1.department_long_name, s1.hier3_name

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptSubjectStats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR), ActivitySponsorStats AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s.SPONSOR_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS activity_count, MIN(d.FEE) AS min_fee FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR` AS s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s.SPONSOR_NAME), TermJoin AS (SELECT t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, d.TERM_CODE, d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s.SPONSOR_NAME FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR` AS s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY GROUP BY t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, d.TERM_CODE, d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s.SPONSOR_NAME) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units, ass.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ass.SPONSOR_NAME, ass.activity_count, ass.min_fee FROM DeptSubjectStats AS dss JOIN TermJoin AS tj ON dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR = tj.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN ActivitySponsorStats AS ass ON tj.ACTIVITY_TITLE = ass.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND tj.SPONSOR_NAME = ass.SPONSOR_NAME ORDER BY dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ass.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ass.SPONSOR_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_total_units, inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.SPONSOR_NAME, inner_cte.activity_count, inner_cte.min_fee, s.SPONSOR_TYPE FROM inner_cte JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR` AS s ON inner_cte.SPONSOR_NAME = s.SPONSOR_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.SPONSOR_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS hr_org_unit_count, SUM(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS total_department_id, f.DLC_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS f JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID > 100000 GROUP BY f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, f.DLC_KEY), dept_subdept_stats AS (SELECT m.DLC_NAME, AVG(sub_dept_counts.num_sub_depts) AS avg_num_sub_departments, STDDEV(sub_dept_counts.num_sub_depts) AS stddev_num_sub_departments, m.DLC_KEY FROM `MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY` AS m JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY JOIN (SELECT h2.DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS num_sub_depts FROM `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h2 WHERE h2.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'SUB DEPARTMENT' GROUP BY h2.DLC_KEY) AS sub_dept_counts ON m.DLC_KEY = sub_dept_counts.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT m.DLC_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, m.DLC_KEY ORDER BY stddev_num_sub_departments DESC) SELECT i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.hr_org_unit_count, i.total_department_id, d.DLC_NAME, d.avg_num_sub_departments, d.stddev_num_sub_departments, h.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_subdept_stats AS d ON i.DLC_KEY = d.DLC_KEY JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.hr_org_unit_count, i.total_department_id, d.DLC_NAME, d.avg_num_sub_departments, d.stddev_num_sub_departments, h.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT su.SPACE_USAGE, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME FROM `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd JOIN `SPACE_USAGE` AS su ON sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = su.SPACE_USAGE_KEY WHERE sd.ROOM_COUNTER = 1 AND sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND su.SPACE_USAGE NOT LIKE '%STORAGE%') SELECT icte.SPACE_USAGE, AVG(icte.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS avg_sqft, VARIANCE(icte.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS sqft_variance, max_room.Largest_Room_Name, max_room.Largest_Room_Square_Footage FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN (SELECT SPACE_USAGE, BUILDING_ROOM_NAME AS Largest_Room_Name, ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS Largest_Room_Square_Footage FROM (SELECT SPACE_USAGE, BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SPACE_USAGE ORDER BY ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte) AS ranked WHERE rn = 1) AS max_room ON icte.SPACE_USAGE = max_room.SPACE_USAGE GROUP BY icte.SPACE_USAGE, max_room.Largest_Room_Name, max_room.Largest_Room_Square_Footage ORDER BY sqft_variance DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(t0.RECORD_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ'), IAPActivities AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TERM_START_DATE, MIN(t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.TERM_CODE ORDER BY t0.TERM_CODE) AS window_column FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS t0 JOIN `TIME_DAY` AS t1 ON t1.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE = t0.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10) SELECT icte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, icte.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.window_column AS tip_window_avg_record_count, ia.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ia.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, ia.MAX_ENROLLMENT, ia.ACADEMIC_TERM_DESCRIPTION, ia.TERM_START_DATE, ia.window_column AS iap_min_max_enrollment, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN IAPActivities AS ia ON icte.TERM_CODE = ia.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON icte.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ia.TERM_CODE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, t0.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, AVG(t2.RECORD_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U'), MaterialStatusStats AS (SELECT d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, AVG(c.RECORD_COUNTER) AS avg_record_counter, VARIANCE(c.RECORD_COUNTER) AS record_counter_variance FROM `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG` AS c ON d.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = c.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY WHERE c.CATALOG_YEAR > 2000 GROUP BY d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY record_counter_variance DESC) SELECT ic.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, ic.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, ic.TERM_CODE, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, ic.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ic.window_column, mss.avg_record_counter, mss.record_counter_variance, rc.CATALOG_TITLE, rc.CATALOG_AUTHOR_NAME FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN MaterialStatusStats AS mss ON ic.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = mss.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG` AS rc ON ic.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = rc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY ORDER BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC, mss.record_counter_variance DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptCatalogVariance AS (SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM `LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR` AS lci JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY catalog_key_variance DESC), YearDeptSubjectStats AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT yds.ACADEMIC_YEAR, yds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, yds.subject_count, yds.min_total_units, dcv.catalog_key_variance FROM YearDeptSubjectStats AS yds JOIN DeptCatalogVariance AS dcv ON yds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcv.DEPARTMENT) SELECT icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units, icte.catalog_key_variance, MAX(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units, icte.catalog_key_variance ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH OrgInfo AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS window_column, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DLC_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5), RoomInfo AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.ROOM, t1.SPACE_ID, t1.AREA, t0.MAJOR_USE, t0.DESCRIPTION, MIN(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY) AS min_area_per_major_use, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY FROM `FCLT_MAJOR_USE` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 200 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.ORGANIZATION_ID, o.DLC_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, o.window_column, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.FLOOR, r.ROOM, r.SPACE_ID, r.AREA, r.MAJOR_USE, r.DESCRIPTION, r.min_area_per_major_use, o.DLC_KEY, r.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, (r.AREA - r.min_area_per_major_use) AS area_deviation FROM OrgInfo AS o JOIN RoomInfo AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_ID, inner_cte.DLC_NAME, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.FLOOR, inner_cte.ROOM, inner_cte.SPACE_ID, inner_cte.AREA, inner_cte.MAJOR_USE, inner_cte.DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.min_area_per_major_use, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE AS HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE_FROM_HR, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL AS HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL_FROM_HR, inner_cte.area_deviation FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON inner_cte.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY ORDER BY inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.MAJOR_USE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS window_column FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5), LargeAssignableRooms AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.ROOM, t1.SPACE_ID, t1.AREA, t0.MAJOR_USE, t0.DESCRIPTION, MIN(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY) AS min_area_per_major_use, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM `FCLT_MAJOR_USE` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 200 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.ORGANIZATION_ID, o.DLC_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, o.window_column, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.FLOOR, r.ROOM, r.SPACE_ID, r.AREA, r.MAJOR_USE, r.DESCRIPTION, r.min_area_per_major_use, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE FROM inner_cte AS o JOIN LargeAssignableRooms AS r ON o.ORGANIZATION_ID = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON o.DLC_NAME = h.DLC_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH OrgWindowed AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.DLC_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.ORG_PARENT = 'S H&SS'), SpaceUnitStats AS (SELECT t1.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.DEPT_COUNT, t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, AVG(t2.DEPT_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPT_COUNT ORDER BY t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS avg_dept_count_within_group, t2.SQFT, t1.DLC_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN `SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE` AS t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DEPT_NAMES WHERE t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500) SELECT ow.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ow.DESCRIPTION, ow.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, ow.window_column, sus.space_unit_name, sus.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, sus.DEPT_COUNT, sus.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, sus.avg_dept_count_within_group, sus.SQFT FROM OrgWindowed AS ow JOIN SpaceUnitStats AS sus ON ow.DLC_KEY = sus.DLC_KEY) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(ORGANIZATION_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY org_sort, space_unit_name) = ORGANIZATION_NAME THEN NULL ELSE ORGANIZATION_NAME END AS organization_name, DESCRIPTION, HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, window_column, space_unit_name, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, DEPT_COUNT, NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, avg_dept_count_within_group, SQFT, SUM(SQFT) OVER (PARTITION BY ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS total_sqft_per_org FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ORGANIZATION_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(space_unit_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ORGANIZATION_NAME END AS org_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ORGANIZATION_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(space_unit_name) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ORGANIZATION_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(space_unit_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE ORGANIZATION_NAME END AS ORGANIZATION_NAME, DESCRIPTION, HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, window_column, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ORGANIZATION_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(space_unit_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE space_unit_name END AS space_unit_sort, space_unit_name, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, DEPT_COUNT, NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, avg_dept_count_within_group, SQFT FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, DESCRIPTION, HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, window_column, space_unit_name, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, DEPT_COUNT, NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, avg_dept_count_within_group, SQFT WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY org_sort, space_unit_sort

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sp.FULL_NAME AS student_name, MIN(sp.MIT_ID) AS min_mit_id, AVG(msd.DEPARTMENT) AS avg_department_number FROM `SE_PERSON` AS sp JOIN `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` AS msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE ((sp.MIT_ID BETWEEN 921145998 AND 999756146) OR (msd.DEPARTMENT >= 4)) AND msd.DEPARTMENT BETWEEN 4 AND 6 AND sp.ORGANIZATION = 'Electrical Engineering-Computer Science' AND msd.DEPARTMENT = 6 GROUP BY sp.FULL_NAME) SELECT ic.student_name, ic.min_mit_id, ic.avg_department_number, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` AS msd ON ic.student_name = msd.FULL_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH SubjectStddev AS (SELECT sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS so JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON so.COMPOSITE_SUBJECT_KEY = sos.COMPOSITE_SUBJECT_KEY WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' GROUP BY sos.SUBJECT_TITLE HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY total_units_stddev DESC), SubjectWindow AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, MIN(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t0 JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog') SELECT sw.SUBJECT_TITLE, sw.SUBJECT_ID, sw.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sw.ACADEMIC_YEAR, sw.TERM_DESCRIPTION, sw.window_column, ss.total_units_stddev FROM SubjectWindow AS sw JOIN SubjectStddev AS ss ON sw.SUBJECT_TITLE = ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.window_column, icte.total_units_stddev, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS so ON icte.SUBJECT_TITLE = so.SUBJECT_TITLE JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON so.COMPOSITE_SUBJECT_KEY = sos.COMPOSITE_SUBJECT_KEY WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' GROUP BY icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.window_column, icte.total_units_stddev
