WITH inner_cte AS (WITH ProvostAreaDepts AS (SELECT m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE) AS min_level3_code FROM `MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY` AS m JOIN `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY), FacilityOrgStats AS (SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, MAX(hr_unit_count) - MIN(hr_unit_count) AS org_unit_count_range, VARIANCE(hr_unit_count) AS org_unit_count_variance, STDDEV(hr_unit_count) AS org_unit_count_stddev FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS f JOIN `MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY` AS m ON f.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY JOIN (SELECT h.DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS hr_unit_count FROM `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h WHERE NOT h.DLC_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY h.DLC_KEY) AS hr_stats ON m.DLC_KEY = hr_stats.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT f.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' GROUP BY f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY org_unit_count_range DESC), CombinedProvostFacility AS (SELECT p.DLC_NAME, p.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, p.org_count, p.min_level3_code, f.org_unit_count_range, f.org_unit_count_variance, f.org_unit_count_stddev FROM ProvostAreaDepts AS p JOIN FacilityOrgStats AS f ON p.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT * FROM CombinedProvostFacility) SELECT i.DLC_NAME, i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.org_count, i.min_level3_code, i.org_unit_count_range, i.org_unit_count_variance, i.org_unit_count_stddev, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS f ON i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON f.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT h.DLC_KEY IS NULL ORDER BY i.DLC_NAME, i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptVariation AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `STUDENT_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), Subjects2017JA AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `STUDENT_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA') SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.window_column, dv.coefficient_of_variation, sd.SCHOOL_CODE FROM Subjects2017JA AS s LEFT JOIN DeptVariation AS dv ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN `STUDENT_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT * FROM inner_cte

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS avg_hr_dept_code, MAX(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) - MIN(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS hr_dept_code_range, VARIANCE(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS hr_dept_code_variance, fo.DLC_KEY FROM `SPACE_UNIT` AS su JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND hou.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '03-DEC-24' GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.DLC_KEY ORDER BY hr_dept_code_range DESC), OrgStats AS (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS avg_dept_code_old, VARIANCE(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS var_dept_code_old, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = HR_ORG_UNIT.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND NOT HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY ORDER BY var_dept_code_old DESC), CombinedStats AS (SELECT s.SPACE_UNIT, s.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s.avg_hr_dept_code, s.hr_dept_code_range, s.hr_dept_code_variance, o.avg_dept_code_old, o.var_dept_code_old, s.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte AS s JOIN OrgStats AS o ON s.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(cs.SPACE_UNIT) OVER (ORDER BY cs.hr_dept_code_range DESC, cs.var_dept_code_old DESC, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE) = cs.SPACE_UNIT THEN NULL ELSE cs.SPACE_UNIT END AS SPACE_UNIT, cs.ORGANIZATION_NAME, cs.avg_hr_dept_code, cs.hr_dept_code_range, cs.hr_dept_code_variance, cs.avg_dept_code_old, cs.var_dept_code_old, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL FROM CombinedStats AS cs JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS hou ON cs.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY AND hou.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '03-DEC-24' ORDER BY cs.hr_dept_code_range DESC, cs.var_dept_code_old DESC, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH CurrentTermSummary AS (SELECT atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollment FROM `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS atp JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR), CurrentTermSubjects AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM') SELECT cts.TERM_CODE, cts.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cts.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cts.subject_count, cts.total_enrollment, csub.SUBJECT_TITLE, csub.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, csub.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, csub.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, csub.window_column, csub.SUBJECT_ID FROM CurrentTermSummary AS cts JOIN CurrentTermSubjects AS csub ON cts.TERM_CODE = csub.TERM_CODE) SELECT inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.total_enrollment, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.window_column, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR), ActivitySponsorStats AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s.SPONSOR_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS activity_count, MIN(d.FEE) AS min_fee, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SPONSOR_TYPE) AS sponsor_type_count, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR` AS s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s.SPONSOR_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units, ass.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ass.SPONSOR_NAME, ass.activity_count, ass.min_fee, ass.sponsor_type_count FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN ActivitySponsorStats AS ass ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ass.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ass.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ass.SPONSOR_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM'), person_role_enrollment_stats AS (SELECT p.PERSON_ROLE, AVG(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, MAX(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) - MIN(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_range, VARIANCE(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance, COUNT(*) AS total_activities_led FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON` AS p JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d ON p.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND NOT d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL GROUP BY p.PERSON_ROLE ORDER BY max_enrollment_range DESC) SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s.window_column, p.PERSON_ROLE, p.avg_max_enrollment, p.max_enrollment_range, p.max_enrollment_variance, p.total_activities_led FROM inner_cte AS s CROSS JOIN person_role_enrollment_stats AS p

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, s.SESSION_TITLE, s.SESSION_LOCATION, s.SESSION_DATE, s.SESSION_START_TIME, s.SESSION_END_TIME, MIN(s.SESSION_START_TIME) OVER (PARTITION BY s.SESSION_LOCATION ORDER BY s.SESSION_LOCATION) AS min_start_time_per_location, d.TERM_CODE FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION` AS s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY WHERE d.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N') SELECT i.ACTIVITY_TITLE, i.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, i.MAX_ENROLLMENT, i.SESSION_TITLE, i.SESSION_LOCATION, i.SESSION_DATE, i.SESSION_START_TIME, i.SESSION_END_TIME, i.min_start_time_per_location, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, CASE WHEN i.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 50 THEN 'HIGH_CAPACITY' WHEN i.MAX_ENROLLMENT < 25 THEN 'LOW_CAPACITY' ELSE 'MEDIUM_CAPACITY' END AS capacity_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `TIME_DAY` AS t0 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE = i.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 ON i.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20 ORDER BY i.SESSION_LOCATION

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, t0.ROOM_FULL_NAME, t0.AREA, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DEPT_CODE, t1.NUM_OF_ROOMS FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t0.AREA > 300 AND t1.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 100) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(BUILDING_NAME_LONG) OVER (ORDER BY building_sort, org_sort) = BUILDING_NAME_LONG THEN NULL ELSE BUILDING_NAME_LONG END AS building_name_long, ORGANIZATION_NAME, room_count, avg_area, SPACE_UNIT, org_number_variance, org_number_stddev, DEPT_CODE FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(BUILDING_NAME_LONG) = 1 AND GROUPING(ORGANIZATION_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE BUILDING_NAME_LONG END AS building_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(BUILDING_NAME_LONG) = 0 AND GROUPING(ORGANIZATION_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(BUILDING_NAME_LONG) = 1 AND GROUPING(ORGANIZATION_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE BUILDING_NAME_LONG END AS BUILDING_NAME_LONG, CASE WHEN GROUPING(BUILDING_NAME_LONG) = 0 AND GROUPING(ORGANIZATION_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ORGANIZATION_NAME END AS org_sort, ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ROOM_FULL_NAME) AS room_count, AVG(AREA) AS avg_area, MAX(SPACE_UNIT) AS SPACE_UNIT, VARIANCE(ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance, STDDEV(ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev, MAX(DEPT_CODE) AS DEPT_CODE FROM inner_cte AS rw JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON rw.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS s ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND NOT s.DLC_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY BUILDING_NAME_LONG, ORGANIZATION_NAME WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY building_sort, org_sort

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT su.SPACE_USAGE, sd.BUILDING_ROOM, VARIANCE(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS variance_square_footage FROM `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd JOIN `SPACE_USAGE` AS su ON sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = su.SPACE_USAGE_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = '32' AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 10 AND su.SPACE_USAGE NOT LIKE '%STORAGE%' GROUP BY su.SPACE_USAGE, sd.BUILDING_ROOM) SELECT SPACE_USAGE, MAX(variance_square_footage) AS highest_variance_square_footage FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SPACE_USAGE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t2.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, MIN(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') SELECT icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.TERM_START_DATE, icte.window_column AS min_academic_year_window, lso.COURSE_NUMBER, lso.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS dense_rank_material_status, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrm ON icte.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY AND icte.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID JOIN `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS lso ON lrm.SUBJECT_ID = lso.SUBJECT_ID AND lrm.TERM_CODE = lso.TERM_CODE WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS subcnt, MIN(MEET_TIME) AS mintime, AVG(CASE WHEN equivalent_subjects IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 + LENGTH(equivalent_subjects) - LENGTH(REPLACE(equivalent_subjects, ',', '')) END) AS avgeqisub FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` GROUP BY TERM_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, term, dept_sort) = term THEN NULL ELSE term END AS term, dept, subcnt, avgeqisub, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone, COALESCE(mat.material_count, 0) AS num_required_or_optional_materials FROM inner_cte AS tbltmp LEFT JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.TERM_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t ON c.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID AND c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IN ('RQ', 'EO') GROUP BY c.TERM_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS mat ON tbltmp.term = mat.TERM_CODE AND tbltmp.dept = mat.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH OrgLevel5 AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5), RoomsFloor2 AS (SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.SPACE_USAGE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(t0.ACCESS_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM `ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2), CombinedResults AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.DESCRIPTION, o.SPACE_UNIT, o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, o.window_column AS org_window_column, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.SPACE_USAGE, r.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, r.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.window_column AS room_window_column, r.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM OrgLevel5 AS o JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS su ON o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY JOIN RoomsFloor2 AS r ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = r.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) SELECT cr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, cr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, cr.DESCRIPTION, cr.SPACE_UNIT, cr.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, cr.org_window_column, cr.BUILDING_ROOM, cr.SPACE_USAGE, cr.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, cr.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, cr.room_window_column, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM CombinedResults AS cr JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON cr.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) SELECT * FROM inner_cte ORDER BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, BUILDING_ROOM

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH subq1 AS (SELECT r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count, MIN(r.FLOOR) AS min_floor, r.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 100 AND r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY), subq2 AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.ROOM, t1.SPACE_ID, t1.AREA, t0.MAJOR_USE, t0.DESCRIPTION, MIN(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY) AS min_area_per_major_use, t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM `FCLT_MAJOR_USE` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 200 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1) SELECT s1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s1.room_count, s1.min_floor, s2.BUILDING_ROOM, s2.FLOOR, s2.ROOM, s2.SPACE_ID, s2.AREA, s2.MAJOR_USE, s2.DESCRIPTION, s2.min_area_per_major_use, s1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = s2.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY AND s1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT inner_cte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.room_count, inner_cte.min_floor, inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.FLOOR, inner_cte.ROOM, inner_cte.SPACE_ID, inner_cte.AREA, inner_cte.MAJOR_USE, inner_cte.DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.min_area_per_major_use, fo.DESCRIPTION AS organization_description FROM inner_cte JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS fo ON inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY inner_cte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.MAJOR_USE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC), TermInfo AS (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_PARAMETER, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, AVG(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TERM_INDICATOR ORDER BY t0.TERM_START_DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_INDICATOR = 'P'), DeptSubjects AS (SELECT t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cco.DEPARTMENT_CODE, cco.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT cco.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS cco ON t0.TERM_CODE = cco.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cco.DEPARTMENT_CODE, cco.DEPARTMENT_NAME), RollupResults AS (SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.avg_total_units, i.stddev_total_units, t.TERM_CODE, t.TERM_PARAMETER, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.TERM_START_DATE, t.window_column, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.num_subjects FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN TermInfo AS t ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = t.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN DeptSubjects AS d ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR UNION ALL SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(d.num_subjects) FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN DeptSubjects AS d ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR GROUP BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT * FROM RollupResults ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_CODE, TERM_START_DATE, TERM_CODE

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH GeometricMeanMaterialsPerSubject AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(material_count))) AS geometric_mean_materials_per_subject FROM (SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE FROM `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE) AS sub JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` ON sub.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), GeometricMeanDegreeYear AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(ACADEMIC_TERMS.DEGREE_YEAR))) AS geometric_mean_degree_year FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.DEGREE_YEAR > 1900 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), GeometricMeanFinancialAidYear AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(ACADEMIC_TERMS.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR))) AS geometric_mean_financial_aid_year FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR > 1900 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), CombinedGeometricMeans AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, NULL AS geometric_mean_degree_year, NULL AS geometric_mean_financial_aid_year, 'MaterialsPerSubject' AS Reason FROM GeometricMeanMaterialsPerSubject UNION ALL SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, geometric_mean_degree_year, NULL AS geometric_mean_financial_aid_year, 'DegreeYear' AS Reason FROM GeometricMeanDegreeYear UNION ALL SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, NULL AS geometric_mean_degree_year, geometric_mean_financial_aid_year, 'FinancialAidYear' AS Reason FROM GeometricMeanFinancialAidYear) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, geometric_mean_degree_year, geometric_mean_financial_aid_year, Reason FROM CombinedGeometricMeans ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, Reason) SELECT * FROM inner_cte

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH dept_variance AS (SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM `LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR` AS lci JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY catalog_key_variance DESC), subject_window AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12) SELECT sw.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dv.catalog_key_variance, COUNT(*) AS num_subjects, AVG(sw.window_column) AS avg_subject_enrollment FROM subject_window AS sw LEFT JOIN dept_variance AS dv ON sw.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dv.DEPARTMENT GROUP BY sw.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dv.catalog_key_variance) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, catalog_key_variance, num_subjects, avg_subject_enrollment FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_subject_enrollment > (SELECT AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12) ORDER BY avg_subject_enrollment DESC, catalog_key_variance DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_PARAMETER, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, AVG(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TERM_INDICATOR ORDER BY t0.TERM_START_DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_INDICATOR = 'P'), AcademicYearVariation AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0), DepartmentCounts AS (SELECT t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS num_departments FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c ON t0.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT icte.TERM_CODE, icte.TERM_PARAMETER, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.TERM_START_DATE, icte.window_column, ayv.coefficient_of_variation, dc.num_departments FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN AcademicYearVariation AS ayv ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN DepartmentCounts AS dc ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dc.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.TERM_CODE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SCHOOL_CODE) AS window_column FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS t0 JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT t0.SCHOOL_CODE IS NULL AND NOT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NULL), eng_degree_courses AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS t0 JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'), subject_course_counts AS (SELECT icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(edc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS degree_course_count FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN eng_degree_courses AS edc ON icte.SUBJECT_CODE = edc.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME), most_recent_course AS (SELECT edc.SUBJECT_CODE, edc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, edc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, edc.SUBJECT_TITLE, edc.LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY edc.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY edc.LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE DESC) AS rn FROM eng_degree_courses AS edc) SELECT scc.SUBJECT_CODE, scc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scc.degree_course_count, mrc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, mrc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS COURSE_DEPARTMENT_NAME, mrc.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM subject_course_counts AS scc LEFT JOIN most_recent_course AS mrc ON scc.SUBJECT_CODE = mrc.SUBJECT_CODE AND mrc.rn = 1 ORDER BY scc.degree_course_count DESC LIMIT 10

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t1 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.Subject_Count, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccat.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS s ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND s.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccat ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccat.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND s.SUBJECT_TITLE = ccat.SUBJECT_TITLE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS = (SELECT MAX(s2.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS s2 WHERE s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND s2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND s2.TOTAL_UNITS = 12) ORDER BY icte.Subject_Count DESC, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE LIMIT 10

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS t0 JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t0.CLUSTER_TYPE = 'S'), Subquery1 AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_KEY, t3.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS offering_count, NULL AS total_units, SUM(t3.LAB_UNITS) AS total_lab_units, s.window_column, 'Cluster S Dense Rank' AS Reason FROM inner_cte AS s JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t1 ON s.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS t3 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t3.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_KEY, t3.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.window_column), Subquery2 AS (SELECT so.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.SUBJECT_KEY, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS offering_count, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units, SUM(ss.LAB_UNITS) AS total_lab_units, NULL AS window_column, 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment' AS Reason FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS so ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' GROUP BY so.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.SUBJECT_KEY, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME), CombinedSubjects AS (SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.SUBJECT_KEY, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.offering_count, s1.total_units, s1.total_lab_units, s1.window_column, s1.Reason FROM Subquery1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.SUBJECT_KEY, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.offering_count, s2.total_units, s2.total_lab_units, s2.window_column, s2.Reason FROM Subquery2 AS s2) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, SUBJECT_KEY, DEPARTMENT_NAME, offering_count, total_units, total_lab_units, window_column, Reason FROM CombinedSubjects ORDER BY SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_USE, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_HIST` AS b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE NOT r.AREA IS NULL AND NOT b.BUILDING_USE IS NULL AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_USE) SELECT ic.BUILDING_USE, ic.area_variance, bh.BUILDING_NAME_LONG AS building_with_largest_area FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT b.BUILDING_USE, b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, SUM(r.AREA) AS total_area, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.BUILDING_USE ORDER BY SUM(r.AREA) DESC) AS rn FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_HIST` AS b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE NOT r.AREA IS NULL AND NOT b.BUILDING_USE IS NULL AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_USE, b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG) AS bh ON ic.BUILDING_USE = bh.BUILDING_USE AND bh.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.area_variance DESC LIMIT 1

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, s.SESSION_TITLE, s.SESSION_LOCATION, s.SESSION_DATE, s.SESSION_START_TIME, s.SESSION_END_TIME, MIN(s.SESSION_START_TIME) OVER (PARTITION BY s.SESSION_LOCATION ORDER BY s.SESSION_LOCATION) AS min_start_time_per_location, d.TERM_CODE FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION` AS s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY WHERE d.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N') SELECT cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT, cte.SESSION_TITLE, cte.SESSION_LOCATION, cte.SESSION_DATE, cte.SESSION_START_TIME, cte.SESSION_END_TIME, cte.min_start_time_per_location, dr.window_column, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte AS cte JOIN (SELECT t1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE FROM `TIME_DAY` AS t0 JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20) AS dr ON cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE = dr.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND cte.TERM_CODE = dr.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON cte.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE ORDER BY cte.SESSION_LOCATION

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.AREA, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY FROM `FCLT_MAJOR_USE` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1), avg_major_use AS (SELECT FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, AVG(AREA) AS avg_area FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` WHERE ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY), subquery1 AS (SELECT i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.AREA, i.DESCRIPTION, (i.AREA - a.avg_area) AS deviation_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_major_use AS a ON i.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = a.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY), subquery2_base AS (SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.FLOOR, t0.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.OFFICE_LOCATION, t1.FULL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER, t0.AREA FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` AS t0 JOIN `EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY` AS t1 ON t0.BUILDING_ROOM = t1.OFFICE_LOCATION WHERE t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = 'E38'), avg_dept_area AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NUMBER, AVG(AREA) AS avg_area FROM subquery2_base GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NUMBER), subquery2 AS (SELECT s2b.BUILDING_ROOM, NULL AS AREA, NULL AS DESCRIPTION, (s2b.AREA - ada.avg_area) AS deviation_column, s2b.FLOOR, s2b.MAJOR_USE_DESC, s2b.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s2b.OFFICE_LOCATION, s2b.FULL_NAME, s2b.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM subquery2_base AS s2b JOIN avg_dept_area AS ada ON s2b.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER = ada.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER), CombinedRooms AS (SELECT s1.BUILDING_ROOM, s1.AREA, s1.DESCRIPTION, s1.deviation_column, NULL AS FLOOR, NULL AS MAJOR_USE_DESC, NULL AS ORGANIZATION_NAME, NULL AS OFFICE_LOCATION, NULL AS FULL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, 'AccessLevel1' AS Reason FROM subquery1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.BUILDING_ROOM, s2.AREA, s2.DESCRIPTION, s2.deviation_column, s2.FLOOR, s2.MAJOR_USE_DESC, s2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s2.OFFICE_LOCATION, s2.FULL_NAME, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, 'E38Rooms' AS Reason FROM subquery2 AS s2) SELECT * FROM CombinedRooms ORDER BY BUILDING_ROOM

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH BuildingAreaStddev AS (SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.BUILDING_NUMBER, STDDEV(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS` ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.BUILDING_NUMBER HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY area_stddev DESC), RoomAccessLevel1 AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.BUILDING_COMPONENT, t1.FLOOR, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(t1.FLOOR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SPACE_USAGE ORDER BY t1.FLOOR) AS window_column FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD` AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1) SELECT bal.BUILDING_NUMBER, bal.area_stddev, ral1.BUILDING_ROOM, ral1.BUILDING_COMPONENT, ral1.FLOOR, ral1.SPACE_USAGE, ral1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ral1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ral1.window_column, fr.AREA, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM BuildingAreaStddev AS bal JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS fr ON bal.BUILDING_NUMBER = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN RoomAccessLevel1 AS ral1 ON fr.BUILDING_ROOM = ral1.BUILDING_ROOM), BuildingAvgArea AS (SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(AREA) AS avg_area FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) SELECT i.BUILDING_NUMBER, i.area_stddev, i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.BUILDING_COMPONENT, i.FLOOR, i.SPACE_USAGE, i.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN BuildingAvgArea AS baa ON i.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = baa.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE i.AREA > baa.avg_area ORDER BY i.area_stddev DESC, i.FLOOR

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT dal.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dal.access_level_range, dal.access_level_variance, ds.avg_supervisees, ds.supervisee_range, ds.supervisee_variance FROM (SELECT HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.ACCESS_LEVEL) - MIN(ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_range, VARIANCE(ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_variance FROM `ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD` JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` ON ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE NOT ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.ACCESS_LEVEL IS NULL GROUP BY HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY access_level_range DESC) AS dal JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS fo ON dal.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY JOIN (SELECT SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT AS department_name, AVG(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS avg_supervisees, MAX(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) - MIN(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS supervisee_range, VARIANCE(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS supervisee_variance FROM `SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE` JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` ON SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.DEPT_NAMES = SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT ORDER BY supervisee_range DESC) AS ds ON su.SPACE_UNIT = ds.department_name ORDER BY dal.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.access_level_range, ic.access_level_variance, ic.avg_supervisees, ic.supervisee_range, ic.supervisee_variance, SUM(ssu.SQFT) AS total_sqft, AVG(ssu.RESEARCH_VOLUME) AS avg_research_volume FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS fo ON ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY JOIN `SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE` AS ssu ON su.DLC_KEY = ssu.DEPT_NAMES GROUP BY ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.access_level_range, ic.access_level_variance, ic.avg_supervisees, ic.supervisee_range, ic.supervisee_variance ORDER BY ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS undergrad_subjects_2021 FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS s JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS c ON s.HGN_CODE = c.HGN_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' AND c.SCHOOL_WIDE_ELECTIVES = 'U' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT COUNT(*) AS undergrad_subjects_2021_science FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS s JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS c ON s.HGN_CODE = c.HGN_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' AND c.SCHOOL_WIDE_ELECTIVES = 'U' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Science'

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptVariation AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `STUDENT_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), Subjects2017JA AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `STUDENT_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA') SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.window_column, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dv.coefficient_of_variation FROM Subjects2017JA AS s LEFT JOIN DeptVariation AS dv ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.window_column, i.coefficient_of_variation, dept_count.total_subjects_in_dept_2017JA FROM inner_cte AS i LEFT JOIN (SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS total_subjects_in_dept_2017JA FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `STUDENT_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS dept_count ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dept_count.DEPARTMENT_CODE

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH department_max_units AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6), eecs_students_courses AS (SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.COURSE_LEVEL ORDER BY t2.LAST_NAME) AS window_column, t0.COURSE FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS t0 JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci') SELECT dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmu.max_total_units, dmu.SCHOOL_NAME, esc.FULL_NAME, esc.EMAIL_ADDRESS, esc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, esc.COURSE_LEVEL, esc.window_column, esc.COURSE FROM department_max_units AS dmu JOIN eecs_students_courses AS esc ON dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME = esc.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.max_total_units, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.FULL_NAME, icte.EMAIL_ADDRESS, icte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, icte.COURSE_LEVEL, icte.window_column, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS sc ON icte.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS avg_hr_dept_code, MAX(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) - MIN(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS hr_dept_code_range, VARIANCE(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS hr_dept_code_variance, su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM `SPACE_UNIT` AS su JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND hou.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '03-DEC-24' GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY hr_dept_code_range DESC), Subquery2 AS (SELECT t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.DLC_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DLC_KEY ORDER BY t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 402100), CombinedResults AS (SELECT icte.SPACE_UNIT, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.avg_hr_dept_code, icte.hr_dept_code_range, icte.hr_dept_code_variance, icte.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, NULL AS DLC_NAME, NULL AS DLC_KEY, NULL AS window_column, icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, 'HRStats' AS Source FROM inner_cte AS icte UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SPACE_UNIT, s2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, NULL AS avg_hr_dept_code, NULL AS hr_dept_code_range, NULL AS hr_dept_code_variance, s2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, s2.DLC_NAME, s2.DLC_KEY, s2.window_column, NULL AS HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, 'SpaceUnitRank' AS Source FROM Subquery2 AS s2) SELECT SPACE_UNIT, ORGANIZATION_NAME, avg_hr_dept_code, hr_dept_code_range, hr_dept_code_variance, SPACE_UNIT_KEY, DLC_NAME, DLC_KEY, window_column, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, Source FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, SPACE_UNIT_KEY

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH TopSubjects AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserve_materials FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS lso JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE ORDER BY num_reserve_materials DESC LIMIT 10), PreviousTerms AS (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous') SELECT ts.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ts.TERM_CODE, pt.TERM_DESCRIPTION, pt.ACADEMIC_YEAR, pt.window_column, ts.num_reserve_materials FROM TopSubjects AS ts JOIN PreviousTerms AS pt ON ts.TERM_CODE = pt.TERM_CODE) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.num_reserve_materials, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ata.LAST_DAY_OF_FINAL_EXAM FROM inner_cte JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, h.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, h.NON_ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_HIST` AS h ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = h.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE h.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 0 AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.SITE = 'MIT') SELECT BUILDING_NAME, STDDEV(ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS assignable_area_stddev, AVG(NON_ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS avg_non_assignable_area FROM inner_cte GROUP BY BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ORDER BY assignable_area_stddev DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH subq1 AS (SELECT r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count, MIN(r.FLOOR) AS min_floor, r.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 100 AND r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY), subq2 AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.ROOM, t1.SPACE_ID, t1.AREA, t0.MAJOR_USE, t0.DESCRIPTION, MIN(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY) AS min_area_per_major_use, t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM `FCLT_MAJOR_USE` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 200 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1) SELECT s1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s1.room_count, s1.min_floor, s2.BUILDING_ROOM, s2.FLOOR, s2.ROOM, s2.SPACE_ID, s2.AREA, s2.MAJOR_USE, s2.DESCRIPTION, s2.min_area_per_major_use, s1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = s2.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY AND s1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT inner_cte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.room_count, inner_cte.min_floor, inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.FLOOR, inner_cte.ROOM, inner_cte.SPACE_ID, inner_cte.AREA, inner_cte.MAJOR_USE, inner_cte.DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.min_area_per_major_use, fo.DESCRIPTION AS ORGANIZATION_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS fo ON inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY inner_cte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.MAJOR_USE

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH AcademicYearStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC), PreviousTerms AS (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_PARAMETER, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, AVG(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TERM_INDICATOR ORDER BY t0.TERM_START_DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_INDICATOR = 'P') SELECT pts.TERM_CODE, pts.TERM_PARAMETER, pts.TERM_DESCRIPTION, pts.ACADEMIC_YEAR, pts.TERM_START_DATE, pts.window_column, ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ays.avg_total_units, ays.stddev_total_units FROM PreviousTerms AS pts JOIN AcademicYearStats AS ays ON pts.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.TERM_PARAMETER, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, cso.SUBJECT_CODE, cso.SUBJECT_NUMBER, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS cso ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.stddev_total_units DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH OrgLevel5 AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS window_column, t0.DLC_KEY, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID AS org_id FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5), LargeAssignableRooms AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.ROOM, t1.SPACE_ID, t1.AREA, t0.MAJOR_USE, t0.DESCRIPTION, MIN(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY) AS min_area_per_major_use, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM `FCLT_MAJOR_USE` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 200 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.ORGANIZATION_ID, o.DLC_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, o.window_column, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.FLOOR, r.ROOM, r.SPACE_ID, r.AREA, r.MAJOR_USE, r.DESCRIPTION, r.min_area_per_major_use, o.DLC_KEY FROM OrgLevel5 AS o JOIN LargeAssignableRooms AS r ON o.ORGANIZATION_ID = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.ORGANIZATION_ID, i.DLC_NAME, i.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, i.window_column, i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.FLOOR, i.ROOM, i.SPACE_ID, i.AREA, i.MAJOR_USE, i.DESCRIPTION, i.min_area_per_major_use, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE AS HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE_FROM_HR, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL AS HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL_FROM_HR FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON i.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t0.CALENDAR_DATE, t0.DAY_OF_WEEK, AVG(t0.CALENDAR_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.CALENDAR_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE) AS window_column FROM `TIME_DAY` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.TERM_START_DATE WHERE t1.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous'), SubjectCategoryStats AS (SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT i.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS i JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR), TermSubjectInfo AS (SELECT t.TERM_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT td.SUBJECT_ID) AS unique_subject_ids, MIN(i.PREREG_DEADLINE) AS earliest_prereg_deadline FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS td ON t.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS i ON t.TERM_CODE = i.TERM_CODE GROUP BY t.TERM_CODE) SELECT icte.TERM_CODE, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.TERM_START_DATE, icte.CALENDAR_DATE, icte.DAY_OF_WEEK, icte.window_column, scs.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, scs.ACADEMIC_YEAR, scs.subject_count, scs.min_term_start_date, ROUND(scs.subject_count / NULLIF(icte.window_column, 0), 2) AS Normalized_Subjects_Per_Year, tsi.unique_subject_ids, tsi.earliest_prereg_deadline FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN SubjectCategoryStats AS scs ON icte.TERM_START_DATE = scs.min_term_start_date JOIN TermSubjectInfo AS tsi ON icte.TERM_CODE = tsi.TERM_CODE ORDER BY Normalized_Subjects_Per_Year DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.ORGANIZATION_ID, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, MAX(t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ORGANIZATION_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_hr_org_unit_id FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT t1.ORGANIZATION_ID IS NULL AND NOT t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID IS NULL AND t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND NOT t1.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250')) SELECT i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.ORGANIZATION_ID, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, i.max_hr_org_unit_id, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, h.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON i.max_hr_org_unit_id = h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_rooms FROM `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd JOIN `SPACE_FLOOR` AS sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 100 AND sf.FLOOR_NAME LIKE '%Floor%'

SELECT fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fr.FLOOR, fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC, fr.AREA, AVG(fr.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY ff.FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE ORDER BY fr.AREA ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS avg_area_window FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` AS fr JOIN `FCLT_FLOOR` AS ff ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND fr.FLOOR = ff.FLOOR WHERE fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '32' AND ff.ACCESS_LEVEL = 2 AND fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC NOT LIKE '%STORAGE%' ORDER BY ff.FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE, fr.AREA

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fba.BUILDING_NUMBER, fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE, fba.CITY, fba.STATE, fba.POSTAL_CODE, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.BUILDING_TYPE, fb.BUILDING_USE, fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD, GREATEST(fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS, COALESCE(LEAD(fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD), 0)) AS max_num_of_rooms_3rows FROM `FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS` AS fba JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS fb ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_HIST` AS fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fba.CITY = 'Cambridge' AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC'), avg_rooms_cte AS (SELECT AVG(fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS avg_num_of_rooms FROM `FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS` AS fba JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS fb ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_HIST` AS fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fba.CITY = 'Cambridge' AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC') SELECT i.BUILDING_NUMBER, i.ADDRESS_PURPOSE, i.CITY, i.STATE, i.POSTAL_CODE, i.BUILDING_NAME, i.BUILDING_TYPE, i.BUILDING_USE, i.max_num_of_rooms_3rows, (i.max_num_of_rooms_3rows - a.avg_num_of_rooms) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_rooms_cte AS a ORDER BY i.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, i.FISCAL_PERIOD

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_members FROM `MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL` AS m JOIN `EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY` AS e ON m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER = e.KRB_NAME WHERE m.LAST_UPDATE_DATE > '01-JAN-15' AND e.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%Department%' AND NOT e.MIT_ID IS NULL AND e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'

SELECT sf.FLOOR_NAME, sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE FROM `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd JOIN `SPACE_FLOOR` AS sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 100 AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE = (SELECT MAX(sd2.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) FROM `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd2 WHERE sd2.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd2.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY AND sd2.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24') ORDER BY sf.FLOOR_NAME

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_subjects FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS so JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON so.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = ccc.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2014JA' AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 'Y'

SELECT fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME, VARIANCE(fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_of_rooms_variance FROM `FCLT_BUILDING` AS fb JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_HIST` AS fbh ON fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE = fbh.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE WHERE fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 0 AND fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 0 AND fbh.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' AND fbh.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME

SELECT fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, fr.BUILDING_ROOM, fr.FLOOR, fr.ROOM AS ROOM_NAME, fr.AREA, fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC, fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fba.BUILDING_NUMBER, fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE, fba.CITY, fba.STATE, fba.POSTAL_CODE, MIN(fr.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) AS MIN_AREA_OVER_BUILDING FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` AS fr JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS` AS fba ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 AND fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '32' AND fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'DP OF FACILITIES' ORDER BY fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY

SELECT COUNT(*) AS harvard_cross_enrollment_2012_subjects FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS so ON tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT = so.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss ON so.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT = ss.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2012' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'

SELECT fba.BUILDING_NUMBER, fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE, fba.CITY, fba.POSTAL_CODE, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.BUILDING_TYPE, fb.BUILDING_USE, fb.EXT_GROSS_AREA, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD, fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS, MIN(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) AS MIN_ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM `FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS` AS fba JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS fb ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_HIST` AS fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fba.CITY = 'CAMBRIDGE' AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' AND fb.BUILDING_NAME <> 'ASHDOWN HOUSE' ORDER BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY

SELECT COUNT(*) AS harvard_cross_enrollment_2012_subjects FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED` JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE LIKE '2012%' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 AND SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE, a.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE` AS a ON c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = a.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE, a.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM) SELECT ic.HASS_ATTRIBUTE, ic.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM, a.DESCRIPTION_IN_BULLETIN, ic.units_range, ic.units_variance FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE` AS a ON ic.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = a.HASS_ATTRIBUTE ORDER BY ic.units_range DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS nih_not_grad_chem_subjects FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS so JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = sos.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID WHERE sos.HGN_CODE = 'N' AND sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = 'NIH' AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'

SELECT sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sf.FLOOR_NAME, AVG(sd2.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS AVG_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE_PER_FLOOR FROM `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd JOIN `SPACE_FLOOR` AS sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY JOIN `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd2 ON sd2.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 10 GROUP BY sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sf.FLOOR_NAME ORDER BY sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_subjects FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS so ON tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = so.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss ON so.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = ss.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')

SELECT fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, MIN(fb.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS min_num_of_rooms, AVG(fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT) AS avg_building_height FROM `FCLT_BUILDING` AS fb JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS` AS fba ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND ((fb.NUM_OF_ROOMS BETWEEN 10 AND 400) OR (fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT >= 30)) AND fba.STREET_NUMBER BETWEEN 40 AND 27000 GROUP BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY

SELECT f.FLOOR_NAME, SUM(d.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS total_square_footage FROM `SPACE_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `SPACE_FLOOR` AS f ON d.FLOOR_KEY = f.FLOOR_KEY WHERE d.ROOM_NUMBER > 20 AND d.BUILDING_COMPONENT <> '13' AND d.BUILDING_KEY = 32 GROUP BY f.FLOOR_NAME HAVING SUM(d.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) > 0

SELECT tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status_description, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS td JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS` AS tms ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON td.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND td.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Biology' AND (NOT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY IS NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY NOT LIKE 'N/ACourse has no materials%') GROUP BY tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS ORDER BY material_count DESC LIMIT 10

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT su.SPACE_USAGE, VARIANCE(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS variance_square_footage FROM `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd JOIN `SPACE_USAGE` AS su ON sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = su.SPACE_USAGE_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = '32' AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 10 AND su.SPACE_USAGE NOT LIKE '%STORAGE%' GROUP BY su.SPACE_USAGE) SELECT SPACE_USAGE, variance_square_footage FROM inner_cte WHERE variance_square_footage > (SELECT AVG(variance_square_footage) FROM inner_cte)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS harvard_non_grad_subjects FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED` JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED.HGN_CODE_DESC = 'Not for graduate credit' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'

SELECT su.SPACE_USAGE, VARIANCE(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS variance_square_footage FROM `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd JOIN `SPACE_USAGE` AS su ON sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = su.SPACE_USAGE_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = '32' AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 10 AND su.SPACE_USAGE NOT LIKE '%STORAGE%' GROUP BY su.SPACE_USAGE

WITH building_hist_stats AS (SELECT fba.BUILDING_NUMBER, fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE, fba.CITY, fba.STATE, fba.POSTAL_CODE, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.BUILDING_TYPE, fb.BUILDING_USE, fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD, GREATEST(fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS, COALESCE(LEAD(fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD), 0)) AS max_num_of_rooms_3rows FROM `FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS` AS fba JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS fb ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_HIST` AS fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fba.CITY = 'Cambridge' AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC') SELECT BUILDING_NUMBER, ADDRESS_PURPOSE, CITY, STATE, POSTAL_CODE, BUILDING_NAME, BUILDING_TYPE, BUILDING_USE, max_num_of_rooms_3rows FROM building_hist_stats ORDER BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, FISCAL_PERIOD

SELECT COUNT(*) AS research_center_large_rooms FROM `SPACE_DETAIL` JOIN `SPACE_USAGE` ON SPACE_DETAIL.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = SPACE_USAGE.SPACE_USAGE_KEY WHERE SPACE_DETAIL.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 100 AND SPACE_USAGE.SPACE_USAGE = 'RESEARCH CENTER' AND SPACE_DETAIL.BUILDING_KEY = 32

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fb.BUILDING_NUMBER, MIN(fb.BUILDING_NUMBER) AS min_building_number, AVG(ff.FLOOR) AS avg_floor_number, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM `FCLT_BUILDING` AS fb JOIN `FCLT_FLOOR` AS ff ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND ((fb.BUILDING_NUMBER >= '14' AND fb.BUILDING_NUMBER <= 'E62') OR ff.FLOOR >= 2) AND ff.FLOOR BETWEEN 3 AND 16 GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NUMBER, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NUMBER, ic.min_building_number, ic.avg_floor_number, fba.STREET_NAME, fba.CITY FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS` AS fba ON ic.BUILDING_NUMBER = fba.BUILDING_NUMBER ORDER BY ic.BUILDING_NUMBER

SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ed.FULL_NAME AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_FULL_NAME, mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER, AVG(ed.OFFICE_PHONE) OVER (PARTITION BY ed.LAST_NAME ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS AVG_OFFICE_PHONE_WINDOW FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY` AS ed ON c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = ed.MIT_ID LEFT JOIN `MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL` AS mld ON ed.MIT_ID = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = 18 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sf.FLOOR_NAME, sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sd.FLOOR_KEY FROM `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd JOIN `SPACE_FLOOR` AS sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 100 AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE = (SELECT MAX(sd2.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) FROM `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd2 WHERE sd2.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd2.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY AND sd2.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24')) SELECT ic.FLOOR_NAME, ic.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, ic.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, cnt.Total_Rooms_On_Floor FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT sd.FLOOR_KEY, COUNT(*) AS Total_Rooms_On_Floor FROM `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 100 GROUP BY sd.FLOOR_KEY) AS cnt ON ic.FLOOR_KEY = cnt.FLOOR_KEY ORDER BY ic.FLOOR_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_code, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_CODE FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS c JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_CODE HAVING MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) > 120000) SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(i.max_cip_code) AS max_cip_code, s.SCHOOL_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS s ON i.SCHOOL_CODE = s.SCHOOL_CODE GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, MIN(e.OFFICE_PHONE) AS min_office_phone, c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY` AS e ON c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = e.MIT_ID WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND NOT e.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NULL GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID), RollupResults AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, SUM(num_unique_subjects) AS total_unique_subjects, MIN(min_office_phone) AS min_office_phone FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(num_unique_subjects) > 0) SELECT rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SUBJECT_CODE, ed.FULL_NAME AS responsible_faculty_full_name, ed.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS responsible_faculty_email, rr.total_unique_subjects, rr.min_office_phone FROM RollupResults AS rr LEFT JOIN `EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY` AS ed ON rr.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = ed.MIT_ID ORDER BY rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SUBJECT_CODE, responsible_faculty_full_name

WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS t1 JOIN `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t2 ON t1.COURSE_NUMBER = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.window_column, s2.coefficient_of_variation FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_CODE

WITH Sub1 AS (SELECT t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DLC_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.FCLT_MAJOR_ORG_KEY = 230 AND t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'), Sub2 AS (SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND NOT d.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' AND NOT o.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.DLC_KEY, s1.window_column, s2.organization_count, s2.min_organization_number, ROUND(s2.organization_count / NULLIF(s2.min_organization_number, 0), 2) AS normalized_org_count FROM Sub1 AS s1 JOIN Sub2 AS s2 ON s1.DLC_KEY = s2.DLC_KEY AND s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME = s2.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY normalized_org_count DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ff.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY) AS num_floors FROM `FCLT_FLOOR` AS ff JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS fb ON ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_HIST` AS fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 50 AND fbh.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND (fb.BUILDING_NAME = 'Ray and Maria Stata Center' OR fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '32')) SELECT ff.FLOOR, SUM(ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_assignable_area, SUM(ff.NON_ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_non_assignable_area FROM `FCLT_FLOOR` AS ff JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS fb ON ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_HIST` AS fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 50 AND fbh.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND (fb.BUILDING_NAME = 'Ray and Maria Stata Center' OR fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '32') GROUP BY ff.FLOOR ORDER BY ff.FLOOR

WITH OrgSpaceWindow AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, t0.DLC_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' AND NOT t0.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250')), OrgDlcStats AS (SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND NOT d.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' AND NOT o.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT ows.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ows.DESCRIPTION, ows.SPACE_UNIT, ows.window_column, ods.organization_count, ods.min_organization_number FROM OrgSpaceWindow AS ows JOIN OrgDlcStats AS ods ON ows.DLC_KEY = ods.DLC_KEY AND ows.ORGANIZATION_NAME = ods.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY ows.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ows.SPACE_UNIT

WITH AssignableAreaStddev AS (SELECT FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_NAME, STDDEV(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS assignable_area_stddev FROM `FCLT_BUILDING` JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_HIST` ON FCLT_BUILDING.COST_CENTER_CODE = FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.COST_CENTER_CODE WHERE FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_NAME <> 'BROWN BUILDING' GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ORDER BY assignable_area_stddev DESC), RoomAreaStats AS (SELECT fbh.BUILDING_NAME, AVG(fr.AREA) AS avg_area, VARIANCE(fr.AREA) AS var_area FROM `FCLT_BUILDING_HIST` AS fbh JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS fr ON fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fbh.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' OR fbh.BUILDING_NUMBER = '32' GROUP BY fbh.BUILDING_NAME) SELECT aas.BUILDING_NAME, aas.assignable_area_stddev, ras.avg_area, ras.var_area FROM AssignableAreaStddev AS aas JOIN RoomAreaStats AS ras ON aas.BUILDING_NAME = ras.BUILDING_NAME

WITH DeptReservedMaterials AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS total_reserved_materials FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrm ON td.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) > 10), ChemistrySubjects AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `STUDENT_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND NOT t0.TERM_CODE IS NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N') SELECT drm.department_name, drm.total_reserved_materials, cs.SUBJECT_TITLE, cs.TERM_CODE, cs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cs.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, cs.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, cs.SCHOOL_NAME, cs.max_enrolled_students FROM DeptReservedMaterials AS drm JOIN ChemistrySubjects AS cs ON drm.department_name = cs.join_dept_name ORDER BY drm.total_reserved_materials DESC, cs.max_enrolled_students DESC

WITH DeptUnitsStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC), MathSubjectsFaculty AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ed.FULL_NAME AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_FULL_NAME, mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER, AVG(ed.OFFICE_PHONE) OVER (PARTITION BY ed.LAST_NAME ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS AVG_OFFICE_PHONE_WINDOW, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY` AS ed ON c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = ed.MIT_ID LEFT JOIN `MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL` AS mld ON ed.MIT_ID = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = 18 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.units_range, dus.units_variance, msf.SUBJECT_CODE, msf.SUBJECT_NUMBER, msf.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_FULL_NAME, msf.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER, msf.AVG_OFFICE_PHONE_WINDOW FROM DeptUnitsStats AS dus JOIN MathSubjectsFaculty AS msf ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = msf.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY msf.SUBJECT_CODE

WITH LargestRoomPerFloor AS (SELECT sf.FLOOR_NAME, sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sd.FLOOR_KEY FROM `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd JOIN `SPACE_FLOOR` AS sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 100 AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE = (SELECT MAX(sd2.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) FROM `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd2 WHERE sd2.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd2.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY AND sd2.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24') ORDER BY sf.FLOOR_NAME), RoomAndAvgPerFloor AS (SELECT sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sf.FLOOR_NAME, AVG(sd2.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS AVG_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE_PER_FLOOR, sd.FLOOR_KEY FROM `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd JOIN `SPACE_FLOOR` AS sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY JOIN `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd2 ON sd2.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 10 GROUP BY sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sf.FLOOR_NAME, sd.FLOOR_KEY ORDER BY sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) SELECT lrf.FLOOR_NAME, lrf.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME AS LARGEST_ROOM_NAME, lrf.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS LARGEST_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, rapf.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, rapf.ROOM_NUMBER, rapf.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, rapf.AVG_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE_PER_FLOOR FROM LargestRoomPerFloor AS lrf JOIN RoomAndAvgPerFloor AS rapf ON lrf.FLOOR_NAME = rapf.FLOOR_NAME ORDER BY lrf.FLOOR_NAME, rapf.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE

WITH math_units_stats AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > (SELECT AVG(total_units) + STDDEV(total_units) FROM (SELECT SUM(ccso2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at2 JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS t)), math_subjects_faculty AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ed.FULL_NAME AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_FULL_NAME, mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER, AVG(ed.OFFICE_PHONE) OVER (PARTITION BY ed.LAST_NAME ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS AVG_OFFICE_PHONE_WINDOW, c.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY` AS ed ON c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = ed.MIT_ID LEFT JOIN `MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL` AS mld ON ed.MIT_ID = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = 18 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE) SELECT mus.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mus.total_units, msf.SUBJECT_CODE, msf.SUBJECT_NUMBER, msf.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_FULL_NAME, msf.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER, msf.AVG_OFFICE_PHONE_WINDOW FROM math_units_stats AS mus JOIN math_subjects_faculty AS msf ON mus.ACADEMIC_YEAR = msf.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND mus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = msf.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY mus.ACADEMIC_YEAR, msf.SUBJECT_CODE

WITH largest_room_per_floor AS (SELECT sf.FLOOR_NAME, sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sd.FLOOR_KEY FROM `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd JOIN `SPACE_FLOOR` AS sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 100 AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE = (SELECT MAX(sd2.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) FROM `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd2 WHERE sd2.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd2.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY AND sd2.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24') ORDER BY sf.FLOOR_NAME), room_and_avg_per_floor AS (SELECT sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sf.FLOOR_NAME, AVG(sd2.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS AVG_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE_PER_FLOOR, sd.FLOOR_KEY FROM `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd JOIN `SPACE_FLOOR` AS sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY JOIN `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd2 ON sd2.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 10 GROUP BY sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sf.FLOOR_NAME, sd.FLOOR_KEY ORDER BY sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) SELECT lrf.FLOOR_NAME, lrf.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME AS LARGEST_ROOM_NAME, lrf.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS LARGEST_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, raf.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, raf.ROOM_NUMBER, raf.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, raf.AVG_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE_PER_FLOOR FROM largest_room_per_floor AS lrf JOIN room_and_avg_per_floor AS raf ON lrf.FLOOR_NAME = raf.FLOOR_NAME ORDER BY lrf.FLOOR_NAME, raf.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE
